raw.excerpt: About HIGHSCALEWe're HIGHSCALE, a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing how brands advertise on TV and social media.
raw.description:
About HIGHSCALE

We're HIGHSCALE, a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing how brands advertise on TV and social media. Think Amazon's customer obsession meets SpaceX's fearless innovation.

Our 180-person team spans creatives, strategists, editors, and analysts, powering thousands of high-performance video ads for lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands every week. With 50,000 sq. ft. of studios in DTLA and an international network of creators and influencers, we're scaling fast, and we're building our media buying team to help us amplify that growth across global markets.

Why This Role Matters

Every viral campaign starts with precision targeting and flawless media execution. As a Media Buyer, you'll turn creative excellence into performance results, deploying millions in ad spend across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms for US brands.

You'll combine analytical rigor with creative intuition, ensuring every dollar spent fuels data-driven learning and exponential brand growth.

What You'll Do

Launch & Optimize Campaigns

  • Plan, execute, and optimize paid media campaigns across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and other digital platforms.

  • Manage budgets, bidding strategies, and audience targeting to maximize ROI.

  • Continuously A/B test creatives, audiences, and placements to identify scalable winners.

Analyze & Report Performance

  • Track and interpret campaign data daily to identify performance trends.

  • Build and present reports highlighting insights, learnings, and optimization strategies.

  • Translate numbers into actionable strategies for creative and strategy teams.

Collaborate Cross-Functionally

  • Work closely with creative, production, and strategy teams to ensure ads are optimized for performance and storytelling.

  • Provide feedback loops between creative and data, informing what works and what doesn't.

  • Support the strategy team in developing media plans and client recommendations.

Scale Efficiently

  • Manage and scale ad accounts with 5 to 6 figures in monthly spend.

  • Identify growth opportunities and emerging channels to stay ahead of the competition.

  • Proactively propose testing strategies and budget reallocations to maximize performance.

Stay Ahead of Trends

  • Keep up to date with algorithm updates, platform best practices, and performance marketing innovations.

  • Experiment with new ad formats and beta programs to drive early adopter advantage.

Who You Are

Performance-Driven

  • 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience managing paid media campaigns.

  • Proven track record in performance marketing, ideally for eCommerce, fashion, or beauty brands.

  • Strong analytical skills: comfortable reading metrics, building reports, and identifying growth levers.

Data-Savvy

  • Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, and analytics tools.

  • Bonus: hands-on experience with Amazon Ads (Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, DSP) or full Amazon listing management.

  • Bonus: DV360 or other programmatic platform experience.

Creative & Strategic

  • Understands what makes content perform: able to connect audience psychology with ad messaging.

  • Loves blending storytelling with numbers to drive conversions.

Fast & Adaptable

  • Thrives in a high-speed environment where priorities shift daily.

  • Excels at managing multiple campaigns and deadlines with precision.

Collaborative & Communicative

  • Excellent communication skills in English.

  • Available to work 9am to 6pm PST, Monday to Friday, alongside our LA team.

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote Role: Work with global teams from anywhere.

  • Growth Opportunities: Chance to lead media buying strategy for global DTC brands as we build out our team.

  • Profit-Sharing & Stock Options: Be part of our shared success as we scale.

  • Continuous Learning: Access to training, workshops, and tools that sharpen your analytical and creative edge.

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Manager, Sales Recruiting (APJ), you'll lead GitLab's Sales recruiting across the APJ region, partnering with regional Sales leaders to hire the quota-carrying and go-to-market talent that supports GitLab's growth. You'll build hiring strategies that reflect each market's nuances, business cultures, and candidate expectations while developing a team of recruiters. Your focus will be on making hiring repeatable across markets, providing a clear and thoughtful candidate experience, and helping business partners make informed hiring decisions. You'll also stay close to the work by recruiting for senior and specialized Sales roles when needed.

What you'll do

  • Lead and develop recruiters supporting a variety of sales roles, using coaching, feedback, and clear development plans to build capability and accountability.
  • Design recruiting strategies, structured interviews, and hiring frameworks that scale across APJ markets while reflecting local requirements.
  • Advise APJ Sales leaders on talent needs, market insights, and hiring trade-offs across markets such as Australia, India, Japan, Singapore, and Korea.
  • Navigate differences in compensation norms, notice periods, employment models, and candidate expectations with Legal, Compensation, and People partners.
  • Embed diversity, equity, and inclusion into recruiting processes and hiring decisions.
  • Manage a personal requisition load when needed, focusing on senior and specialized Sales roles such as country leaders, front-line managers, and technical sales talent.
  • Use recruiting data to track team performance, identify bottlenecks, and improve hiring strategies and candidate experience across the APJ Sales portfolio.
  • Partner with Sales Leadership, Sales Operations, Enablement, People Business Partners, Compensation, and Finance on workforce planning and coordinated candidate and stakeholder experiences.

What you'll bring

  • Experience developing recruiting teams for Sales or go-to-market organizations, delivering hiring outcomes across multiple APJ countries in a fast-scaling environment.
  • Ability to earn trust with senior Sales leaders while remaining hands-on with recruiting and advising on hiring decisions.
  • A systems-thinking approach to building scalable recruiting processes across varied Sales roles and local market requirements.
  • Ability to use data and analytics to shape recruiting strategy, identify gaps, and communicate impact to stakeholders.
  • Experience sourcing, engaging, and closing passive candidates for quota-carrying, specialized, and senior Sales roles, including discussing variable compensation and on-target earnings across markets.
  • Ability to solve problems in fast-moving, ambiguous environments while maintaining a thoughtful candidate experience.
  • Ability to collaborate across time zones in a remote-first, globally distributed team and apply equitable recruiting practices.
  • Multilingual ability or recruiting experience in Japan, India, or other APJ markets is a plus. We welcome diverse backgrounds and transferable skills relevant to this work.

About the team

Our Sales Recruiting team is a globally distributed group of recruiters and talent acquisition professionals who partner with Sales leaders around the world. We work remote-first and asynchronously, with a focus on clear processes, honest conversations with candidates, and hiring decisions grounded in data. The team moves quickly, shares what works, and values transparency, ownership, and learning from each other while maintaining a high bar for hiring quality and candidate experience.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

iTalent PLUS is recruiting Sales Managers on behalf of an international company operating within the iGaming and technology sector.

We are looking for ambitious, commercially driven professionals to support the company's international growth and business development activities.

We are open to candidates from different professional backgrounds, ranging from motivated B2B sales professionals with experience in SaaS or technology to established iGaming sales professionals with strong industry connections and an existing network of operators.

This is an excellent opportunity for individuals who enjoy building relationships, identifying business opportunities and closing deals in a fast-paced international environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and develop new business opportunities across international markets.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with prospective clients, partners and key decision-makers.

  • Manage the full sales cycle, from prospecting and lead generation through negotiations and closing.

  • Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of potential clients.

  • Represent the company at international iGaming conferences, exhibitions and networking events.

  • Conduct product presentations, commercial discussions and negotiations with prospective clients.

  • Work closely with internal teams to ensure successful onboarding and long-term client relationships.

  • Monitor market developments, competitor activities and emerging commercial opportunities.

  • Achieve agreed sales targets and contribute to the company's international expansion.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in B2B sales, business development or account acquisition.

  • Experience in iGaming, SaaS, technology or related industries.

  • Strong communication, negotiation and relationship-building skills.

  • A proactive, results-oriented mindset with the ability to identify and convert commercial opportunities.

  • Excellent English communication skills, together with fluency in either Spanish or Portuguese.

  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities and take ownership of commercial targets.

  • Willingness to travel internationally and attend industry events.

Additional Advantages

  • Previous sales or business development experience within the iGaming industry.

  • An established network of iGaming operators, aggregators or other industry stakeholders.

  • Experience developing business in emerging or less-regulated international markets.

  • Proven track record of generating new business and closing B2B commercial agreements.

  • Experience selling SaaS platforms, technology solutions or other complex B2B products.

  • Work remotely, from anywhere in Europe

What We Are Looking For

We value commercial drive, ambition and the ability to build lasting business relationships.

Whether you are an experienced iGaming sales professional bringing an established network or a highly motivated B2B salesperson looking to transition into the industry, we would be interested in hearing from you.

raw.description:
What you'll do...

Position: Staff UX Designer

Job Location: 1375 Crossman Avenue, Sunnyvale, CA 94089

Duties: Drives user experience solutions across a small- to medium-sized portfolio of projects by translating business needs into actions and roadmaps; evaluating the scope of projects; designing scalable, reliable, extensible, and maintainable user experience frameworks while balancing resources, constraints, requirements and complexity; directing other project team members to define or select methods to be used (for example, competitive audits, secondary research); managing the creation of user experience frameworks, process flows, site maps, wireframes, and prototypes to advance the company's merchandising, business, marketing, and branding objectives; developing scalable and flexible design frameworks and patterns to ensure the user experience is simple and cohesive; presenting design to project and business teams for review; collaborating with Engineering leads to determine efficacy of given solution; supervising the production of detailed specifications; and reviewing project requirements document (PRD) to ensure correct translation of design. Drives experience strategy and innovation to improve user experience by evaluating the current competitive landscape for compelling customer experiences; analyzing future trends and forecasts in related fields; constructing compelling artifacts outlining present conditions and proposed solutions; designing transitional roadmaps for the future or by clarifying existing user experience frameworks for small- to-medium-sized project portfolios; and presenting information within and across the organization to gain strategic alignment and encourage change. Structures, maintains, and delivers user experience design consistency across software design efforts in collaboration with Engineering Architects by formulating project needs and measures of success; developing and implementing user experience strategy to solve for near-term launch with consideration for long-term portfolio evolution; analyzing user tasks; designing optimum workflow to improve customer experience; requesting and attending usability and brainstorming sessions; and presenting user experience flow and project decisions to senior leadership. Drives continuous improvement of User Experience tools, documentation, and process by maintaining holistic viewpoint when tackling project decisions across the portfolio; defining solutions frameworks from a scalable and global viewpoint; recommending changes to and governing the evolution of site standards; collecting feedback and industry research standards; reviewing and approving projects based on best practices; and guiding the creation of patterns and styles. User Discovery: Requires knowledge of: User experience strategies; User interviews and surveys; User journeys; Story boards; Contextual inquiries. To assess gaps between business expectations and user experience strategies. Leverages a deep understanding of trends in user consumption habits to develop or improve interaction design and user experience strategies. Anticipates and mitigates risks during information synthesis and independently arrives at possible solutions for interactive designs. Analyzes and interprets existing data (for example web analytics, user surveys, customer support calls). Leads cross-functional team projects by establishing and communicating project needs and measures of success; directing cross-functional collaboration activities; collaborating with partners (for example, Engineering, site merchandising, customer advocacy); driving the attainment of project goals; creating customer experiences; advocating for the customer in experience workflow; requesting and attending usability sessions; participating in brainstorming sessions; and presenting user experience flow and project decisions to all levels of leadership.

Minimum education and experience required: Master's degree or equivalent in UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Product Design, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related area and 2 years of experience in UI/UX, interactive and visual design, electronics art, multimedia design, or related area; OR Bachelor's degree or equivalent in UI/UX Design, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Product Design, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related area and 4 years of experience in UI/UX, interactive and visual design, electronics art, multimedia design, or related area.

Skills required: Experience understanding various accessibility standards such as Web Content Accessibility Guideline (WCAG). Experience writing HTML and CSS specifically in relation to accessibility principles. Experience using Accessible Rich Internet Applications (ARIA) roles, properties, and states to enhance accessibility. Experience with screen readers such as JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver (Mac/iOS), and TalkBack (Android) to assess accessibility and identify issues. Experience with manually testing web applications with assistive technologies (screen readers and keyboard-only navigation) to ensure compliance with accessibility standards. Experience conducting accessibility audits and producing detailed reports to outline issues and recommend fixes. Experience using automated tools and scripts for accessibility testing (automated scans for WCAG compliance). Experience understanding design inclusive and accessible user experiences. Experience solving complex accessibility challenges, educating, and training design, engineering, and product teams and providing guidance and direction on accessibility standards and shift-left practices. Experience with magnification software (ZoomText), voice-activated tools like Dragon NaturallySpeaking, Windows Speech Recognition, and alternative input devices like switches or adaptive keyboards. Experience using browser developer tools (Chrome DevTools and Firefox Developer Tools) to inspect and debug accessibility issues in web pages. Experience using Figma to conduct accessibility reviews of design mockups and prototypes, ensuring that design elements like color contrast, typography, and interactive components comply with accessibility standards before development. Employer will accept any amount of experience with the required skills.

Salary Range: $200,304/year to $286,000/year. Additional compensation includes annual or quarterly performance incentives. 

Benefits: At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based incentive awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, education assistance with 100% company paid college degrees, company discounts, military service pay, adoption expense reimbursement, and more.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms. For information about benefits and eligibility, see One.Walmart.com.

Wal-Mart is an Equal Opportunity Employer.




Walmart and its subsidiaries are committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace and has a no tolerance policy regarding the use of illegal drugs and alcohol on the job. This policy applies to all employees and aims to create a safe and productive work environment.

raw.description:
About Remote People

At Remote People, we're building the infrastructure to power borderless teams. By handling global payroll, benefits, taxes, and compliance, our technology enables businesses to hire anyone anywhere compliantly at the push of a button.

If you're interested in adding to our vision of enabling people to work in dream jobs, for every company, and from anywhere in the world, apply now!

We're committed to building a global, diverse team representing different and varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We welcome applications from everyone, regardless of gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, or disability. Being part of Remote People means being part of a growing, international family.

Main mission of the role:

  • Successfully close, sign, and activate new client accounts from the China region, leveraging leads from various channels such as online platforms, partnerships, BDRs, etc.
  • Engage with and capitalize on opportunities from RP‘ existing client base, ensuring project closures and activations.
  • Independently generate a robust outbound sales pipeline, driving the process from lead generation to client activation.

主要任务：

  • 成功关闭、签约并激活来自中国区域的新客户账户，利用来自在线平台、合作伙伴、BDR等多种渠道的线索。
  • 利用RemotePeople现有客户群中的机会，确保项目的成功关闭和激活。
  • 独立生成强大的外部销售管道，从潜在客户生成到客户激活的整个过程。

Key responsibilities:

  • Own the entire sales cycle, from identifying and qualifying leads across diverse sources (marketing initiatives, partnerships, outbound efforts, networking, etc.) to converting them into successful business deals.
  • Promptly engage with new leads, upholding the highest standards of sales excellence to initiate a premium sales experience.
  • Actively develop your own project pipeline by reaching out to and securing new, previously unengaged (cold) companies through outbound strategies and leveraging your professional network.
  • From day one, nurture and strengthen relationships with both new and existing clients, understanding their business needs and challenges, and ensuring superior post-sales satisfaction through proactive communication and problem-solving.
  • Diligently manage and record all sales activities in our CRM system, maintaining high-quality data for continuous learning and improvement.
  • Collaborate closely with other customer-facing teams within RP (operations, legal, product, marketing) to enhance our customer-centric service offering.
  • Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly targets by focusing on client retention, expansion, and growth.
  • Exhibit proficiency in pipeline forecasting, management, and documentation.
  • Participate actively and punctually in all relevant sales meetings, contributing meaningfully to discussions.

职责：

  • 负责整个销售周期，从识别和确认来自多样化来源（市场活动、合作伙伴、外出努力、社交网络等）的线索，到将其转化为成功的商业交易。
  • 迅速与新线索接触，保持最高标准的销售卓越，启动优质的销售体验。
  • 通过外部策略积极发展自己的项目管道，并利用自己的专业网络，主动接触和争取新的、以前未接触过的（冷门）公司。
  • 从第一天开始，培养和加强与新老客户的关系，理解他们的业务需求和挑战，并通过主动沟通和解决问题，确保卓越的售后满意度。
  • 勤奋地管理并记录我们CRM系统中的所有销售活动，保持高质量的数据，以持续学习和改进。
  • 与RP内的其他面向客户的团队（运营、法律、产品、市场）紧密合作，增强我们的以客户为中心的服务提供。
  • 通过关注客户保留、扩展和增长，始终达到或超过每月和每季度的目标。
  • 展现在管道预测、管理和文档记录方面的熟练程度。
  • 积极准时参与所有相关的销售会议，有意义地参与讨论。

Requirements:

  • A minimum of 3 years’ experience in Sales or Business Development within a technology environment, preferably in HR or payroll software sales.
  • A passion for problem-solving, with a keen interest in understanding and rectifying underlying issues.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable engaging with prospects through phone, email, or in-person interactions.
  • Skilled in negotiating business terms with diverse client groups, including line-of-business, procurement teams, and senior management.
  • A track record of developing strong client relationships and leaving no stone unturned in this pursuit.
  • Proven success in building and closing deals from an outbound sales pipeline.
  • A history of exceeding sales quotas in previous roles.
  • Known for high energy and positivity, with a collegial spirit appreciated by teammates.
  • A driven, success-oriented mindset, balanced with a positive attitude and self-initiative.
  • Experience with Hubspot or Salesforce is advantageous.
  • Language requirement: native fluency in Mandarin Chinese, good English.

要求：

  • 至少3年在技术环境中的销售或业务发展经验，最好是在HR或薪酬软件销售方面。
  • 对解决问题充满热情，对理解和纠正潜在问题有浓厚兴趣。
  • 优秀的沟通和演讲技巧，能够通过电话、电子邮件或面对面交流舒适地与潜在客户接触。

raw.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

JOB TITLE

Leather Material Developer

Summary: At Quince, we are committed to crafting premium leather products that exemplify luxury, durability, and timeless design. We are looking for a Leather Material Developer to advance material quality, enhance supply chain consistency, and establish a strategic Leather Library to spur innovation across our product categories.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop, benchmark, and archive premium leather materials for handbags, small leather goods, belts, and accessories.
  • Establish and maintain a centralized Leather Library to ensure consistency and facilitate innovation.
  • Define and implement rigorous quality standards for leather performance, durability, and aesthetics.

Job Description:

Cloud Security Engineer

POSITION SUMMARY

The Cloud Security Engineer protects Gladstone's cloud platforms and services through secure design, configuration, monitoring, automation and evidence-led remediation. The role works across Azure, Kubernetes, networks, identity, workloads, data and delivery pipelines, and supports the safe adoption of AI-enabled systems and operational tooling.

AI-ENABLED WORKING
AI-enabled working is a core expectation of this role. The role holder will use approved AI tools and automation to improve quality, speed, insight and consistency; validate outputs before acting on them; protect customer, employee and company data; and share effective practices with colleagues. Performance will be assessed through outcomes such as quality, reliability, cycle time, risk control and knowledge transfer - not simply the volume of AI-generated output or frequency of tool use.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Cloud Security Engineering

  • Implement and maintain security controls across Azure subscriptions, identities, networks, Kubernetes, containers, servers, data services, endpoints and CI/CD pipelines.
    • Review cloud and platform designs, configuration and change proposals, identifying practical improvements before risk reaches production.
    • Automate secure configuration, vulnerability detection, policy checks, evidence collection and repeatable remediation where appropriate.
    • Support secrets, key, certificate, privileged-access and service-account lifecycle management.
    Detection, Response and Vulnerability Management
    • Monitor security signals and investigate suspicious activity, vulnerabilities, misconfiguration and control failures.
    • Prioritise remediation using exploitability, exposure, business impact and compensating controls rather than severity labels alone.
    • Support security incident response, evidence preservation, root-cause analysis and completion of corrective actions.
    • Maintain clear security findings, owners, due dates, exceptions and risk acceptance records.
    AI and Application Security
    • Threat model AI-enabled services and operational agents, including data leakage, prompt injection, over-permission, unsafe actions, supplier risk and inadequate human oversight.
    • Use approved AI tools to support security analysis, query development, evidence review and incident investigation while validating outputs and protecting sensitive data.
    • Work with R&D and Data teams to embed secure-by-design controls into the AI-DLC, data flows, APIs and deployment patterns.
    • Define and test guardrails for AI access to production systems, credentials, logs and customer information.
    Compliance and Security Culture
    • Provide technical evidence and remediation support for ISO 27001, PCI DSS, Cyber Essentials Plus, GDPR and customer assurance activity.
    • Create practical standards, runbooks and guidance and coach engineers on secure cloud and AI-enabled working.
    • Report material risks and trends clearly to the Cloud Operations Manager, Compliance Manager and relevant owners.

EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Essential

  • Hands-on experience securing Azure or another major cloud platform in a production environment.
    • Practical knowledge of identity and access management, networking, Kubernetes or containers, operating systems, vulnerability management, logging and incident response.
    • Ability to investigate and prioritise technical security findings and implement or coordinate effective remediation.
    • Experience with scripting, policy-as-code, infrastructure automation or security automation.
    • Understanding of secure development and deployment practices, including secrets and pipeline security.
    • Clear documentation and communication of technical risk to different audiences.
    Desirable
    • Azure security, Kubernetes security or recognised cyber-security certification.
    • Experience of ISO 27001, PCI DSS, Cyber Essentials Plus or regulated SaaS environments.
    • Experience threat modelling AI-enabled systems, APIs or agentic automation.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
• High ownership, sound judgment and a bias toward solving problems rather than moving them between teams.
• Curious and adaptable, with a practical commitment to continuous learning and responsible AI adoption.
• Systematic, evidence-led problem solving and attention to detail.
• Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
• Collaborative working style and willingness to share knowledge, review work and support others.

Senior UX Designer

Location: Remote

Duration: Permanent

Hours: Full time

Summary

The Wikimedia Foundation is a non-profit organization supporting Wikipedia and other Wiki projects. The Foundation operates one of the world’s top five websites and has global reach and impact. Technology and innovation are critical in our quest to support every human in freely sharing knowledge.

The Product Design team is looking for a Senior UX Designer with a solid understanding of user experience and product development processes to work within a new multi-disciplinary product team that will be focused on improving trust and safety. You will be influential in creating and developing the user experience, feeding directly into the product strategy for your product team.

For this role, you will primarily be working with the Reader Growth team, software focused on ways of learning and engagement for new and casual readers of Wikipedia.

Must be available for design, product and engineering team meetings and synchronous collaboration from 14:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC (10:00-14:00 ET / 7:00-11:00 PT)

You will be responsible for…

  • Reducing complexity to create simple, delightful experiences for our users.
  • Creating prototypes and running experiments to iteratively test your hypotheses.
  • Using and evolving our design system and guidelines, to create new features from ideas on paper to implementation.
  • Applying accessibility standards and guidelines to your designs.
  • Collaborating with product managers and engineers to create product plans and maintain product design processes.
  • Distilling complex concepts into easy to understand talking points to engage with our readers and communities throughout the design process.

Skills and experience….

The right person is better than the right set of experiences. These are the traits we’ve identified that make great additions to our team so far.

  • Can communicate their design goals and processes clearly and concisely to other team members and stakeholders.
  • Provides constructive feedback to other designers and welcomes feedback from others.
  • Experienced in conducting research, as well as collaborating with UX researchers, to build a deeper understanding of audience behaviours.
  • Is able to generate ideas for the future as well as think tactically about how to deliver work in the present.
  • Is self-motivated and seeks to evolve their skills and share what they’ve learnt with others.
  • 5+ years of experience contributing on design teams.
  • Bachelor's degree and/or Masters degree, or equivalent in related work experience

Additionally, we’d love it if you have...

  • Background in content consumption, publishing, education, or news
  • Experience acting as a researcher, both in-person and with remote participants
  • Have familiarity with Free Knowledge and/or Open Source communities
  • Speak more than one of the nearly 300 languages of the users you’ll be designing for

Team requirements

  • Attendance of mandatory design team meetings weekly on:
    • Mondays from 14:00-15:00 UTC (10:00-11:00 ET / 7:00-8:00 PT)
    • Tuesdays from 14:30-16:00 UTC (10:30-12:00 ET / 7:30-9:00 PT)
    • Thursdays from 14:00-15:30 UTC (10:00-11:30 ET / 7:00-8:30 PT)
  • Availability for team meetings and synchronous collaboration with primary product team from 14:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC (10:00-14:00 ET / 7:00-11:00 PT)

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries*. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$116,633 to US$181,243 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:
US States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)

Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (*citizens/permanent residents only)

We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.

All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.

If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or +1 (415) 839-6885.

  • Containerization and Orchestration: Manage and scale our containerized environments using technologies like Docker and Kubernetes. You will also be proficient with Helm for packaging applications and Kustomize for configuration management.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Lead Data/ETL Engineer to provide technical leadership and hands-on engineering for data ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery under the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This SME-level position will maintain and optimize SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), implement approved API integrations and incremental loading approaches, and build raw, standardized, and curated data layers. The engineer will establish reliable processes for reconciliation, retries, schema changes, identifier mappings, lineage, and failed-record handling.

The Lead Data/ETL Engineer will collaborate with database administrators, architects, governance personnel, AI/ML engineers, BI developers, testers, and Government stakeholders to deliver accurate, traceable, and maintainable data pipelines supporting mission analysis, AI capabilities, and reporting.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Lead Data/ETL Engineer will:

  • Lead the design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise data integration and ETL pipelines.
  • Maintain and optimize SSIS packages, configurations, schedules, dependencies, and execution processes.
  • Develop SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation logic.
  • Use Python or another approved automation language to support ingestion, orchestration, validation, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Implement approved API integrations, including authentication, pagination, rate-limit handling, retries, and error processing.
  • Design incremental loading strategies and implement change-data capture where appropriate and approved.
  • Build and maintain raw, standardized, and curated data layers with documented transformation rules.
  • Establish source-to-target mappings, common identifier mappings, and consistent handling of reference data.
  • Implement reconciliation checks to verify record counts, totals, completeness, and transformation accuracy.
  • Develop restartable processing, controlled retries, checkpoints, and recovery procedures.
  • Implement failed-record handling, quarantine processes, error logging, and controlled reprocessing.
  • Assess and manage schema changes and their effects on pipelines, datasets, analytical models, and reports.
  • Maintain data lineage, transformation documentation, interface specifications, and pipeline dependencies.
  • Monitor pipeline execution, throughput, freshness, resource utilization, and operational failures.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving source systems, APIs, SSIS packages, SQL logic, data quality, and downstream integrations.
  • Optimize pipeline performance while maintaining data integrity, traceability, and approved security controls.
  • Coordinate with governance personnel on definitions, ownership, authoritative sources, metadata, and approved data uses.
  • Work with independent testing personnel to support reconciliation, regression testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
  • Coordinate pipeline changes with database, application, AI/ML, warehouse, and BI teams.
  • Maintain version-controlled code, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Review technical designs and code, guide engineering practices, and provide knowledge transfer to other engineers.
  • Communicate pipeline health, risks, dependencies, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations to technical leads and Government stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Experience maintaining and optimizing SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Experience with Python and data engineering automation.
  • Experience implementing and supporting API integrations.
  • Experience developing incremental data loads.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining data lineage.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex data pipelines.
  • Ability to build raw, standardized, and curated data layers.
  • Ability to manage reconciliation, retries, schema changes, identifier mappings, and failed-record handling.
  • Ability to implement change-data capture where appropriate.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification when applicable to assigned duties.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Relevant data engineering or cloud platform certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense data environments.
  • Experience modernizing legacy SSIS integrations or transitioning pipelines to approved cloud platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise data warehouses, analytical datasets, BI platforms, or AI-ready data.
  • Familiarity with data catalogs, metadata management, data governance, and automated lineage tools.
  • Experience developing automated data-quality checks, reconciliation frameworks, and pipeline regression tests.
  • Experience integrating data engineering workflows with CI/CD, version control, and automated deployment.
  • Experience implementing secure service accounts, secrets management, encryption, and pipeline audit logging.
  • Strong technical mentoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Job Description:

Cloud Security Engineer

POSITION SUMMARY

The Cloud Security Engineer protects Gladstone's cloud platforms and services through secure design, configuration, monitoring, automation and evidence-led remediation. The role works across Azure, Kubernetes, networks, identity, workloads, data and delivery pipelines, and supports the safe adoption of AI-enabled systems and operational tooling.

AI-ENABLED WORKING
AI-enabled working is a core expectation of this role. The role holder will use approved AI tools and automation to improve quality, speed, insight and consistency; validate outputs before acting on them; protect customer, employee and company data; and share effective practices with colleagues. Performance will be assessed through outcomes such as quality, reliability, cycle time, risk control and knowledge transfer - not simply the volume of AI-generated output or frequency of tool use.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Cloud Security Engineering

  • Implement and maintain security controls across Azure subscriptions, identities, networks, Kubernetes, containers, servers, data services, endpoints and CI/CD pipelines.
    • Review cloud and platform designs, configuration and change proposals, identifying practical improvements before risk reaches production.
    • Automate secure configuration, vulnerability detection, policy checks, evidence collection and repeatable remediation where appropriate.
    • Support secrets, key, certificate, privileged-access and service-account lifecycle management.
    Detection, Response and Vulnerability Management
    • Monitor security signals and investigate suspicious activity, vulnerabilities, misconfiguration and control failures.
    • Prioritise remediation using exploitability, exposure, business impact and compensating controls rather than severity labels alone.
    • Support security incident response, evidence preservation, root-cause analysis and completion of corrective actions.
    • Maintain clear security findings, owners, due dates, exceptions and risk acceptance records.
    AI and Application Security
    • Threat model AI-enabled services and operational agents, including data leakage, prompt injection, over-permission, unsafe actions, supplier risk and inadequate human oversight.
    • Use approved AI tools to support security analysis, query development, evidence review and incident investigation while validating outputs and protecting sensitive data.
    • Work with R&D and Data teams to embed secure-by-design controls into the AI-DLC, data flows, APIs and deployment patterns.
    • Define and test guardrails for AI access to production systems, credentials, logs and customer information.
    Compliance and Security Culture
    • Provide technical evidence and remediation support for ISO 27001, PCI DSS, Cyber Essentials Plus, GDPR and customer assurance activity.
    • Create practical standards, runbooks and guidance and coach engineers on secure cloud and AI-enabled working.
    • Report material risks and trends clearly to the Cloud Operations Manager, Compliance Manager and relevant owners.

EXPERIENCE, KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS

Essential

  • Hands-on experience securing Azure or another major cloud platform in a production environment.
    • Practical knowledge of identity and access management, networking, Kubernetes or containers, operating systems, vulnerability management, logging and incident response.
    • Ability to investigate and prioritise technical security findings and implement or coordinate effective remediation.
    • Experience with scripting, policy-as-code, infrastructure automation or security automation.
    • Understanding of secure development and deployment practices, including secrets and pipeline security.
    • Clear documentation and communication of technical risk to different audiences.
    Desirable
    • Azure security, Kubernetes security or recognised cyber-security certification.
    • Experience of ISO 27001, PCI DSS, Cyber Essentials Plus or regulated SaaS environments.
    • Experience threat modelling AI-enabled systems, APIs or agentic automation.

PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES
• High ownership, sound judgment and a bias toward solving problems rather than moving them between teams.
• Curious and adaptable, with a practical commitment to continuous learning and responsible AI adoption.
• Systematic, evidence-led problem solving and attention to detail.
• Clear communication with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
• Collaborative working style and willingness to share knowledge, review work and support others.

Senior UX Designer

Location: Remote

Duration: Permanent

Hours: Full time

Summary

The Wikimedia Foundation is a non-profit organization supporting Wikipedia and other Wiki projects. The Foundation operates one of the world’s top five websites and has global reach and impact. Technology and innovation are critical in our quest to support every human in freely sharing knowledge.

The Product Design team is looking for a Senior UX Designer with a solid understanding of user experience and product development processes to work within a new multi-disciplinary product team that will be focused on improving trust and safety. You will be influential in creating and developing the user experience, feeding directly into the product strategy for your product team.

For this role, you will primarily be working with the Reader Growth team, software focused on ways of learning and engagement for new and casual readers of Wikipedia.

Must be available for design, product and engineering team meetings and synchronous collaboration from 14:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC (10:00-14:00 ET / 7:00-11:00 PT)

You will be responsible for…

  • Reducing complexity to create simple, delightful experiences for our users.
  • Creating prototypes and running experiments to iteratively test your hypotheses.
  • Using and evolving our design system and guidelines, to create new features from ideas on paper to implementation.
  • Applying accessibility standards and guidelines to your designs.
  • Collaborating with product managers and engineers to create product plans and maintain product design processes.
  • Distilling complex concepts into easy to understand talking points to engage with our readers and communities throughout the design process.

Skills and experience….

The right person is better than the right set of experiences. These are the traits we’ve identified that make great additions to our team so far.

  • Can communicate their design goals and processes clearly and concisely to other team members and stakeholders.
  • Provides constructive feedback to other designers and welcomes feedback from others.
  • Experienced in conducting research, as well as collaborating with UX researchers, to build a deeper understanding of audience behaviours.
  • Is able to generate ideas for the future as well as think tactically about how to deliver work in the present.
  • Is self-motivated and seeks to evolve their skills and share what they’ve learnt with others.
  • 5+ years of experience contributing on design teams.
  • Bachelor's degree and/or Masters degree, or equivalent in related work experience

Additionally, we’d love it if you have...

  • Background in content consumption, publishing, education, or news
  • Experience acting as a researcher, both in-person and with remote participants
  • Have familiarity with Free Knowledge and/or Open Source communities
  • Speak more than one of the nearly 300 languages of the users you’ll be designing for

Team requirements

  • Attendance of mandatory design team meetings weekly on:
    • Mondays from 14:00-15:00 UTC (10:00-11:00 ET / 7:00-8:00 PT)
    • Tuesdays from 14:30-16:00 UTC (10:30-12:00 ET / 7:30-9:00 PT)
    • Thursdays from 14:00-15:30 UTC (10:00-11:30 ET / 7:00-8:30 PT)
  • Availability for team meetings and synchronous collaboration with primary product team from 14:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC (10:00-14:00 ET / 7:00-11:00 PT)

About the Wikimedia Foundation

The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit organization that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our vision is a world in which every single human can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. We believe that everyone has the potential to contribute something to our shared knowledge, and that everyone should be able to access that knowledge freely. We host Wikipedia and the Wikimedia projects, build software experiences for reading, contributing, and sharing Wikimedia content, support the volunteer communities and partners who make Wikimedia possible, and advocate for policies that enable Wikimedia and free knowledge to thrive.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a charitable, not-for-profit organization that relies on donations. We receive donations from millions of individuals around the world, with an average donation of about $15. We also receive donations through institutional grants and gifts. The Wikimedia Foundation is a United States 501(c)(3) tax-exempt organization with offices in San Francisco, California, USA.

As an equal opportunity employer, the Wikimedia Foundation values having a diverse workforce and continuously strives to maintain an inclusive and equitable workplace. We encourage people with a diverse range of backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate against any person based upon their race, traits historically associated with race, religion, color, national origin, sex, pregnancy or related medical conditions, parental status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristics.

The Wikimedia Foundation is a remote-first organization with staff members including contractors based 40+ countries*. Salaries at the Wikimedia Foundation are set in a way that is competitive, equitable, and consistent with our values and culture. The anticipated annual pay range of this position for applicants based within the United States is US$116,633 to US$181,243 with multiple individualized factors, including cost of living in the location, being the determinants of the offered pay. For applicants located outside of the US, the pay range will be adjusted to the country of hire. We neither ask for nor take into consideration the salary history of applicants. The compensation for a successful applicant will be based on their skills, experience and location.

*Please note that we are currently able to hire in the following:
US States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, District of Columbia*, Florida, Georgia, Idaho, Illinois, Indiana, Iowa, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, New Jersey, New Mexico, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Puerto Rico*, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming (*US Territory or Federal District)

Countries: Brazil, Canada, Colombia, France, Germany, Ghana, India, Indonesia, Italy, Kenya*, Mexico, Morocco, Netherlands, Poland, Singapore*, South Africa, Spain, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. Our non-US employees are hired through a local third party Employer of Record (EOR) and must have current work authorization in their location. (*citizens/permanent residents only)

We periodically review this list to streamline to ensure alignment with our hiring requirements.

All applicants can reach out to their recruiter to understand more about the specific pay range for their location during the interview process.

If you are a qualified applicant requiring assistance or an accommodation to complete any step of the application process due to a disability, you may contact us at or +1 (415) 839-6885.

raw.excerpt: At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc.
raw.description:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and passionate Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be a key player in designing, building, and maintaining the scalable, reliable, and secure infrastructure that underpins all of our products and services. You will collaborate closely with software development teams to enhance developer experience, automate deployments, and ensure our platforms meet the highest standards of performance and availability. This is a high-impact, strategic role perfect for someone who enjoys solving complex problems at scale and empowering engineering teams to deliver exceptional software.

What you’ll do:

  • Design and Architect: Lead the design and architecture of scalable, resilient, and secure cloud-native platforms and infrastructure on cloud platforms like AWS and GCP.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Develop, manage, and champion the use of IaC tools like Terraform and Crossplane to automate infrastructure provisioning and management.
  • CI/CD and Automation: Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and ArgoCD to automate the build, testing, and deployment of applications, enabling faster and more reliable software delivery.
  • Containerization and Orchestration: Manage and scale our containerized environments using technologies like Docker and Kubernetes. You will also be proficient with Helm for packaging applications and Kustomize for configuration management.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Implement and manage robust monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog) to ensure system health and proactively identify and resolve issues.
  • Continuous Improvement: Identify problems, develop and implement solutions, and drive innovation to improve infrastructure performance, stability, and efficiency.Operations and Maintenance: Participate on on-call rotation to provide support for production infrastructure and respond to incidents.
  • Collaboration and Support: Work closely with development teams to provide self-service tools and platforms, troubleshoot complex issues, and act as a subject matter expert for our infrastructure.
  • Security: Implement and enforce security best practices, conduct security assessments, and ensure compliance with industry standards.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What you have:

  • Education:Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience:
    • 4+ years of experience in a Platform Engineer, DevOps, or SRE role, with a proven track record of working on large-scale, distributed systems.
    • Deep technical experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP).
    • Extensive hands-on experience with IaC tools like Ansible,Terraform and/or Crossplane.
    • Strong proficiency with containerization (Docker) and container orchestration (Kubernetes).
    • Solid understanding of CI/CD principles and experience with automation tools like GitHub Actions and ArgoCD.
  • Skills:
    • Proficiency in one or more programming/scripting languages such as Python, Go, or Bash.
    • Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix administration and networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP).
    • Experience with observability tools (like Prometheus, Grafana, or Datadog).
    • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

What makes you stand out:

  • Solid understanding of networking principles (e.g., VPCs, load balancing, firewalls) in a cloud environment.
  • Hands-on experience with ArgoWorkflows and ArgoCD.
  • Experience building and managing internal developer platforms (IDPs).
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd).
  • Knowledge of database management (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, Certified Kubernetes Administrator, Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer).

Where you’ll live:

  • While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates.

Working at PrizePicks:

The typical salary range for this position is $160,000 to $175,000. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process.

This application period will remain open for 30 days. We’re committed to finding the best candidate, so this date may be adjusted, and any changes will be reflected in this posting.

Date Posted: 10/28/2026

Benefits you’ll receive:

In addition to your great compensation package, full-time employees will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Company-subsidized medical, dental, & vision plans
  • 401(k) plan with company match
  • Annual bonus
  • Flexible PTO to encourage a healthy work/life balance (2 weeks STRONGLY encouraged!)
  • Generous paid leave programs, including 16-week paid parental leave and disability benefits
  • Workplace flexibility and modern work schedules focused on getting the job done, not hours clocked
  • Company-wide in-person events and team outings
  • Lifestyle enhancement program
  • Company equipment provided (Windows & Mac options)
  • Annual performance reviews with opportunities for growth and career development

You must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

PrizePicks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

raw.title: Lead Data/ETL Engineer
raw.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Lead Data/ETL Engineer to provide technical leadership and hands-on engineering for data ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery under the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Lead Data/ETL Engineer to provide technical leadership and hands-on engineering for data ingestion, transformation, integration, and delivery under the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This SME-level position will maintain and optimize SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), implement approved API integrations and incremental loading approaches, and build raw, standardized, and curated data layers. The engineer will establish reliable processes for reconciliation, retries, schema changes, identifier mappings, lineage, and failed-record handling.

The Lead Data/ETL Engineer will collaborate with database administrators, architects, governance personnel, AI/ML engineers, BI developers, testers, and Government stakeholders to deliver accurate, traceable, and maintainable data pipelines supporting mission analysis, AI capabilities, and reporting.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Lead Data/ETL Engineer will:

  • Lead the design, implementation, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise data integration and ETL pipelines.
  • Maintain and optimize SSIS packages, configurations, schedules, dependencies, and execution processes.
  • Develop SQL queries, stored procedures, transformations, and reconciliation logic.
  • Use Python or another approved automation language to support ingestion, orchestration, validation, monitoring, and recovery.
  • Implement approved API integrations, including authentication, pagination, rate-limit handling, retries, and error processing.
  • Design incremental loading strategies and implement change-data capture where appropriate and approved.
  • Build and maintain raw, standardized, and curated data layers with documented transformation rules.
  • Establish source-to-target mappings, common identifier mappings, and consistent handling of reference data.
  • Implement reconciliation checks to verify record counts, totals, completeness, and transformation accuracy.
  • Develop restartable processing, controlled retries, checkpoints, and recovery procedures.
  • Implement failed-record handling, quarantine processes, error logging, and controlled reprocessing.
  • Assess and manage schema changes and their effects on pipelines, datasets, analytical models, and reports.
  • Maintain data lineage, transformation documentation, interface specifications, and pipeline dependencies.
  • Monitor pipeline execution, throughput, freshness, resource utilization, and operational failures.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues involving source systems, APIs, SSIS packages, SQL logic, data quality, and downstream integrations.
  • Optimize pipeline performance while maintaining data integrity, traceability, and approved security controls.
  • Coordinate with governance personnel on definitions, ownership, authoritative sources, metadata, and approved data uses.
  • Work with independent testing personnel to support reconciliation, regression testing, defect resolution, and release validation.
  • Coordinate pipeline changes with database, application, AI/ML, warehouse, and BI teams.
  • Maintain version-controlled code, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Review technical designs and code, guide engineering practices, and provide knowledge transfer to other engineers.
  • Communicate pipeline health, risks, dependencies, corrective actions, and improvement recommendations to technical leads and Government stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of 12 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Experience maintaining and optimizing SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS).
  • Strong SQL skills.
  • Experience with Python and data engineering automation.
  • Experience implementing and supporting API integrations.
  • Experience developing incremental data loads.
  • Experience documenting and maintaining data lineage.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex data pipelines.
  • Ability to build raw, standardized, and curated data layers.
  • Ability to manage reconciliation, retries, schema changes, identifier mappings, and failed-record handling.
  • Ability to implement change-data capture where appropriate.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification when applicable to assigned duties.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Relevant data engineering or cloud platform certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense data environments.
  • Experience modernizing legacy SSIS integrations or transitioning pipelines to approved cloud platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise data warehouses, analytical datasets, BI platforms, or AI-ready data.
  • Familiarity with data catalogs, metadata management, data governance, and automated lineage tools.
  • Experience developing automated data-quality checks, reconciliation frameworks, and pipeline regression tests.
  • Experience integrating data engineering workflows with CI/CD, version control, and automated deployment.
  • Experience implementing secure service accounts, secrets management, encryption, and pipeline audit logging.
  • Strong technical mentoring, documentation, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

The Aumentum Technologies support team is seeking a Support Specialist to provide application support to customers that will involve answering complex questions on the function and usage of our products. As a Support Specialist, you will provide application support and expertise to both our customers and internal resources. This will involve answering complex questions, contributing to our knowledge base, and serving as a support liaison between the company and our customers. Working closely with other Support team members and counterparts on the Research and Development team, you will investigate, manage, track, and close client support issues, specifically related to the database and function of the application(s) and escalations.


Responsibilities:

  • Work directly or indirectly with customers to provide services and help resolve user issues
  • Assess a variety of software scenarios, reviewing software configuration, set up, and software code to identify the correct resolution or escalate according to departmental guidelines
  • Report detailed information within the client tracking system and document processes, routines, and programs by following the defined guidelines and team goals and objectives
  • Work closely with other team members, exchanging knowledge through training sessions, and producing documentation
  • Create and conduct training for customers on functionality and best practices for products, including at user conferences
  • Collaborate with customers and/or our product and engineering teams to document proposed enhancements and determine cause/resolution to software defects
  • Work with our Account Managers to process and track contracted services
  • Review all technical support related processes and documentation for continuous improvement

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with relational databases and reading / writing T-SQL
  • Previous experience with property tax software support and or knowledge of the property tax life cycle
  • Experience with the following: SQL, Excel, Crystal Reports

Competencies:

  • Action Oriented
  • Approachability
  • Customer Focus
  • Informing
  • Listening
  • Managerial Courage
  • Patience
  • Peer Relationships
  • Technical Learning
  • Time Management

Required Qualifications:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

  • 3 + years' experience in Customer Service Role
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills
  • Excellent listening skills and the ability to ask probing questions, understand concerns, overcome objectives and resolve problems
  • Strong work ethic and self-starter, ability to work independently and as a team player
