raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior AI/ML & MLOps Engineer to build, deploy, monitor, maintain, and govern production machine learning capabilities supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This position will maintain training, validation, and testing datasets; develop automated model deployment pipelines; monitor deployed models; detect data and model drift; and control updates to production models, datasets, configurations, and supporting services. The engineer will implement repeatable, traceable, and secure processes for promoting machine learning capabilities from development through testing and into production.

The Senior AI/ML & MLOps Engineer will work with data scientists, data engineers, cloud architects, software developers, cybersecurity personnel, testers, operations teams, and Government mission owners. The successful candidate must be able to combine machine learning engineering with deployment automation, monitoring, version control, rollback planning, and model and data governance.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior AI/ML & MLOps Engineer will:

  • Maintain training, validation, and testing datasets used for machine learning development and evaluation.
  • Develop repeatable processes for dataset ingestion, preparation, transformation, validation, versioning, and controlled promotion.
  • Ensure datasets are maintained in or can be transformed into analysis-ready and model-ready formats.
  • Evaluate datasets for quality, completeness, consistency, integrity, provenance, and fitness for their intended purpose.
  • Maintain traceability among source data, transformed datasets, features, model versions, evaluation results, and production deployments.
  • Build and maintain automated pipelines for data preparation, model training, model evaluation, packaging, deployment, monitoring, and rollback.
  • Deploy machine learning models into approved cloud, application, analytical, and operational environments.
  • Automate model build, test, validation, promotion, deployment, and recovery processes.
  • Configure and maintain model registries and controlled repositories for models, datasets, code, configurations, dependencies, and evaluation results.
  • Implement automated unit, integration, regression, data-quality, pipeline, and deployment testing.
  • Establish model-evaluation procedures, performance measures, validation thresholds, and release-readiness criteria.
  • Monitor production models for accuracy, performance, availability, latency, errors, data drift, concept drift, and unexpected behavior.
  • Configure alerts, dashboards, thresholds, and escalation procedures for model degradation, drift, data-quality issues, and pipeline failures.
  • Investigate production model, dataset, pipeline, and deployment anomalies.
  • Coordinate corrective actions with data, application, infrastructure, security, testing, and mission teams.
  • Control updates to production models, datasets, pipelines, features, dependencies, and configurations through documented change and approval procedures.
  • Maintain version control for model code, training logic, deployment scripts, datasets, features, configurations, and infrastructure definitions.
  • Develop and test rollback procedures for model, dataset, pipeline, and configuration updates.
  • Support secure data pipelines used for model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and operational analysis.
  • Maintain documentation covering model purpose, datasets, evaluation methods, performance, limitations, dependencies, deployments, changes, incidents, and known risks.
  • Support the auditing and validation of model outputs to identify inaccurate, unsupported, or unexpected results.
  • Help implement human-review and escalation checkpoints for model outputs that may affect mission or operational decisions.
  • Integrate MLOps workflows with continuous integration, continuous delivery, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, monitoring, and incident-management capabilities.
  • Support data and model governance requirements, including access controls, versioning, approval gates, traceability, change control, and audit logging.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to address vulnerabilities, identity and access controls, secrets management, software dependencies, encryption, logging, and authorization requirements.
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams on data ingestion, transformation, metadata, warehouse integration, data quality, and governed access.
  • Assist with architecture reviews, code reviews, release-readiness reviews, troubleshooting, operational handoff, and knowledge transfer.
  • Prepare model lifecycle documentation, deployment instructions, rollback procedures, monitoring plans, test results, technical diagrams, and operating guides.
  • Communicate model status, performance, drift, risks, incidents, and corrective actions to technical teams, Government stakeholders, and program leadership.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience maintaining machine learning training, validation, and testing datasets.
  • Experience building or maintaining automated machine learning deployment pipelines.
  • Experience deploying machine learning models into production environments.
  • Experience monitoring production models and supporting services.
  • Experience detecting and responding to model or data drift.
  • Experience using version control for model code, datasets, configurations, pipelines, or deployment artifacts.
  • Experience developing and executing rollback procedures for models, datasets, pipelines, or production configurations.
  • Experience controlling model and dataset updates through documented change, testing, and approval procedures.
  • Experience implementing automated testing for machine learning models, data pipelines, APIs, or deployment workflows.
  • Experience with cloud-based machine learning services or production cloud environments.
  • Understanding of model evaluation, validation metrics, production monitoring, model governance, and data governance.
  • Ability to maintain traceability across datasets, transformations, model versions, evaluation results, deployments, and production outcomes.
  • Ability to investigate and resolve model, dataset, pipeline, and deployment issues.
  • Understanding of secure data pipelines, access controls, audit logging, encryption, secrets management, and dependency security.
  • Ability to document and communicate model performance, drift, limitations, risks, incidents, and corrective actions.
  • CompTIA Security+ CE or another approved IAT Level II certification.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate or a comparable machine learning platform certification.
  • Additional AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Databricks, data engineering, or cloud architecture certification.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense programs.
  • Experience operating machine learning capabilities in secure, regulated, or mission-critical environments.
  • Experience with MLflow, Amazon SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, Databricks, Kubeflow, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with model registries, feature stores, metadata repositories, experiment tracking, or data-lineage tools.
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
  • Experience implementing observability, automated alerting, incident response, and production reliability controls.
  • Familiarity with responsible AI practices, model explainability, output validation, bias evaluation, and human oversight.
  • Familiarity with DoD Impact Level 4 or comparable Government cloud and data-protection requirements.
  • Experience supporting analytical models, generative AI, retrieval workflows, or agentic AI capabilities.

Skills

  • Machine learning operations and lifecycle management.
  • Training, validation, and testing dataset maintenance.
  • Automated model deployment pipelines.
  • Production model monitoring.
  • Model and data drift detection.
  • Model evaluation and performance analysis.
  • Version control and configuration management.
  • Rollback and recovery planning.
  • Model and data governance.
  • Cloud ML platforms and secure data pipelines.
  • Automated testing and release validation.
  • Production troubleshooting and incident response.
  • Technical documentation and stakeholder communication.
  • Collaboration across data, software, cloud, security, testing, mission, and operations teams.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: ERP Application Developer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $115,000–$130,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a ERP Application Developer with broad expertise across Workday configuration, reporting, calculated fields, business process design, and Workday Extend application development. The role spans technical configuration, custom report design, integration support, and lightweight application extension work, helping HR, finance, and IT stakeholders get more value from the Workday platform. The ideal candidate combines strong Workday platform knowledge with practical engineering discipline and the ability to translate business requirements into clean, maintainable Workday configurations. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Required Qualifications
  • Five or more years of Workday technical experience.
  • Deep expertise in Workday report writer including advanced and composite reports.
  • Strong proficiency with calculated fields across HCM and Finance.
  • Hands-on experience configuring business processes and condition rules.
  • Strong understanding of Workday security framework.
  • Experience with PRISM Analytics or Workday Extend.
  • Familiarity with Workday tenant management and release process.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Workday Pro certifications.
  • Experience with Workday Extend application development.
  • Familiarity with PRISM data ingestion and modeling.
  • Exposure to multi-tenant or multi-region Workday deployments.

raw.excerpt: About The RoleEverPro is hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the next chapter of ZyraTalk, our AI-powered voice and receptionist product line.
raw.description:
About The Role

EverPro is hiring a Senior Product Manager to lead the next chapter of ZyraTalk, our AI-powered voice and receptionist product line. ZyraTalk was recently acquired by EverCommerce and is now becoming a core part of EverPro’s AI and customer engagement strategy across our portfolio of home services software products.

This role will own the product direction for ZyraTalk while also driving the broader EverPro Voice product line: deepening integrations into EverPro Product Suite; expanding the value of AI voice across customer communication workflows; and helping shape how voice agents become an embedded, revenue-driving capability across the EverPro suite.

The ideal candidate is a senior product leader who is comfortable operating at the intersection of AI, voice, SaaS workflow automation, customer experience, and platform integration. They should be able to translate market opportunity and customer pain into clear product strategy, partner closely with engineering and go-to-market teams, and bring structure to a product area entering its next phase of scale.

What You’ll Own

  • Lead the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for ZyraTalk as part of the EverPro product portfolio.
  • Define and drive the EverPro Voice product line, including how AI voice capabilities integrate into and enhance EverPro’s vertical SaaS products.
  • Identify and prioritize integration opportunities across EverPro products, with a focus on customer communication, scheduling, lead capture, missed-call handling, support workflows, and revenue conversion.
  • Partner with engineering, design, AI/platform teams, customer success, sales, and business unit leaders to deliver high-impact voice and AI-powered workflows.
  • Build a deep understanding of home services SMB customers and how voice automation can reduce administrative burden, improve responsiveness, and drive business outcomes.
  • Translate customer needs, product usage, and business priorities into clear requirements, product briefs, launch plans, and success metrics.
  • Own product discovery, customer feedback loops, competitive analysis, and market insights for AI voice and receptionist capabilities.
  • Drive adoption and commercialization of voice offerings across EverPro, including packaging, positioning, enablement, and expansion opportunities.
  • Establish product KPIs and operating rhythms to measure usage, quality, retention, revenue impact, customer satisfaction, and operational effectiveness.
  • Help lead the transition from founder-led product intuition to a scalable product management discipline for the ZyraTalk product area.

What You’ll Do

  • Create a compelling product vision for AI voice within EverPro and turn that vision into an actionable roadmap.
  • Work closely with engineering to continue developing ZyraTalk’s core capabilities, including call handling, conversational flows, integrations, routing, summaries, handoffs, analytics, and customer-specific configuration.
  • Partner with EverPro product teams to determine where voice should be embedded directly into existing workflows and where it should operate as a standalone or cross-product offering.
  • Prioritize product investments across core ZyraTalk enhancements, platform integrations, customer-specific needs, and scalable shared capabilities.
  • Collaborate with go-to-market teams to define target customers, packaging, pricing inputs, sales enablement, launch sequencing, and expansion motions.
  • Partner with AI and platform leaders to ensure voice capabilities align with EverPro’s broader agentic platform strategy, including shared tooling, data access, observability, security, and reusable agent patterns.
  • Develop a strong point of view on the AI voice market, including competitive offerings, customer expectations, technical constraints, and emerging opportunities.
  • Bring clarity and momentum to a product area with high strategic importance and significant cross-portfolio potential.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of product management experience, including experience owning complex SaaS products or platform capabilities.
  • Experience with AI, voice, conversational products, communications platforms, workflow automation, or customer engagement tools strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to lead product strategy and execution in a cross-functional environment.
  • Strong customer discovery skills and ability to translate qualitative and quantitative insights into product decisions.
  • Experience working with engineering teams on technically complex products, integrations, APIs, data workflows, or platform capabilities.
  • Ability to balance near-term customer and business needs with longer-term platform and product strategy.
  • Strong analytical skills, including comfort defining success metrics, evaluating adoption, and making prioritization decisions based on data.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to align executives, product teams, engineering, sales, customer success, and other stakeholders.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity, especially in a newly acquired or rapidly evolving product area.
  • Strong commercial instincts and an understanding of how product decisions influence packaging, adoption, retention, and revenue growth.

Nice To Have

  • Experience with voice AI, contact center technology, virtual receptionist products, call tracking, telephony, or conversational AI.
  • Experience integrating acquired products into a broader product portfolio.
  • Experience serving SMB customers, especially in home services, field services, construction, pest control, lawn care, HVAC, plumbing, or similar verticals.
  • Familiarity with AI agents, LLM-powered workflows, speech-to-text / text-to-speech systems, call analytics, or automation platforms.
  • Experience building products across multiple brands, business units, or vertical SaaS products.

Success In This Role Looks Like

  • ZyraTalk has a clear product strategy, roadmap, and operating rhythm.
  • EverPro has a defined Voice product line with clear integration paths across priority products.
  • Voice capabilities are embedded into meaningful customer workflows, not treated as a standalone add-on alone.
  • Product teams across EverPro understand how and where to leverage ZyraTalk capabilities.
  • Customers see measurable value through improved responsiveness, reduced missed opportunities, saved administrative time, and stronger customer communication.
  • The business has a clear view of adoption, quality, revenue impact, and expansion potential.
  • ZyraTalk successfully transitions from founder-led momentum into a scalable, integrated EverPro product capability.

Why This Role Matters

AI voice is becoming one of the most important front doors for small businesses. For EverPro customers, every missed call can mean missed revenue, slower service, or a weaker customer experience. ZyraTalk gives EverPro the opportunity to bring intelligent voice automation directly into the workflows our customers already use every day.

This role will help turn that opportunity into a scaled product line: continuing to advance ZyraTalk while building the voice layer of the EverPro suite.

Become a part of our caring community

Become a Part of Our Caring Community

Humana is seeking a Lead Applied Scientist to design, develop, and scale intelligent decision systems powering our Next Best Action (NBA) platform.

Our platform combines machine learning, reinforcement learning, and decision intelligence to deliver personalized recommendations that improve healthcare experiences and outcomes for millions of members.

We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can translate complex business problems into scalable, production-ready decision systems. The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning expertise with an understanding of decision science and software engineering.

This role goes beyond building predictive models. You will have end-to-end ownership of models and decision policies, from initial prototyping and experimentation through offline evaluation, simulation, testing, production deployment, and ongoing monitoring. You will help define how intelligent systems make decisions, evaluate their behavior under real-world constraints and uncertainty, and continuously improve their performance based on production outcomes.

Key Responsibilities


Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning


Design, develop, and improve machine learning and reinforcement learning models for personalized recommendations, sequential decision making, and policy learning.


Decision Intelligence and Simulation


Apply decision science, operations research, and simulation techniques to formulate complex decision problems, evaluate alternatives, and improve outcomes under business and operational constraints.


Scalable ML Engineering


Develop and improve production ML pipelines using Python, PyTorch, Databricks, PySpark, Ray RLlib, and MLflow, supporting large-scale data processing, model training, and inference.


Model Evaluation and Experimentation


Design experiments, simulations, offline evaluations, and performance metrics to assess model effectiveness, policy behavior, decision quality, and business impact before and after deployment.


Production Deployment and Monitoring


Own models and decision policies throughout their lifecycle, from prototyping and testing through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Partner with software engineering and platform teams to ensure production systems are scalable, reliable, and observable.


Constraint-Aware Decision Making


Incorporate clinical eligibility, member preferences, business rules, operational capacity, and other constraints into intelligent decision systems.


Technical Leadership


Provide technical direction on model architecture, algorithm selection, evaluation methods, engineering best practices, and system design while collaborating with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience in machine learning, applied science, decision science, or related engineering disciplines.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and monitoring machine learning solutions in production environments.
  • Solid understanding of reinforcement learning, sequential decision making, or other advanced decision-making techniques.
  • Strong Python programming skills and experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Experience with distributed data processing and ML platforms such as Databricks, PySpark, Ray, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, including software architecture, code quality, automated testing, and scalable system design.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate complex business problems into analytical models and production solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience owning models across the full lifecycle, including prototyping, offline evaluation, simulation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with reinforcement learning algorithms, contextual bandits, Markov Decision Processes, or offline policy evaluation.
  • Experience with operations research, simulation, or decision analysis.
  • Familiarity with MLflow, Ray RLlib, Databricks, and distributed model training.
  • Experience developing recommendation systems, personalization platforms, or Next Best Action solutions.
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka, Redis, or rule-based decision engines.
  • Familiarity with decision mapping, multi-objective decision making, and decision making under uncertainty.
  • Experience monitoring deployed models and policies for changes in performance, data distributions, and decision behavior.
  • Experience within healthcare, insurance, or other regulated industries.

Additional Information

This role is not eligible for work visa sponsorship.


Work Style: Remote/Hybrid - Preferably Boston, MA. Occasional travel to Humana's offices for training or meetings may be required.


Work Hours: Typical business hours are Monday-Friday, 8 hours/day, 5 days/week-- some flexibility might be possible, depending on business needs.

Very minimal travel might be required for training, meetings, and/or conferences

Crum & Forster Company Overview

Crum & Forster (C&F), with a proud history dating to 1822, provides specialty and standard commercial lines insurance products through our admitted and surplus lines insurance companies. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best and is proud of our superior customer service platform. Our claims and risk engineering services are recognized as among the best in the industry.

Our most valuable asset is our people: more than 2000 employees in locations throughout the United States. The company is increasingly winning recognition as a great place to work, earning several workplace and wellness awards, including the 2025 Great Place to Work® Award for our employee-first focus and our steadfast commitment to diversity, equity and Inclusion.

C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings, a global, billion dollar organization. For more information about Crum & Forster, please visit our website: www.cfins.com.

Job Description

Since 2000, Crum & Forster’s Accident & Health division (A&H) has offered a diverse portfolio of specialty insurance and reinsurance products nationwide. We place a strong focus on product development and creative distribution methods, along with excellent client service and support.

In addition to our robust domestic portfolio, which spans both special risk and medical solutions, A&H works on an international basis through various partnerships. Our global capabilities provide our partners with even broader flexibility in underwriting solutions. Gross premium written in 2025 surpassed $2.4B. The qualities and capabilities of Crum & Forster Accident & Health demonstrate our philosophy of building meaningful, long-term partnerships and our dedication to providing alternative strategies in an ever-changing insurance market.

The Claims department of the Crum & Forster Accident & Health segment is looking for a multi-talented individual to join the Program Claims team supporting the Specialty Business Unit (SBU). This Program Manager will work as part of the claims team to proactively manage a team of Specialists assigned to manage a portfolio of claim clients (Third Party Administrators and Managing General Underwriters) while performing oversight and enhancing the client relationship by identifying and resolving process issues in all phases of the client’s and company’s operations. This individual will interact internally with Underwriting, Actuarial, Compliance, IT, and externally with the division’s business partners.

What you will do:

Relationship Management:

  • Act as an Audit Coordinator, by scheduling, coordinating & monitoring annual audits
  • Be the first-level review of all required reports drafted by Program Management Team members
  • Have oversight of Program Team member functions including:
    • Assist in the creation of a relationship-based culture through a broad set of activities which include managing a diverse portfolio of products and administrators on an ongoing basis
    • Serve as a “next step” liaison to administrative, operations, and underwriting areas of the company, on an ongoing basis
    • Utilize sensitivity tactics to address relevant issues with distressed customers in a professional manner, on an ongoing basis
    • Participate in team member’s meetings with clients and address all open issues no less often than monthly
    • Address technical issues and coordinate with IT team to seek resolutions as needed
    • Assign or assist with the Program Management Team’s onboarding of new clients as needed
    • Establish long term customer relationships through prompt and courteous service

Risk Management

  • Assist in Due Diligence of new program administration business, which includes onsite reviews and assessment, while providing Management an operational assessment of prospective partners
  • Assist in annual reviews of administrators to ensure compliance with company requirements, while identifying gaps in process and/or areas for potential improvement at both the administrator and company level
  • Monitor claims activity to identify any outliers, no less often than quarterly
  • Identify processing, system and/or operational issues within client or company operations in order to ensure claims are paid consistent with policy terms

Reporting/Trend Analysis

  • Prepare monthly reporting packages, including but not limited to, inventory reporting, first level (TPA customer service & turnaround) statistics, and referral analysis (turnaround times, volume breakdowns) for review by Senior Level Management
  • On a monthly basis, provide an analysis of all claims related litigation/regulatory inquiries to identify all trends and exposure
  • On no less than a quarterly basis, provide an analysis of all claims referrals logs to identify trends and recommendations for authority level adjustments as necessary

Legal/Regulatory

  • Refer to and assist as necessary, all small claims litigation to the Legal team
  • Review all attorney correspondences and coordinate responses with administrator
  • Assist Compliance in reviews of claims-related regulatory inquiries

Best Practices/Process Documentation

  • Draft initial documents for internal Claims Best Practices including:
    • Standards – both C&F and regulatory
    • Procedures
    • Workflow
  • Review and update above practices, on no less than a quarterly basis
  • Oversee the Program Management Teams review of TPA Best Practices, to ensure all Claims administrators are informed of and in adherence to applicable state unfair claims practices laws

Training & Development

  • Continue development of product knowledge on the Program Management Team
  • Assist in the development of Program Management Team to think bigger picture and outside the “claims audit box”
  • Utilize actual situations (i.e. distressed administrators) as an educational and development tool for Program Management Team members
  • Other duties as assigned

What YOU will bring to C&F:

  • Proven ability to establish strong rapport with customers and team members.
  • Demonstrated high level of service delivery, with a focus on customer satisfaction and issue resolution.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and implement process improvements.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly.
  • A commitment to personal accountability and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited university/institution or equivalent experience
  • 6+ years of relevant Special Risk, Travel, and Travel Medical experience
  • Strong PC skills including Excel, Word, Outlook, Power Point
  • Experience in specialty products such as Employer Stop Loss, Travel, Short Term Medical, Medical Travel, Workers Compensation and/or Occupational Accident is preferred
  • Ability to Travel (20%)

What C&F will bring to you

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Generous 401K employer match
  • Employee Stock Purchase plan with employer matching
  • Generous Paid Time Off
  • Excellent benefits that go beyond health, dental & vision. Our programs are focused on your whole family’s wellness, including your physical, mental and financial wellbeing
  • A core C&F tenet is owning your career development, so we provide a wealth of ways for you to keep learning, including tuition reimbursement, industry-related certifications and professional training to keep you progressing on your chosen path
  • A dynamic, ambitious, fun and exciting work environment
  • We believe you do well by doing good and want to encourage a spirit of social and community responsibility, matching donation program, volunteer opportunities, and an employee-driven corporate giving program that lets you participate and support your community

At C&F you will BELONG

If you require special accommodations, please let us know. We value inclusivity and diversity. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and welcome everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. If you require special accommodations, please let us know

For California Residents Only: Information collected and processed as part of your career profile and any job applications you choose to submit are subject to our privacy notices and policies, visit for more information.

Crum & Forster is committed to ensuring a workplace free from discriminatory pay disparities and complying with applicable pay equity laws. Salary ranges are available for all positions at this location, taking into account roles with a comparable level of responsibility and impact in the relevant labor market and these salary ranges are regularly reviewed and adjusted in accordance with prevailing market conditions. raw.title: Key Account Manager
raw.excerpt: About the Company Reebelo is a marketplace for refurbished tech devices and certified pre-owned lifestyle products.
raw.description:
About the Company

Reebelo is a marketplace for refurbished tech devices and certified pre-owned lifestyle products. We empower consumers to save up to 70% on their favorite brands while contributing to a sustainable future with every purchase. Our ambitious vision is to lead the circular economy, transforming how people think about consumption. Founded by European co-founders, today we are headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area with team members across the US, Canada, Australia, Singapore, Malaysia, the UK, France, Germany and Italy. Having raised over $65M and are profitable, join our VC-backed scaleup if you’re ready to be part of a dynamic, high-growth team dedicated to making a meaningful impact.

TheRole

We are looking for an Account Manager (Europe with DACH focus) to join our global team and own our vendor partnerships. In this role, you will be the day-to-day owner of the relationships with the sellers who list on Reebelo, responsible for onboarding new vendors, growing the sales of existing ones and making sure our customers always find a competitive, high-quality offer. This exciting role is one of our first European hires and reports directly to the Managing Director.

What you'll do:

Account management (around 70% of your time)

  • Own and grow a portfolio of German vendor accounts, with a sales plan and target for each.
  • Keep listings competitive and complete — pricing, assortment depth, stock availability and content quality — so our customers always find the best deal on their favorite brands.
  • Run regular business reviews with your vendors: performance against target, pricing opportunities, upcoming promotions and category gaps to fill.
  • Track vendor performance against our quality standards (defect and return rates, dispatch times, customer ratings) and run improvement plans where vendors fall short.
  • Be the voice of your vendors internally and the voice of Reebelo to your vendors: work with Product, Operations, Customer Service and Marketing to resolve issues quickly and to plan promotions and campaigns.
  • Help your strongest vendors list cross-border into our other European markets.

New vendor acquisition (around 30% of your time)

  • Build and work a pipeline of refurbishers, distributors, telcos and trade-in partners across who are not yet selling on Reebelo.
  • Prioritise the categories, brands and price points where our catalogue has gaps, and go after the vendors who fill them.
  • Pitch Reebelo, negotiate commercial terms and take each new vendor from first conversation to catalogue live and first sale.
  • Carry new vendors through their first 90 days so they become the accounts you grow next.

Across both

  • Report weekly on account performance, acquisition pipeline and market insights (pricing trends, competitor activity, category gaps) to EU leadership.
  • Travel occasionally within Europe to meet vendors and attend industry events.

What You'll Bring

  • Languages: fluent English required, German strongly preferred, French or Italian a plus.
  • At least 3 years' experience in account management, vendor or seller management, partnerships or B2B sales — ideally in e-commerce, a marketplace, consumer electronics or refurbished tech.
  • Commercial instinct: you understand pricing, margin and what makes a listing convert, and you can read a performance dashboard and turn it into actions with your vendors.
  • A natural relationship-builder who is equally comfortable prospecting new partners and growing existing accounts.
  • Experience with a CRM and seller or marketplace tools, and confident with Excel or Google Sheets.
  • Organised, self-reliant and a positive team player — you will work remotely with a lean team across time zones.

Bonus points

  • An existing network in the refurbished electronics, telco or consumer electronics distribution space.

Why You'll Love Working Here

  • Fully Remote: Work from Europe on a remote basis.
  • Compensation: Competitive salary, retirement benefit and performance bonus.
  • Real Ownership: You will own the vendor base end-to-end and see the impact of your work in the numbers every week.
  • Low-Meeting Culture: We prioritize focus time and async communication.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview with our People team [15 minutes]
  2. Interview with the hiring manager [45–60 minutes]
  3. Short commercial case study and final interview with our Managing Director and Chief Revenue Officer [45–60 minutes]
  4. References & Background Checks
  5. Offer 🎉

We know the job search can be both exciting and exhausting, so we strive to keep things simple, streamlined and respectful of your time — our interview process takes 2–3 weeks.

Work Rights

We are only able to consider applicants who hold full, independent working rights in Germany or the EU. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship or support work permit applications for this role.

Tidio is the customer service platform that aligns AI and people, so businesses can scale without losing trust or the human touch. Our goal is to help entrepreneurs grow by making customer service more efficient while keeping it helpful.

Working at Tidio means impacting thousands of companies and millions of their users. But our clients are not the only ones who can grow with us. By joining Tidio, you can grow, too!

A few facts about us:

  • Our product is one of the world's leading AI customer service solutions, and our goal is to become no. 1

  • We are among the Top 50 AI and Customer Service Products in G2’s Best Software Awards 2024.

  • We currently rate at 4.7/5 in both Shopify and G2.

  • Our ML team was among the first in the world to launch an AI agent - (Lyro) for customer service! 🌍

  • Every month, our widget is viewed by 350 million unique users, which is 4% of the global population.

  • Currently, we hire over 150 fantastic people.

As a Customer Success Manager at Tidio, you’ll step into a dynamic and impactful role within our close-knit, international team of 5. Imagine yourself as the trusted partner for our European B2B customers, empowering them to unlock the full potential of Tidio and transform their businesses. In this role, you won’t just be managing accounts; you’ll be cultivating long-term relationships, becoming an expert in our product, and guiding clients toward success in a way that truly makes a difference.

If you’re passionate about driving adoption, proactive in finding solutions, and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced SaaS environment, this is your opportunity to shine. At Tidio, we value innovation, empathy, and celebrating every win, big or small. Join us, and together, let’s create success stories that leave a lasting impact.

As the Customer Success Manager, you will:

  • Own ~80 European, SMB and mid-market accounts ($300–$3,000 MRR each) end-to-end, from onboarding through every renewal.

  • Be personally accountable for your book's Net Dollar Retention.

  • Lead QBRs, executive reviews, and strategic calls with decision-makers from a head of support at a growing DTC brand to a founder at a B2B SaaS.

  • Own Slack channels for your most important accounts and respond within SLA.

  • Identify expansion opportunities and close them yourself: price-anchoring, negotiating, and closing upsells without leaning on a sales rep.

  • Report on your book weekly: health, risks, actions, outcomes.

  • Surface strategic product and process feedback to our Product and Leadership teams, with specifics, not vibes.

  • Support the creation of outbound campaigns, emails, and enablement content that drive adoption and reactivation at scale across your book

Requirements

You are the perfect fit if you have:

  • 2+ years as a CSM in B2B SaaS, with a book you owned end-to-end.

  • A commercial mindset: you've measurably influenced retention, expansion, or churn in a previous role, and you can walk us through the numbers with specifics.

  • Technical curiosity to own the product yourself; you’d rather tinker and understand how something actually works than route the question to engineering or support.

  • English at C1 (Ukrainian is a plus).

  • Hands-on experience with a customer-success platform (Totango, Gainsight, ChurnZero, or equivalent), building your own automations and workflows.

  • A good understanding of industry-standard KPIs (churn rate, retention rate, net dollar retention).

  • Experience running QBRs and executive conversations with stakeholders up to VP level.

  • The ownership reflex. You take the uncomfortable call, bring the bad news, and close the loop without being asked.

Bonus cookie points for

  • Ability to leverage AI tools for automation and pipeline management

One thing worth naming. The CSMs who thrive at Tidio share a common instinct - high agency. They enjoy figuring things out on their own, go deep on our product rather than pass technical questions to engineering, and feel comfortable respectfully pushing back when a customer’s ask isn’t quite right. They think in outcomes rather than feature lists; they simplify the team’s workload rather than adding to it. That instinct matters to us more than polished relationship language, and if it sounds like the way you already work, we’d love to hear from you.

We would like to offer you:

  • Be part of a Polish-founded company operating globally at the forefront of AI-powered customer service — our ML team was among the first in the world to launch an AI agent (Lyro) for customer service.

  • An independent role with a strong impact on the company's growth.

  • Work in a small, flat structure, with real decision-making power and a shared passion for purpose-driven work.

  • Great development opportunities – company-supported courses and conferences.

  • Mental well-being program.

  • Free access to one of the most popular e-book/audiobook services.

What happens when you send your CV?

Diversity Statement

One of Tidio’s core values is to play fair. Therefore, we treat all candidates equally. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. raw.description:
About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Our Product Marketing team's mission is to generate customer insights that inform Stripe's product strategy, and lead go-to-market for our suite of products. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, Demand Generation and Campaigns to name a few. Different from many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle, from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption post-launch.

We are looking to hire a Product Marketing Manager to own end-to-end go-to-market strategy for Stripe Subscriptions to help businesses build, launch, and scale recurring revenue models.

What you'll do

As a Product Marketing Manager for Subscriptions, you will set the go-to-market strategy for our subscription management offerings, translating customer needs and market dynamics into positioning, launches, and programs that drive adoption and growth.

  • Set go-to-market strategy — Build and own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for subscription management offerings, defining target audiences, priority use cases, routes to market, and measures of success.
  • Champion the customer — Develop deep insight into the needs of businesses with recurring revenue models through customer research, market analysis, and close partnership with user-facing teams; translate those insights into product and commercial recommendations.
  • Shape positioning and messaging — Create clear, differentiated narratives that make complex billing and monetization capabilities accessible and compelling to businesses ranging from startups to global enterprises.
  • Lead product launches — Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Partnerships, and Demand Generation to bring new capabilities to market, coordinating launch plans and enabling teams to deliver a consistent customer experience.
  • Drive adoption and growth — Design and execute programs that increase awareness, activation, and sustained usage across priority customer segments, using data and experimentation to improve performance.
  • Enable customer-facing teams — Equip Sales and other user-facing teams with the insights, content, and tools they need to communicate value, navigate customer needs, and accelerate adoption.
  • Measure and optimize impact — Define goals and success metrics, synthesize qualitative and quantitative signals, and turn results into actionable recommendations for product and go-to-market teams.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply.

Minimum requirements

  • 7+ years of product marketing or growth marketing experience at a technology company, with a track record of independently owning end-to-end go-to-market strategy and execution.
  • Experience marketing complex B2B software, financial technology, billing, payments, or other products that require translating technical concepts into clear customer value.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop positioning and messaging, lead product launches, and drive adoption across multiple customer segments.
  • Strong customer orientation and analytical judgment, with experience combining research, market insight, and performance data to shape strategy and influence product decisions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create compelling narratives for executive, technical, sales, and customer audiences.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence and deliver results across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing teams.

About Us

At Netwrix, our mission is to revolutionize data security by placing identity at the core - providing unparalleled visibility and control. Engineered and supported by over 900 highly talented, motivated employees and hundreds of trusted partners in nearly every geography, Netwrix solutions are relied upon daily by security professionals across more than 13,500 organizations in over 100 countries around the world.

Over the past two decades, Netwrix has expanded its market presence through innovation, organic growth, and strategic acquisitions, and are proud to be backed by renowned private equity firms, TA Associates and Centerbridge Partners. Netwrix maintains a global presence, fostering a remote-first work environment while encouraging and facilitating frequent face-to-face interaction with colleagues, customers, and partners.

Position Overview

Due to continued accelerated growth, we are looking for a detail-oriented, creative and strategic Customer Success Manager to join our team. Working for Netwrix you will have an opportunity to make immediate business impacts while accelerating your personal career journey, surrounded by a positive and motivating team.

The Customer Success Manager is responsible for ensuring our customers' success and fostering long-lasting relationships. Your main objective will be to understand the unique needs and goals of our customers and proactively provide guidance and solutions to meet and exceed their expectations. You will be the driving force behind customer happiness, retention, and expansion.

Responsibilities

  • Customer Centric Focus: Put our customers at the heart of everything you do. Actively listen to their feedback, re-confirm their needs, and go above and beyond to deliver an exceptional customer experience.
  • Relationship Building: Cultivate strong relationships with key stakeholders throughout our Customer’s organization. Understand their business objectives and challenges to provide tailored solutions that will meet their desired outcomes
  • Onboarding and Adoption: Lead the onboarding process for new customers, act as the main point of contact for all things Netwrix, ensuring smooth adoption of our products throughout the Customer lifecycle.
  • Value Realization: Work closely with customers to define and measure key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics. Track and report on the achievement of desired outcomes to ensure customers realize the full value of our products and services.
  • Customer Health Monitoring: Continuously monitor customer health and engagement. Proactively identify areas of concern and implement strategies to ensure success.
  • Bi-Annual Health Check: Coordinate bi-annual health checks with our Customers and internal technical resources, ensure go forward plan aligns with strategic objectives, drive execution and ensure a regular communication cadence with the Customer.
  • Renewals and Expansion: Collaborate with the Account and Renewal Managers to drive contract renewals and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs.
  • Customer Advocacy: Be the voice of the customer within Netwrix. Advocate for customer needs, feedback, and feature requests to drive product improvements and enhancements.

Qualifications

  • Customer Centric: Demonstrated passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences and ensuring customer success.
  • Experience: 3 years of experience in a customer-facing role, such as Customer Success, Account Management, or similar in or adjacent to the CyberSecurity industry.
  • Outcome Measurement: Proficient in defining key performance indicators (KPIs) and success metrics for Customers, tracking their progress, and using data to measure and report on the achievement of desired outcomes.
  • Excellent Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Empathy and Patience: Empathetic listener with a patient and positive attitude. Able to empathize with customer challenges and provide support accordingly.
  • Problem-Solving Skills: Proven ability to analyze complex situations and provide creative solutions to meet customer needs.
  • Collaborative Team Player: Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to ensure customer success.
  • Tech-Savvy: Familiarity with information security is a plus.
  • Bachelor's Degree: A degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. • Tools: Salesforce.com and Microsoft Office Applications.
  • Most importantly, you are intellectually curious and eager to learn about everything (new technologies, industry best practices, Customer’s “whys”, etc.).

    • Our Values

    At Netwrix, our values guide every action:

    • Next-Level Customer Focus -Customers first, always. We listen, protect, and go the extra mile— because their success is our mission.
    • Excellence - We set high standards and take pride in delivering exceptional results. We celebrate wins, seek constant improvement, and address shortcomings professionally.
    • Transparent Ownership - We celebrate our successes, own up to our mistakes, communicate openly, and face challenges head-on with a genuine commitment to doing the right thing.
    • Winning with Clear Thinking - We value clarity, find straightforward solutions to complex problems, and make swift, effective decisions.
    • Relentless Innovation - We continually seek better ways to serve our customers and stay ahead. We foster creative thinking, and we embrace new approaches.
    • Industry-Leading Expertise - We take pride in our expertise and continuously seek to learn and share knowledge, striving to be the trusted experts our customers rely on.
    • eXceptional Together - We believe in the power of collaboration and diverse perspectives. By valuing each other’s strengths, we achieve outcomes that surpass individual contributions.

    Join us in a culture where integrity, respect, and hard work are foundational. Be part of a team dedicated to making a lasting impact.

    Why You’ll Love Working at Netwrix

    • Competitive Health Benefits
    • Continuous Learning and Development Opportunities
    • Team-Oriented, Collaborative, and Innovative Work Environment
    • Regular Company Town Halls to Keep You Informed
    • Opportunities for Career Growth and Advancement

    We pride ourselves on a culture that truly values employee input across various backgrounds and experiences. We look forward to welcoming new talent who can help us further our mission.

    Netwrix Corporation and its wholly owned subsidiaries are Equal Opportunity Employers (EEO) and welcome all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

What We Offer

Shape the future of healthcare analytics at Novant Health. As an Advanced Analytics Engineer Lead, you'll design and deliver high-quality, analytics-ready data products within Nucleus, our enterprise data warehouse, enabling data-driven decisions across the organization.

In this lead technical role, you'll lead the development of dimensional data models, curated data marts, and reusable data assets using Databricks Unity Catalog. You'll optimize solutions for Power BI and other analytics platforms, establish engineering best practices, and mentor fellow Analytics Engineers. You'll also ensure data products are secure, reliable, scalable, and trusted by the business.

Schedule: 8:00AM – 5:00PM Monday - Friday (On call support required as needed)

Location: Remote

Department:SPX Governance

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and delivery of enterprise data products, including facts, dimensions, aggregates, and data marts.
  • Build scalable, high-performing solutions in Databricks and Unity Catalog.
  • Optimize data models for Power BI and self-service analytics.
  • Establish reusable development standards and engineering best practices.
  • Mentor team members and provide technical leadership on complex initiatives.
  • Drive data quality, governance, security, documentation, and production reliability.

What You'll Do

Your work will transform complex data into actionable insights that improve patient care, operational performance, and strategic decision-making across Novant Health.


What We're Looking For

  • Education:
    • Bachelors Degree, required.
    • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or information systems required.
    • Graduate Degree, preferred. Master’s Degree Preferred master’s degree in computer science or information systems.
  • Experience:
    • 7 Required Minimum seven years of analytics engineering, data engineering, data warehousing, analytics development, and/or business intelligence experience.
  • Additional Skills (required):
    • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python, PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, and Databricks for large-scale data transformation and analytics engineering.
    • Advanced expertise in dimensional modeling, including facts, dimensions, conformed and role-playing dimensions, bridges, outriggers, aggregates, surrogate keys, slowly changing dimensions, and data grain.
    • Experience developing curated data marts and reusable analytics assets using medallion architecture patterns.
    • Experience building modular, maintainable, metadata-driven transformation code and reusable Nucleus framework components for batch and incremental processing.

    • Experience applying Databricks Unity Catalog, lineage, metadata, classification, auditing, and secure access patterns to governed data products.
    • Understanding of row-level filtering, column masking, least privilege, PHI/PII protection, and healthcare privacy and security requirements.
    • Ability to translate complex clinical, operational, and financial requirements into scalable models, transformation rules, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
    • Ability to lead root-cause analysis and resolve complex production, data-quality, performance, schema, and downstream-consumption issues.
    • Strong documentation, facilitation, mentoring, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Additional Skills (preferred):
    • Experience with Epic source data, including Clarity and Caboodle, and understanding of healthcare workflows and data domains.
    • Experience designing Nucleus data products that support enterprise and composite Power BI semantic models using DirectQuery.
    • Experience with Delta Live Tables, Delta Sharing, APIs, event or streaming technologies, and Azure Data Lake Storage.
    • Experience implementing data contracts, metadata-driven frameworks, observability, automated lineage, and data-quality scorecards.
    • Experience with healthcare interoperability formats and standards such as HL7, FHIR, CCDA, JSON, XML, and Parquet.
    • Working knowledge of Power BI semantic modeling, DAX behavior, query folding, model relationships, and DirectQuery performance
    • Experience with dbt or comparable analytics engineering transformation and testing frameworks.

At Novant Health, we believe remarkable care starts with compassion for our patients, our communities, and each other. We value belonging, courage, personal growth, and teamwork, creating a space where everyone is respected, supported, and safe to show up as their full selves.

This opportunity is designed for individuals with firsthand experience working within intelligence organizations, including professionals from intelligence operations, technology, strategy, policy, program management, and senior leadership functions.

You will apply your knowledge of how intelligence agencies operate, make decisions, manage programs, and support national security missions to help train and evaluate next-generation AI systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  3. Intelligence operations, analysis, collection, or mission support.
  4. Technology, IT systems, engineering, cybersecurity, or digital transformation.
  5. Program management, organizational operations, or administrative leadership.
  6. Intelligence policy, strategic planning, governance, or interagency coordination.

  8. Strong understanding of the organizational structures, professional practices, and operating environments of civilian intelligence agencies.

raw.excerpt: Company OverviewVoted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

We are seeking a Human-Centered Design (HCD) Engineer to bridge the gap between user needs and technical execution. You will lead qualitative research, map user journeys, build interactive prototypes, and run usability tests to ensure our products are intuitive, accessible, and impactful for the physicians, clinical staff, billers, front-desk teams, and patients who rely on them every day. In a clinical setting, a confusing screen costs a provider time, adds to burnout, and can affect patient safety, so this role carries real weight. You will thrive here if you love sitting with users in their actual workflows, can turn messy observations into clear direction, and can defend design decisions with evidence.

Key Responsibilities

User Research

  • Conduct contextual inquiries, interviews, field observations, and surveys with physicians, clinical staff, billers, and patients to uncover explicit and latent needs.
  • Partner with account managers and support teams to surface usability pain points from client feedback and support tickets.

Synthesis & Strategy

  • Translate research into personas, journey maps, service blueprints, and system workflows across clinical, operational, and billing processes.
  • Present insights to product and executive leadership to shape roadmap priorities.

Ideation & Prototyping

  • Facilitate cross-functional design workshops and build low- to high-fidelity wireframes and interactive prototypes in Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD.
  • Design AI-powered features (AI charting, AI agents) that keep clinicians in control and make AI output easy to review and correct.

Usability Testing

  • Plan, moderate, and analyze formative and summative usability tests to iterate on designs before and during development.
  • Evaluate safety-critical workflows such as medication management and e-prescribing, and support ONC Safety-Enhanced Design testing.

Collaboration & Governance

  • Partner with product managers, business analysts, and engineers in Agile/Scrum teams to maintain design integrity from concept through release.
  • Uphold accessibility standards (WCAG, Section 508) and HIPAA-safe research practices across all products.

Leadership

  • Build and scale WRS Health's HCD practice, including research operations, templates, and standards.
  • Mentor designers and researchers, and coach teammates on human-centered methods.

Qualifications

Required

  • Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Human-Centered Design, Human-Factors Engineering, Interaction Design, Cognitive Psychology, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3 to 6+ years of professional experience in HCD, UX design, or user research, including enterprise or regulated-industry experience.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in prototyping software (Figma, Sketch, or Adobe XD), qualitative research methodologies, usability testing frameworks, and Agile/Scrum delivery flows.
  • Accessibility: Working knowledge of Section 508 and WCAG standards and how to apply them in practice.
  • Core Competencies: Strong empathy, verbal storytelling, analytical problem-solving, and the ability to defend design decisions with data.
  • A portfolio or case studies demonstrating end-to-end research, synthesis, prototyping, and measurable impact.

Preferred

  • Experience designing for EHR, practice management, revenue cycle, telehealth, or other health IT products.
  • Familiarity with clinical workflows and terminology across ambulatory specialties.
  • Knowledge of ONC Safety-Enhanced Design (user-centered design and summative testing) requirements, NISTIR 7804, or ISO 9241-210.
  • Experience designing AI-assisted or automation features, including human-in-the-loop review patterns.
  • Prior experience leading or mentoring designers/researchers, or building a design function from the ground up.
  • Experience with remote research and unmoderated testing tools and product analytics platforms.
  • Clinical background or prior work in a medical practice setting.

A Day in the Life

Your days move between the field, the whiteboard, and the prototype. You might start by joining the product team's stand-up to flag a research insight affecting an upcoming sprint, then sit in (virtually or on-site) with a specialty practice to watch how the front desk, medical assistants, and physicians actually work, noting the workarounds they've built and where the screens slow them down. Later, you could be synthesizing those observations into an updated journey map, facilitating a workshop with product managers, engineers, and billing specialists to sketch solutions, or moderating a usability test of a new AI charting feature to see how a clinician reviews and trusts AI-drafted notes. Before the day ends, you refine prototypes in Figma based on what you learned, check designs against accessibility standards, share prioritized recommendations with product leadership, and make time to coach the designers and researchers on your team.

Success Metrics

  • Measurable usability gains: Improved task success rates, time-on-task, error rates, and System Usability Scale (SUS) scores for redesigned workflows, including fewer clicks and less documentation time for key clinical tasks.
  • Research-driven roadmap: Consistent monthly contact with users across specialties, with a clear, visible share of roadmap items originating from or validated by HCD research.
  • Fewer usability issues post-release: Decline in usability-related support tickets, rework, and post-launch design defects.
  • Accessibility and certification compliance: New and updated features meet WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards at release, and ONC Safety-Enhanced Design documentation is completed on time.
  • Adoption and satisfaction: Higher feature adoption (including AI features) and improved client satisfaction or NPS for redesigned areas.

Job Details

  • Job Type: Full-time | Independent Contractor
  • Location: Remote
  • Hours: Must be available during standard US business hours (9:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST or 8:30 AM – 4:30 PM EST)

Compensation will be based on location, experience, and qualifications.

This job description outlines the general responsibilities of the role and is not exhaustive. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business operations.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

Overview

DecisionPoint seeks four Senior Full-Stack Software Developers to design, implement, test, secure, and modernize mission-critical software capabilities for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. These roles develop complex features across front-end and back-end application layers, build and integrate APIs, correct security findings, perform code reviews, and support reliable software releases.

The Senior Full-Stack Software Developers work with architects, mission liaisons, requirements analysts, UI/UX specialists, testers, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, and Government stakeholders. They also mentor other developers and cross-train across critical components to improve delivery continuity and reduce key-person dependencies.

These positions are remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Full-Stack Software Developers will:

  • Design, develop, test, integrate, document, deploy, and maintain mission-critical software capabilities.
  • Implement complex features and modernization enhancements across front-end, application, service, API, and data-access layers.
  • Translate approved requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, interface requirements, and design specifications into secure software solutions.
  • Develop intuitive and accessible web interfaces in coordination with UI/UX and accessibility specialists.
  • Design, implement, document, and maintain secure application programming interfaces and service integrations.
  • Develop reusable components, shared services, libraries, and software patterns.
  • Support application modernization, refactoring, technical-debt reduction, and replacement of obsolete components.
  • Evaluate existing code and recommend improvements to reliability, maintainability, scalability, security, and performance.
  • Implement approved security fixes and coordinate remediation with cybersecurity, testing, and platform teams.
  • Apply secure coding practices throughout design, development, testing, integration, and deployment.
  • Develop and maintain unit tests, integration tests, regression tests, and other automated quality checks.
  • Participate in peer reviews, code reviews, design reviews, and architecture discussions.
  • Review source code for correctness, security, performance, testability, maintainability, and compliance with established development standards.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex defects, integration failures, performance issues, and production-support concerns.
  • Support root-cause analysis and implement durable corrective actions.
  • Use approved version-control practices, including branching, merging, pull requests, tagging, and release management.
  • Support continuous integration and continuous delivery pipelines, automated builds, testing, and deployment activities.
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, API documentation, build instructions, installation procedures, and release artifacts.
  • Support sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, demonstrations, reviews, retrospectives, and release-readiness activities.
  • Provide accurate estimates and identify technical risks, dependencies, assumptions, and implementation constraints.
  • Coordinate work with architecture, infrastructure, cloud, database, cybersecurity, testing, training, and operations teams.
  • Mentor junior and journeyman developers through technical guidance, code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing.
  • Cross-train on critical application components and provide coverage during absences, incidents, releases, and priority remediation activities.
  • Support Government demonstrations, user acceptance testing, operational validation, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Protect sensitive data and comply with applicable federal, DoD, security, privacy, and configuration-management requirements.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of software-engineering, testing, documentation, and delivery practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess all the following:

  • An active Secret clearance or higher.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • At least eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience developing, integrating, testing, and maintaining software applications.
  • Experience working across both front-end and back-end application layers.
  • Experience designing, developing, integrating, or consuming application programming interfaces.
  • Experience developing and maintaining unit tests.
  • Experience applying secure coding principles and correcting software security issues.
  • Experience using version-control systems and structured source-code management practices.
  • Ability to implement complex software features and modernization enhancements.
  • Ability to review source code and provide actionable technical feedback.
  • Ability to diagnose and resolve complex software, integration, performance, or security problems.
  • Ability to mentor developers and cross-train across critical application components.
  • Ability to collaborate with architects, analysts, designers, testers, cybersecurity personnel, platform engineers, and Government stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, and communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • A relevant software-development or cloud certification from AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, Oracle, Red Hat, or another recognized provider.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense software-development or modernization programs.
  • Experience developing mission-critical, regulated, security-sensitive, or high-availability systems.
  • Experience with modern JavaScript or TypeScript frameworks and component-based front-end development.
  • Experience with Java, C#, .NET, Python, Node.js, or comparable server-side technologies.
  • Experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs, web services, asynchronous integrations, or event-driven services.
  • Experience with relational databases, data modeling, structured query languages, or object-relational mapping technologies.
  • Experience with cloud-native application development and services hosted in AWS, Azure, or another approved cloud environment.
  • Experience with containers, microservices, infrastructure automation, or modern application-platform technologies.
  • Experience with automated testing frameworks, static-code analysis, dependency scanning, or software-composition analysis.
  • Experience with continuous integration and continuous delivery tools and DevSecOps practices.
  • Experience with Agile software delivery and tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, GitHub, GitLab, or comparable platforms.
  • Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility requirements and accessible web-development practices.
  • Familiarity with DoD security requirements, DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides, configuration management, and software-release controls.

Position Summary:

Serves as the clinical trial lead responsible for the planning, conduct and oversight of the operational portion of clinical studies per defined scope of work and ensures that clinical studies are conducted in accordance with the protocol, standard operating procedures (SOPs), ICH-GCP and all applicable regulatory requirements.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Primary clinical point of contact with the client
  • Collaborate with PM on monthly invoicing and variance management of clinical budget
  • Develop study related clinical documents (e.g. clinical plans, Informed Consent Form templates, study specific forms and manuals, CRF completion guidelines, study trackers, PSV/SIV slides and other training materials)
  • Identify and develop training needs for CRAs and third-party vendors specific to the study, protocol and practices including presenting these at Investigator Meetings and Study Kick-off meetings
  • Generate potential site list from key stakeholders and drive site feasibility process
  • Identify potential risks to the enrollment targets based on feasibility analysis and site’s contracted commitment
  • Develop and finalize the country recruitment/retention strategy
  • Develop timely and effective communication and good working relationships with investigators and study team to ensure effective and timely feasibility, site start up, enrollment, maintenance and close out procedures
  • Lead internal clinical team meetings and sets expectations for clinical team of CRAs and CTAs
  • Address all CRA and site questions and maintains Frequently Asked Question (FAQ) log as appropriate
  • Support in planning and conducting investigator meetings
  • Review and/or approve of IP release packages
  • Oversee, support and track all submissions and approvals to Competent Authorities and IRB/Ethics Committees in conjunction with regulatory departments as applicable
  • Develop clinical monitoring strategies for assuring study timelines are met and assuring quality deliverables
  • Generate and utilizes metric reporting (e.g., CTMS, DM Query Trends, Outstanding Monitoring Reports) to ensure that the study is conducted per plan and communicates issues to PM and CRAs as appropriate
  • Responsible for eTMF implementation and management
  • Collaborate with PM, CRAs and QA to develop any Corrective and Preventative Action Plan (CAPA) and is accountable for implementation and timely closure
  • Accountable to assist sites, internal staff and CRAs with the preparation for GCP audits
  • Work closely with PM for project-specific resourcing issues
  • Escalate pertinent CRA performance and site compliance issues when necessary
  • Collaborate with data management and CRAs to ensure data quality and compliance with data cleaning timelines
  • Manage processes for investigational product (IP) including drug accountability and reconciliation
  • When a cross-functional PM is not assigned to a given program, the CTM will assume project management responsibility as needed
  • Support business development and marketing activities as appropriate
  • May negotiate site budget and investigator contract with support from the legal department and/or site contracts group
  • May review site visit reports and ensures monitoring (i.e. scheduling and scope) is executed per monitoring plan
  • May be responsible for management of clinical vendors (e.g. labs, IP, patient diary, home health care) in conjunction with PM
  • May perform clinical data review of patient profiles, data listings and summary tables, including query generation
  • May have line management responsibilities
  • Performs other duties as assigned by management
