Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education/experience in science or health-related field. Advanced degree preferred
  • Minimum of 7 years of clinical research experience or proven competencies for the position with significant clinical monitoring experience

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree
  • Experience with Radiopharmaceuticals and/or CAR-T studies

Other Required:

  • Experience with Microsoft Office Products (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively interface with others in a team setting
  • Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer service demeanor
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally including overnight stays

Competencies:

  • Demonstrates mastery knowledge of ICH-GCP, relevant Precision SOPs, and regulatory guidance, as well as the ability to implement
  • Working knowledge of clinical management techniques and tools
  • Direct work experience in a cross-functional environment
  • Proven experience in functional management including proven experience in delegating while fostering cohesive team dynamics
  • Proven experience in planning, risk management and change management
  • High level of integrity and must inspire and demand the highest standards from a professional and ethical perspective
  • Ability to lead and inspire excellence within a team
  • Ability to create an environment where employees have a sense of ownership that will lead to increases in productivity and efficiency
  • Results oriented, accountable, motivated and flexible
  • Excellent time management, negotiation, critical thinking, decision making, analytical and interpersonal skills
  • Excellent presentation, verbal and written communications skills
  • In depth proven experience in pharmaceutical and/or device research required
  • Demonstrated successful independent negotiation and conflict management strategies

Title:

GxP Compliance Manager

Job Description:

Now Hiring: GxP Compliance Manager

Salary: $90,000-$100,000

Travel up to 25%

Job Overview

The GxP Compliance Manager is responsible for overseeing cleanroom cleaning operations, contamination control programs, and regulatory compliance within GxP cleanrooms, laboratories, and other controlled environments. This role ensures that all cleaning and disinfection activities are performed in accordance with current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), approved Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), validated cleaning methods, and applicable regulatory and safety requirements.


In addition to technical and compliance oversight, the GMP Compliance Manager is accountable for overall account performance, including, labor productivity, staffing, client satisfaction, contract compliance, and continuous operational improvement. The successful candidate will develop strong client partnerships, lead and develop site teams, maintain inspection-ready documentation, and ensure the consistent delivery of high-quality, compliant services within regulated life sciences environments.


Roles & Responsibilities

To perform this job successfully and safely, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Other duties may be assigned.


GMP Compliance & Contamination Control

  • Oversee contamination control and environmental cleaning programs within cleanrooms, laboratories, and controlled environments.
  • Ensure cleaning and disinfection activities are conducted using approved, validated methods in accordance with cGMP requirements, applicable standards, and site-specific procedures.
  • Maintain accurate, complete, and audit-ready documentation, including cleaning logs, checklists, controlled records, and compliance reports.
  • Develop, implement, review, and maintain SOPs, work instructions, and cleaning documentation to ensure consistent execution and regulatory compliance.
  • Monitor adherence to contamination control protocols, cleaning validation requirements, and established quality standards.
  • Support internal audits, client inspections, regulatory assessments, and corrective and preventive action (CAPA) activities as required.
  • Identify compliance gaps, investigate deviations, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence and strengthen operational performance.
  • Ensure employees receive appropriate training and demonstrate competency in GMP procedures, cleanroom protocols, chemical handling, and applicable OSHA safety requirements.

Financial & Business Performance

  • Evaluate staffing models, labor utilization, and operational productivity to ensure resources align with contractual obligations and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, optimize labor deployment, and strengthen overall account performance.

Client Relationship & Contract Management

  • Build and maintain strong client relationships to support customer satisfaction, service excellence, and long-term account retention.
  • Maintain an active client stewardship program, engaging stakeholders at multiple organizational levels to review performance, address concerns, and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor contract requirements and ensure service delivery meets or exceeds established contractual commitments, performance standards, and client expectations.
  • Communicate program capabilities, service alternatives, and available corporate resources to address evolving client needs.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to customize service delivery models and develop solutions that meet unique operational and compliance requirements.
  • Proactively identify service concerns, resolve escalated issues, and implement sustainable action plans to protect client relationships and support account growth.

Leadership & Operational Excellence

  • Lead, develop, and hold site personnel accountable for performance, productivity, safety, and compliance.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and quality service delivery.
  • Ensure staffing levels, employee qualifications, training, and scheduling support operational requirements and contractual commitments.
  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), identify performance trends, and implement improvement initiatives to strengthen service quality and efficiency.
  • Partner with clients, corporate leadership, quality teams, and operational support functions to resolve challenges and achieve business objectives.
  • Demonstrate initiative, sound judgment, adaptability, and effective decision-making in a highly regulated and changing environment.

Qualification

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required to perform this job safely. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice.


Education and/or Experience

Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

Demonstrated experience managing cleanroom cleaning, contamination control, environmental services, or related operations within regulated facilities.

Experience managing client accounts, service contracts, and customer relationships in a highly regulated environment.


Certificates, Licenses, Registrations

A valid driver's license may be required for this position based on business needs. Employees required to drive as part of their job duties must maintain an acceptable Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) and meet company driving eligibility requirements.


Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

Working knowledge of cGMP requirements, cleanroom protocols, contamination control practices, SOP management, and audit-ready documentation.

Proven ability to lead teams, manage staffing and productivity, and drive operational improvements.

Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present operational and financial results to clients and senior leadership.

Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to prioritize competing demands and manage multiple responsibilities.

Demonstrated leadership, initiative, flexibility, accountability, and professionalism.

Working knowledge of contract administration, performance management, and standard business procedures.


Supervisory Responsibilities

Carries out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, planning, assigning, and directing work; performance evaluations; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems. Ensure employees are properly trained on tasks and safety requirements.

Cargobase is entering its next phase of growth, scaling its product ecosystem, modernizing platform architecture, and expanding its global customer base. As customer complexity and commercial ambition increase, execution quality and customer outcomes become business-critical.

Role Overview

The Senior Customer Excellence Manager owns the full post-sales customer lifecycle, with accountability for onboarding, implementation, platform support, ongoing success, and commercial expansion within existing accounts. This role leads a global team of generalist Customer Excellence Consultants and is responsible not only for delivery quality and customer outcomes, but also for retention, expansion readiness, and revenue protection post-sale.

The role operates at the intersection of delivery, customer value realization, and commercial outcomes, ensuring customers adopt broadly, expand intentionally, and remain long-term strategic accounts.

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a global team of Customer Excellence Consultants across all levels.
  • Define clear expectations for consultants across delivery excellence, customer ownership, and commercial awareness.
  • Build career paths, conduct performance reviews, and promote a culture of accountability and collaboration.

Implementation Ownership

  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Sales to address blockers, ensure customer readiness, and meet go-live commitments.

Customer Experience Management

  • Ensure a seamless and unified post-sales experience covering onboarding, support, and success
  • Establish team workflows to deliver timely support responses, effective issue resolution, and proactive account engagement.
  • Develop structured customer touchpoints and lifecycle strategies that scale across regions and customer types.
  • Track and optimize customer health metrics (e.g., NPS, CES, adoption rates, time-to-resolution).
  • Ensure Customer Excellence acts as the primary signal source for churn risk, upsell timing, and account growth opportunities.

Commercial Expansion & Revenue Impact

  • Partner with Sales to support account expansion, renewals, and commercial growth within existing customers.
  • Ensure Customer Excellence identifies, qualifies, and documents expansion opportunities (additional lanes, volumes, modules, regions).
  • Establish clear ownership boundaries and handoff models between Customer Excellence and Sales for upsell execution.
  • Drive expansion readiness by ensuring customers are operationally stable, adopted, and value-aligned before commercial discussions.
  • Track and report post-sales commercial metrics, including retention, expansion contribution, and at-risk revenue.

Process & Operational Excellence

  • Implement systems, SLAs, and metrics to manage workload, track performance, and improve response quality.
  • Support rollout and usage of internal tools, knowledge base, ticketing, and self-service resources.

Internal & Cross-Functional Collaboration

raw.title: Staff Software Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the design and delivery of a new, cloud-native platform.
raw.description:
We are seeking a Staff Software Engineer to provide technical leadership for the design and delivery of a new, cloud-native platform. This engineer will work across teams to translate business capabilities and architectural direction into scalable, maintainable software while helping establish the engineering practices and technical foundations needed to support the platform long term.

The Staff Software Engineer will operate as a hands-on technical leader, partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Architecture, and external delivery partners. This role requires someone who can move comfortably between architecture and implementation, make pragmatic technical decisions, identify risks early, and help multiple engineering teams deliver effectively without sacrificing long-term system quality.

Key responsibilities include:

• Provide hands-on technical leadership across the design, development, testing, deployment, and operation of platform capabilities.
• Partner with Architecture, Engineering, and Product to translate business capabilities and architectural direction into pragmatic, executable technical designs.
• Make and influence technical decisions involving application architecture, integration patterns, APIs, data flows, reliability, scalability, security, and maintainability.
• Lead technical design discussions and help teams evaluate tradeoffs rather than defaulting to a single solution or technology.
• Develop production-quality software while remaining close enough to implementation to understand the realities facing engineering teams.
• Establish and reinforce engineering standards and practices across software design, code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, reliability, and production readiness.
• Identify architectural, technical, integration, and delivery risks early and drive them toward resolution.
• Work across multiple engineering teams to maintain technical consistency while allowing teams appropriate autonomy in implementation.
• Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, raise the technical capability of the broader organization, and help develop future technical leaders.
• Create clear technical artifacts, including design documents, architecture decision records, technical plans, and other documentation needed to make important decisions durable and understandable.
• Partner with engineering leadership to improve technical planning, decomposition, dependency management, and delivery predictability.
• Help establish sustainable engineering practices that enable teams to deliver quickly without creating unnecessary operational or technical debt.
• Participate in production support and continuously improve the reliability, observability, and operability of the platform.

Working across a blended delivery organization:
• Provide technical leadership across a blended engineering model consisting of FTEs, contractors, and onshore/offshore vendor teams.
• Work directly with vendor technical leads and engineers to ensure solutions align with established architecture, engineering standards, and long-term platform direction.
• Review and challenge vendor-proposed designs and technical approaches when appropriate, using engineering evidence, tradeoffs, and platform needs to drive decisions.
• Help ensure critical technical knowledge, architectural decisions, and engineering ownership remain within the organization rather than becoming dependent on individual vendors or delivery partners.
• Support onboarding and technical integration of new engineering teams as the organization scales, creating patterns and practices that can be reused across teams.

The ideal candidate combines deep software engineering expertise with strong technical leadership and systems thinking. They should be comfortable working in a complex distributed environment, influencing technical direction across organizational boundaries, challenging assumptions constructively, and turning ambiguous problems into clear technical approaches.

They should be equally comfortable designing a system, writing production code, reviewing another team's architecture, mentoring engineers, and explaining technical tradeoffs to engineering and non-engineering partners. Success in this role is not measured solely by individual code contribution, but by the engineer's ability to improve the technical quality, decision-making, and effectiveness of the broader engineering organization.

B. EXTERNAL ENGAGEMENT, ADVOCACY & CHILD PARTICIPATION

  • Support with child participation initiatives in close coordination with field offices’ child participation focal points and children’s councils.
  • Support with the establishment of sustainable child and youth participation mechanisms at field and regional level.
  • Support with the conceptualisation and implementation of external engagement events at regional level.

C. COMMUNICATIONS & SOCIAL MEDIA

  • Support with communications and social media content production and design.
  • Support with updating RO website pages in WVI.
  • Support with reviewing and publishing FO content in WVI.
  • Supporting with uploading regional content in storyhub and answering any content requests.
  • Support with social media posting and monitoring.
  • Support with communications dashboard and hootsuite roll out at regional level and in close collaboration with GC and RO.

  • Lead on liaising with external designers for the design of external products such as reports and capacity statements.

  • Support the team with exploring how the usage of AI tools could facilitate and enhance communications and social media content development

D. TECHNICAL SUPPORT FOR FIELD OFFICES

  • Provide technical communications and social media support to field offices when needs arise.
  • Provide technical advocacy and child participation support to field offices when needs arise.

F. GENERAL

KNOWLEDGE, SKILL AND EXPERIENCE

Required Education, training, license, registration, and/or Certification

Required Professional Experience

  • Minimum five (5) years of relevant professional experience in communications, advocacy, media relations, public affairs, or external engagement within the humanitarian, development, or non-profit sector.
  • Experience developing and implementing communications and advocacy initiatives at national, regional, or international level.
  • Experience working with multiple stakeholders, including media representatives, civil society organizations, government actors, donors, and community representatives.
  • Experience providing communications and/or advocacy support to field teams and/or local partners.

Required Language(s)

  • Fluency in written and spoken English.
  • Knowledge of any other language relevant to the Middle East and Eastern Europe Region (MEER) is an asset.

Position’s physical requirements

Must be in good physical health


Preferred Experience, Knowledge and/or other Qualifications

  • Strong communications content development skills, including photography, videography, graphic design, storytelling, and multimedia content production.
  • Experience in social media management, monitoring, audience engagement, and digital communications.
  • Excellent report writing, editing, proofreading, and report design skills.

Develop a Specialized Clinical Skill Set — Gain hands-on experience treating gambling, gaming, and other behavioral addictions while building expertise in one of behavioral health's fastest-growing specialties

Receive Clinical Training & Mentorship — We provide ongoing education, clinical consultation, and support pursuing the International Certified Gambling Counselor (ICGC-I) credential through mentorship from a nationally recognized, Ph.D.-trained, ICGC-II-certified gambling addiction clinician

What We Provide:

  • ICGC-I certification support
  • Ongoing training and professional development
  • Clinical consultation and peer support
  • Insurance credentialing support
  • Assistance with and funding for additional state licensure
  • Administrative and billing support
  • Flexible scheduling and remote work
  • W-2 employment
  • 401(k) with employer match

Who We're Looking For:

  • Active clinical licensure in the state of West Virginia: LPC, LPCC, LCSW, LMFT, or equivalent license
  • Interest in gambling disorder, gaming disorder, and other behavioral challenges

  • Commitment to evidence-based, client-centered care
  • Interest in collaborating with a team that’s driving innovation in teletherapy

Join Our Mission:

At Kindbridge, you'll have the opportunity to expand your expertise into a highly specialized area of behavioral health while helping individuals and families affected by gambling, gaming, and related behavioral challenges.

If you're looking for meaningful clinical work, ongoing mentorship, and the opportunity to become a leader in an emerging field, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

At H&R Block, we are committed to providing exceptional service and support to our clients. As a Client Services Representative, you will play a crucial role in resolving both internal and external client concerns on behalf of our District Managers. Your responsibilities will include conducting thorough research, performing detailed analysis, and making independent decisions to ensure client satisfaction.

You will leverage multiple software applications to manage and resolve escalated complaint cases efficiently. Additionally, you will act as a liaison, contacting H&R Block Field Leadership and other related business units to facilitate effective communication and resolution for our clients.

Your ability to navigate complex situations with professionalism and empathy will be essential in maintaining the trust and confidence of our clients. Join us in our mission to provide outstanding service and support and help us make a positive impact on the lives of those we serve.

 

Day to day, you'll... 

  • Provide escalation support to assist both internal and external clients using multiple communication methods, including phone, e-mail, mail, and chat
  • Monitor multiple regional areas for incoming client issues and inquiries
  • Respond to all incoming client issues and inquiries within the department’s service level agreement (SLA)

Work Experience:

  • Awareness of H&R Block brand and values
  • Crisis management abilities and technical proficiency
  • Emotional intelligence, problem-solving skills, and adaptability
  • General knowledge of computer navigation and troubleshooting issues with software and/or networking connectivity problems, including prior experience with Microsoft Office tools

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.

raw.description:
Are you passionate about improving the quality of healthcare?
Are you ready to leverage your talents to make healthcare better for everyone?
Do you want the opportunity to give back to your community?
Do you want to have fun at work?
Then join the growing team at Health Services Advisory Group (HSAG) that is transforming the delivery of healthcare in the United States!

Summary

HSAG is nationally recognized as an industry leader in healthcare data analysis, measure development, and survey research. We are seeking a Business Intelligence (BI) Developer II with hands-on Amazon QuickSight expertise to design and deliver dashboards supporting HSAG’s Quality Improvement Organization (QIO) contract within the secure Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) environment. Familiarity with Tableau is also desired to support other HSAG visual analytics work.

The BI Developer II position benefits from HSAG’s commitment to developing future leaders in healthcare data science and quality improvement. Under the direction of the Business Intelligence Architect and other senior DSAA leaders, this position collaborates directly with analysts, data scientists, project leaders, and QIO staff. The role’s primary focus is creating, enhancing, and supporting QIO dashboards in Amazon QuickSight, with opportunities to use Tableau for other visual analytics initiatives.

Description

The BI Developer II is a key contributor to federal analytic work supporting HSAG’s Quality Improvement Organization (QIO) contract. The primary responsibility of this role is to create, enhance, validate, document, and maintain dashboards in Amazon QuickSight within the secure CMS data environment. The successful candidate must be able to translate business and contract requirements into clear, accurate, and actionable dashboard experiences for QIO stakeholders.

Data incorporated into these dashboards may include, but are not limited to:

  • medical and prescription drug claims
  • skilled nursing facility (SNF) home minimum data set (MDS) data
  • case review
  • facility self-reported
  • demographics
  • QIO operational data
  • publicly reported data (e.g., Care Compare)
  • survey and certification data

Essential Competencies, Duties and Responsibilities

  • Serve as an integral member of HSAG’s Data Science & Advanced Analytics division.
  • Work with HSAG staff, CMS stakeholders, and other customers to elicit, document, and refine dashboard requirements.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, document, and maintain Amazon QuickSight analyses, datasets, reports, and multi-level dashboards in the CMS environment.
  • Develop efficient, intuitive QuickSight dashboard navigation, drill-downs, filters, parameters, calculations, and role-appropriate views.
  • Apply data validation and quality-control procedures to confirm that dashboard measures, calculations, labels, and visualizations accurately reflect approved specifications.
  • Maintain dashboard version documentation and support controlled promotion of dashboard changes in accordance with CMS and HSAG processes.
  • Create and maintain Tableau dashboards or visualizations for other assigned HSAG work, as needed.
  • Design and implement proof-of-concept solutions and advanced BI visualizations, applying effective data visualization and dashboard usability practices.
  • Use approved data sources and reporting tools to validate dashboard measures, investigate data issues, and support ad hoc analysis.
  • Design, develop, and automate end-to-end ETL solutions using dynamic SQL to perform file validation, manage staging-to-production pipelines, and prepare large-scale datasets for QuickSight dashboards and other BI solutions.
  • Architect and implement complex business rules within the SQL environment to ensure data transformations meet rigorous contract and project specifications.
  • Lead data quality management by developing SQL-based validation frameworks and implementing automated corrective actions to resolve data anomalies.
  • Author and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including dashboard documentation, data definitions, data mapping, ETL workflow diagrams, user guidance, presentations, and related project materials that help ensure data are secure, accurate, and accessible.
  • Provide advanced technical support and troubleshooting to HSAG staff, stakeholders, providers, and contractors regarding QuickSight dashboards, data, access, and functionality, as well as data gathering, database design, and dissemination activities.
  • Oversee the technical User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process to validate that data loads, dashboards, and system outputs meet customer and budget requirements; document findings, resolve defects, and support production readiness for dashboards.
  • Manage the full dashboard and data project lifecycle, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality products that align with project schedules, QIO contract requirements, security expectations, and milestones.
  • Collaborate with other HSAG departments to troubleshoot project activities and provide data support services for complex customer research issues.
  • Stay current on emerging QuickSight capabilities, database structures, ETL technologies, and analytic methodologies, communicating relevant advancements to the team to improve internal data infrastructure.
  • Communicate complex technical and analytic topics clearly through written documentation, demonstrations, and oral presentations.

Education and/or Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer information systems, or a quantitative discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and maintaining visualization solutions in Amazon QuickSight is required. Candidates must demonstrate practical QuickSight expertise, including experience creating analyses, dashboards, calculated fields, filters, parameters, and interactive visualizations.
  • Familiarity with Tableau dashboard development is required to support additional HSAG visual analytics work; hands-on Tableau development experience is preferred.
  • At least three (3) years of experience with ETL processes in a Microsoft SQL Server environment is required.
  • At least three (3) years of data warehousing experience is required.
  • Experience gathering and refining requirements and interviewing business users to understand and document data requirements is required.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience documenting business and technical requirements based on user interviews are required.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, SSIS, SSAS, Power BI, and Databricks is preferred.

Other Qualifications

  • Experience working with healthcare data, Medicare data, claims data, quality improvement data, or other regulated data is strongly preferred.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word and Excel.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to handle several projects simultaneously and work with multiple teams.

CMS Access and Security Requirements

This position requires access to CMS data systems and secure computing environments. As a condition of performing assigned QIO work, the selected candidate must successfully complete all required CMS vetting, identity verification, background investigation, security, privacy, and access-authorization processes applicable to the role.

The employee must maintain eligibility for CMS system access, complete required security and privacy training, comply with CMS and HSAG policies for handling sensitive information, and promptly provide documentation or information needed to establish and retain access.

Employment in the role and assignment of CMS-related duties are contingent upon obtaining and maintaining the required CMS approvals and system access. Inability to obtain or retain required access may affect the individual’s ability to perform the essential functions of the position.

Work Environment

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Disclaimer

This is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts or working conditions associated with the position. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current position, management reserves the right to revise the position or to require that other or different tasks be performed when circumstances change (e.g., emergencies, changes in personnel, work load, rush jobs requiring non-regular work hours, or technological developments).
HSAG is an EEO Employer of Veterans protected under Section 4212.
If you have special needs and require assistance completing our employment application process, please feel free to contact us.

Executive Assistant & Operations Partner

Remote | Full-time | 40-hours/week
Rate: $6 to $7/hour, with the final rate to be determined during the final interview.

About the Role

We are looking for an Operations Lead who can build, run, and continuously improve the operational engine behind Pillar Health Solutions.

This is a highly hands-on role for someone who is comfortable working in a growing healthcare business where processes are still evolving.

You will work closely with leadership and take ownership of the workflows connecting physician partners, practice staff, patients, dietitians, exercise professionals, and internal support teams.

You may be investigating why patients are not scheduling, improving a referral workflow, resolving a practice issue, reviewing operational data, building a new process, creating an SOP, coordinating provider capacity, or implementing automation to eliminate repetitive work.

We are looking for someone who does not simply identify problems. You should be able to determine why they are happening, create a practical solution, implement it, and measure whether the solution worked.

What You Will Do

1. Executive Support & Project Management

  • Work closely with leadership to organize priorities, coordinate projects, manage follow-ups, and ensure important tasks and deadlines are completed.

  • Turn leadership discussions, ideas, and decisions into clear action plans, while coordinating with stakeholders and tracking progress.

  • Prepare meeting summaries, presentations, reports, and other business materials to support leadership and decision-making.

2. Business Operations & Process Improvement

  • Coordinate daily operational activities involving physician practices, patients, healthcare providers, and internal teams, ensuring smooth communication and timely resolution of concerns.

  • Support practice onboarding, patient scheduling, provider coordination, documentation, and other healthcare administrative workflows.

  • Identify operational inefficiencies, resolve recurring issues, and create or improve SOPs, checklists, templates, and standardized processes.

3. Reporting, Technology & AI Automation

  • Maintain spreadsheets, dashboards, trackers, and performance reports to monitor operational activities, business priorities, and key performance indicators.

  • Analyze operational data, identify trends or potential issues, and provide leadership with actionable insights and recommendations.

  • Leverage AI tools, automation, and digital platforms to streamline repetitive tasks, improve reporting, and increase overall business efficiency.

What We Are Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in operations, program management and client success

  • Experience owning processes and outcomes rather than only completing assigned administrative tasks.

  • Strong understanding of patient scheduling, provider coordination, documentation, healthcare administrative workflows, and service operations.

  • Demonstrated ability to identify operational problems, investigate root causes, and independently implement solutions.

  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

  • Strong communication skills and confidence interacting with physicians, practice staff, healthcare professionals, patients, and senior leadership.

  • Experience creating or improving SOPs, workflows, dashboards, trackers, or operational systems.

  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when working with patient information, documentation, billing information, and operational data.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving, changing, or early-stage environment.

  • Comfortable learning unfamiliar tools, systems, workflows, and processes independently.

  • Practical experience using AI, automation, or technology to improve business processes.

Highly Preferred

  • Experience supporting US medical practices or healthcare organizations.

  • Experience in telehealth, nutrition, wellness, chronic care, preventive health, exercise programs, or virtual healthcare services.

  • Familiarity with healthcare insurance, eligibility, reimbursement, billing, claims, or revenue-cycle workflows.

  • Experience working with EHR/EMR systems, scheduling platforms, CRM tools, telehealth systems, or patient communication platforms.

  • Experience coordinating or managing remote healthcare teams.

  • Experience with physician practice onboarding, account management, or client success.

  • Experience building processes or operations within an early-stage or rapidly growing company.

During your first few weeks, success will mean developing a strong understanding of Pillar's end-to-end operating model and creating clear visibility into how physician practices, patients, providers, documentation, billing, and internal workflows connect.

You will identify the biggest operational bottlenecks, improve patient and practice workflows, strengthen accountability, establish meaningful operational reporting, and reduce recurring operational issues.

Over time, you will help build an operating system capable of supporting substantially more physician practices, patients, and providers without operational complexity increasing at the same rate as the business.

The ultimate goal is simple:

Create an operation where physician practices receive a reliable experience, patients move through the program smoothly, providers have the support they need, leadership has visibility into performance, and fewer problems require manual intervention as Pillar grows.

Software Verification & Test Engineer

Remote | East Coast Hours | Up to 10% Travel | Full Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations is seeking an experienced Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer to support the development, verification, and certification of advanced aviation navigation systems.

This position will support functional, system, performance, and hardware/software integration testing for safety critical avionics applications. The selected engineer will develop and execute test cases, test scripts, procedures, and verification activities designed to evaluate system performance against defined technical and certification requirements.

The role requires deep experience with DO-178C software verification and certification, avionics software and hardware testing, requirements-based verification, and safety critical aviation systems. The successful candidate must be capable of independently analyzing requirements, developing verification approaches, executing tests, evaluating results, documenting anomalies, and producing high-quality verification evidence.

This position also requires hands on experience with SCADE, strong Java development experience, and familiarity with avionics certification and aircraft safety analysis.

The ideal candidate is an experienced verification engineer who combines strong software development knowledge with rigorous testing discipline, exceptional attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of safety critical aviation software development and certification.

Key Responsibilities

Software Verification & Testing

  • Develop, review, and execute software and system test cases, test scripts, and test procedures.
  • Perform requirements-based verification of safety critical avionics software.
  • Conduct functional, system, integration, and performance testing.
  • Verify software behavior against system and software requirements.
  • Analyze test results and identify, document, and investigate anomalies.
  • Perform regression testing following software or requirements changes.
  • Support software verification activities throughout the avionics development lifecycle.
  • Ensure test artifacts are complete, traceable, repeatable, and suitable for certification evidence.

Avionics Hardware & Software Integration

  • Perform software testing on avionics hardware platforms and integrated hardware/software environments.
  • Support hardware/software integration testing associated with navigation avionics.
  • Evaluate system behavior under normal, abnormal, and boundary conditions.
  • Troubleshoot software, hardware, interface, and integration issues.
  • Support simulation, bench testing, and hardware in the loop testing environments when applicable.
  • Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and test engineers to isolate and resolve technical issues.

DO-178C Certification & Compliance

  • Perform verification activities in accordance with DO-178C objectives.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of verification evidence required for avionics certification.
  • Ensure traceability between system requirements, software requirements, test procedures, test results, and identified anomalies.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, test reviews, peer reviews, and certification related activities.
  • Support development and review of verification documentation and certification artifacts.
  • Assist with identifying and resolving verification gaps or compliance issues.

Requirements Analysis & Traceability

  • Review system and software requirements for clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability.
  • Develop test cases and procedures directly from approved requirements.
  • Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements and verification artifacts.
  • Support requirements management and analysis using IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management tools.
  • Identify ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting requirements and coordinate resolution with engineering stakeholders.

SCADE & Software Development Support

  • Utilize SCADE within model-based software development and verification environments.
  • Support verification of SCADE generated or model-based avionics software.
  • Apply Java development experience to support software development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, or verification activities.
  • Review software behavior and implementation as necessary to support test development and anomaly investigation.
  • Collaborate with development engineers throughout verification and certification activities.

Safety Critical Aviation Systems

  • Support verification and certification activities for navigation avionics and related aircraft systems.
  • Apply understanding of aircraft safety, system safety, and certification considerations when developing verification approaches.
  • Support analysis of system performance and navigation related functionality.
  • Participate in technical reviews involving software, hardware, systems engineering, and certification stakeholders.
  • Maintain rigorous quality standards consistent with safety critical aviation development.

Documentation & Technical Collaboration

  • Develop clear and complete test procedures, test reports, verification records, and technical documentation.
  • Document defects, anomalies, corrective actions, and test results.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to engineering teams and program stakeholders.
  • Participate in peer reviews of requirements, test cases, procedures, results, and verification artifacts.
  • Support reporting program and technical status activities as required.

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Minimum eight years of professional software development, software verification, software testing, or related engineering experience.
  • Minimum five years of Java development experience.
  • Direct professional experience using SCADE.
  • Direct experience supporting DO-178C software development, verification, testing, or certification activities.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing requirements-based software test cases and procedures.
  • Experience performing functional, system, integration, or performance testing of avionics systems.
  • Experience testing software in conjunction with avionics hardware.
  • Experience supporting avionics certification and testing activities.
  • Experience with navigation avionics, aircraft navigation systems, inertial navigation systems, or closely related aviation systems.
  • Experience with FAA certification activities, aircraft safety analysis, or other safety critical aviation development processes.
  • Ability to analyze software and system requirements and translate requirements into executable verification activities.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to software quality.
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote engineering environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management and traceability tools.
  • Experience performing detailed requirements analysis.
  • Experience with inertial navigation, GPS aided navigation, guidance, or control systems.
  • Experience with test automation.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated test frameworks.
  • Experience with hardware in the loop, simulation, or laboratory test environments.
  • Experience with structural coverage analysis tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with static analysis tools.
  • Experience with Python, C, C++, or other languages commonly used in embedded avionics verification.
  • Familiarity with DO-254, ARP4754A, ARP4761, or related aviation development and certification standards.
  • Experience supporting FAA or military airworthiness certification activities.

Work Environment & Schedule

This position is remote and requires availability during Eastern Time business hours.

Travel of up to 10% may be required to support program activities, technical reviews, integration, testing, or customer needs.

The position requires close collaboration with software, systems, hardware, certification, and program engineering teams.

Compensation

Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer: $100,000 to $150,000 annually

Compensation is determined based on experience, technical expertise, certifications, education, internal equity, and business needs.

Crown complies with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws. The listed compensation range represents the good faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on job-related factors.

Benefits

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) with Company Match

• Company Paid Life Insurance

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Employee Assistance Program

• Professional Development Opportunities

About Crown

Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, engineering, advanced integration, analytics, software, and strategic planning, with deep expertise supporting the modernization and continued evolution of the National Airspace System.

For more than 30 years, Crown has supported a diverse portfolio of government and commercial clients, including the Federal Aviation Administration, NASA, the U.S. Energy Information Administration, state and local governments, and commercial organizations.

As a prime contractor supporting high impact federal programs, Crown provides comprehensive capabilities across engineering, infrastructure modernization, lifecycle data management, modeling and simulation, software development, regulatory compliance, and emerging technologies.

Our employees play a direct role in advancing aviation safety, improving operational performance, modernizing critical infrastructure, and supporting nationally significant programs.

Crown has consistently been recognized as one of the best places to work in the Washington, DC metropolitan area and is committed to providing employees with opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to meaningful, mission driven work.

Compliance & Equal Opportunity

Overview

Lumicera Health Services is seeking a Sr. Director, Industry and Payor Strategy to join our team!

The Sr. Director, Industry and Payor Strategy provides strategic leadership for Lumicera’s industry partnerships, payor strategy, and specialty pharmacy market access. This leader establishes and executes a multiyear strategy that expands access to medications and payor networks, strengthens competitive positioning, and delivers sustainable growth and financial performance. The role leads a team of experienced professionals and develops executive-level relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs), wholesalers, group purchasing organizations (GPOs), health systems, and other strategic partners. Accountability includes limited distribution drug (LDD) access, manufacturer and enhanced service agreements, payor network participation and reimbursement strategy, procurement and GPO contracting, and health system partnerships.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the Chief Growth Officer and senior leadership, translating industry and payor insights into recommendations on market positioning, partnership priorities, investment decisions, and enterprise growth opportunities.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing industry and payor strategy team; establish clear decision rights, priorities, and accountability for strategic execution, partner outcomes, and financial results.
  • Build organizational capability through leadership development, succession planning, coaching, and continuous improvement; align team structure and capabilities with evolving industry and payor priorities.
  • Own the development and execution of the multiyear industry and payor strategic plan, including annual operating priorities, resource allocation, departmental budgets, and measurable growth, access, and profitability objectives aligned with Lumicera’s enterprise strategy.
  • Provide leadership and management to ensure that the mission and core values of Lumicera are put into practice and shared with strategic partners.
  • Lead executive and cross-functional alignment on strategic priorities, communicating business cases, tradeoffs, risks, and progress to secure sponsorship and drive coordinated execution across commercial, clinical, operations, finance, legal, and compliance teams.
  • Define and lead payor strategy across health plans, PBMs, and other purchasers, prioritizing network access, preferred specialty pharmacy positioning, reimbursement sustainability, and strategic partnerships that support patient access and profitable growth.
  • Direct complex negotiations with manufacturers, payors, PBMs, wholesalers, GPOs, and health systems for distribution, procurement, network participation, reimbursement, and service agreements. Establish negotiation objectives and financial guardrails, obtain required approvals, and oversee implementation, contractual compliance, and realization of agreed-upon economics.
  • Develop and steward executive-level relationships with pharmaceutical manufacturers, payors, PBMs, wholesalers, GPOs, health systems, and providers; establish joint strategic plans that expand access, reduce costs, diversify revenue, and strengthen long-term partnership value.
  • Lead cross-functional development of differentiated payor and industry value propositions, including clinical outcomes, patient experience, total cost of care, and service capabilities; translate these into partnership proposals, requests for proposal responses, and scalable commercial offerings.
  • Establish portfolio-level contracting strategy and governance, including pricing and reimbursement frameworks, renewal priorities, performance guarantees, analytical controls, and audit processes. Evaluate contract profitability, concentration risk, and strategic fit, and recommend corrective actions or alternative arrangements.
  • Own the manufacturer access and specialty product portfolio strategy, prioritizing LDD opportunities, enhanced service programs, and emerging therapies. Direct launch readiness and agreement implementation to align product access with payor coverage, operational capabilities, and patient needs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare, Health Services, Pharmacy, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, required. MBA, MHA, or PharmD from an accredited pharmacy school preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in specialty pharmacy, pharmaceutical industry relations, market access, payor or PBM strategy, trade relations, account management, or a related industry, required.
  • 5+ years of progressive leadership experience, including strategic oversight and experience leading individual contributors and/or other leaders, required.
  • Experience in contract negotiation required, with strong preference in specialty or PBM rebate contracting.
  • Knowledge of specialty pharmacy medications, including REMS requirements and Limited Distribution Drug (LDD) best practices, required.

UpToDate is a trusted global clinical decision support platform used by clinicians around the world. UpToDate Expert AI builds on that foundation with production-grade, responsible AI that supports better decision-making inside everyday clinical workflows.


We are looking for a Lead Technical Product Manager to lead the delivery of APIs, integrations, and embedded applications that bring UpToDate intelligence into the broader healthcare ecosystem. This includes APIs used by third-party products and applications embedded in existing clinical tools such as electronic health record systems.


Working within the API operating model, you will own execution and outcomes for a defined product area, partner with platform and engineering teams, and serve as the portfolio’s go-to product expert for integrations. Success means delivering capabilities that are adopted by partners, reliable in production, easy to integrate, and supportive of business growth.


Working within the API operating model and the strategic direction established by product leadership, you will lead day-to-day execution for a defined product area, partner closely with platform and engineering teams, and serve as a key integration product resource across the portfolio. Success means helping deliver capabilities that are adopted by partners, reliable in production, easy to integrate, and supportive of business growth.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own execution and outcomes for defined API, integration, embedded application, and agentic AI capabilities.
  • Lead the delivery of APIs that enable third-party products and partners to integrate UpToDate intelligence.
  • Lead the delivery of applications that embed UpToDate Expert AI into existing clinical tools, including electronic health record systems.
  • Translate partner, product, and clinical workflow needs into clear product and platform requirements.
  • Recommend and manage roadmap sequencing, dependencies, and tradeoffs for the assigned product area.
  • Serve as the portfolio’s integration product expert, advising other product teams on integration approaches and shared platform capabilities.
  • Apply and improve standards for API governance, lifecycle management, versioning, reliability, and developer experience.
  • Define requirements for AI quality, safety, evaluation, monitoring, and operational readiness.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data, Security, Privacy, Legal, and other enterprise stakeholders.
  • Communicate priorities, decisions, dependencies, and risks clearly to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Identify recurring partner needs and turn them into reusable capabilities, reference patterns, templates, and self-service tools, reducing one-off engineering.
  • Own the discovery, technical readiness, sandbox onboarding, testing, launch, production monitoring, upgrades, and deprecation.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • 6+ years delivering complex software products from problem definition through launch and iteration.
  • Experience owning execution and outcomes for a platform, API, integration, or other technical product area.
  • Strong technical fluency in APIs, distributed systems, authentication and authorization, reliability, SLAs and SLOs, and cloud architecture.
  • Experience building developer-facing integration capabilities, including APIs, SDKs, documentation, versioning strategies, or sandbox environments.
    •

Experience using Jira, Confluence, and GitHub to manage product backlogs, document requirements and decisions, and collaborate effectively with different internal teams.

  • Experience delivering products that integrate into enterprise or clinical workflows.
  • Experience shipping production AI-enabled capabilities, including approaches to evaluation, monitoring, guardrails, and operational readiness.
  • Strong product judgment in regulated or high-trust environments.
  • Ability to lead through influence across technical and business stakeholders.
    •

Preferred

  • Technical background in software engineering, architecture, SRE, or B2B platform development.
  • Experience in healthcare, electronic health record integrations, interoperability standard such as SMART on FHIR, or another regulated domain.
    •

Experience with healthcare interoperability and electronic health record integrations, including technologies such as SMART on FHIR, OAuth 2.0, or OpenID Connect

  • Familiarity with AI observability, evaluation pipelines, or AI incident response.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

Our agentic voice AI portfolio—AIR, AVA, and ACE—brings together automation, assistance, and insights across the entire conversation lifecycle. The result? More seamless, intelligent experiences for businesses everywhere.


With $2.5B+ in ARR and $250M invested in R&D annually, we’re building the future of AI-powered business communications.


This is where you and your skills come in. We’re currently looking for a Senior Employment Counsel to join our Legal team as a contractor. In this role, you will provide practical, business-focused legal advice across a wide range of employment matters in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You will partner closely with HR, leadership, and cross-functional teams to help manage risk, support compliance, and enable the business to scale effectively.


Job Responsibilities:

  • Advise on a broad range of domestic and international employment and labor law matters, including recruiting, employee relations, performance management, accommodations, wage and hour, investigations, and terminations
  • Draft, review, and update employment-related agreements, policies, and templates to ensure compliance and consistency
  • Manage and advise on internal investigations, employment-related claims, demand letters, audits, and administrative complaints
  • Partner with HR and business leaders to evaluate and implement employment practices, policies, and processes
  • Manage employment litigation matters in collaboration with internal and external counsel and support global employment and immigration initiatives

To succeed in this role you must have experience in:

  • Juris Doctor (JD) degree and active membership in good standing with at least one US state bar (Colorado or California preferred).
  • 3+ years of experience practicing U.S. employment law at a nationally recognized law firm and/or in-house

The best business decisions don't happen by accident. They happen when leaders have the right information, the right context, and the confidence to act.

As a Senior Business Insights Analyst, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to leaders across Summit, transforming complex operational, financial, and customer data into meaningful business insights. You'll partner with executives and cross-functional teams to develop performance frameworks, evaluate strategic opportunities, build business cases, and provide the analysis that helps shape the company's future.

Success in this role isn't measured by the reports you produce. It's measured by the quality of the decisions your insights help leaders make.

What You’ll Do:
  • Partner with executive leadership and business stakeholders to identify opportunities, evaluate business performance, and support strategic decision-making.
  • Lead complex operational, financial, and strategic analyses that provide actionable recommendations for business leaders.
  • Develop business cases, scenario models, forecasting tools, and value-realization analyses that support investment decisions and organizational priorities.
  • Design and evolve enterprise KPI frameworks, executive dashboards, and performance scorecards that provide meaningful visibility across the organization.
  • Translate complex business questions into analytical approaches that uncover trends, risks, opportunities, and recommendations.
  • Monitor organizational performance, proactively identifying emerging trends, operational challenges, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Strengthen data governance and reporting standards by improving data quality, consistency, and enterprise reporting practices.
  • Present findings, recommendations, and business insights to executive leadership in clear, concise, and actionable ways.
  • Partner with Finance, Delivery, Sales, Product, and other business functions to align reporting, metrics, and performance measurement across the organization.
  • Continuously improve Summit's analytical capabilities by introducing new reporting approaches, measurement frameworks, and decision-support tools.
What You’ll Deliver:
  • Executive insights that improve strategic and operational decision-making.
  • Business cases and scenario models that support investments, operational improvements, and long-term planning.
  • Enterprise KPI frameworks that provide consistent, meaningful visibility into business performance.
  • Trusted executive dashboards and reporting that connect organizational performance with business priorities.
  • Actionable recommendations that improve operational effectiveness, financial performance, and customer outcomes.
  • Strong data governance practices that increase confidence in enterprise reporting and analytics.
  • Continuous improvements that strengthen Summit's ability to make informed, data-driven decisions.
You’ll Thrive in This Role If You:
  • Have experience leading business analytics, operational analysis, financial modeling, or strategic decision support in a technology or high-growth environment.
  • Enjoy solving complex business problems through thoughtful analysis and practical recommendations.
  • Can translate large amounts of data into clear stories that help leaders make confident decisions.
  • Build trusted relationships with executives and influence decisions through credibility, collaboration, and sound judgment.
  • Balance curiosity with business acumen, knowing when to dig deeper and when to simplify.
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences, adapting your message to the needs of your audience.
  • Naturally connect information across teams, functions, and business priorities to uncover opportunities others may miss.
  • Believe the best insights don't just explain the past; they help shape what's next.
Bonus Points:
  • Experience developing executive dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Advanced experience with SQL, data modeling, statistical analysis, or business intelligence tools.
  • Experience supporting executive planning, investment analysis, or enterprise performance management.
  • Experience developing KPI architectures, reporting frameworks, or value-realization methodologies.
  • Familiarity with managed services, cloud infrastructure, enterprise technology, or cybersecurity environments.
How We Work at Summit

How you approach the work matters just as much as what you do. At Summit, our core values show up in how we make decisions, work together, and support our customers.

We build the infrastructure that keeps businesses running. We need people who take that seriously, and have fun doing it.

Our Core Values:

  • Empower our people
  • Constant elevation
  • Customer first
  • Focus on outcomes
  • Embrace curiosity
Benefits

Summit offers a total rewards package designed to support you at work, at home, and everywhere in between. Here’s a snapshot of what that looks like:

  • Flexible Time Off (yes, really) – take what you need, we trust you to manage it
  • Medical, Dental & Vision – comprehensive coverage with HSA/HRA options
  • 401(k) with 4% match – we invest alongside you
  • Parental Leave – paid time for the moments that matter most
  • Life & Disability Insurance – built-in peace of mind
  • Wellness Support – resources for your mental and physical health
  • Free Colocation & Cloud Access – build and experiment in real environments
  • Work From Anywhere – remote-friendly by design
  • A low-ego, get-it-done culture – come as you are, do great work
Compensation

The salary range for this role is $110,000 – $131,500 annually. Compensation is based on the responsibilities of the role, experience, skills, geographic market, and internal equity. We believe great careers are built one step at a time, and compensation should grow alongside your impact.

Internal candidates may see variations based on current role, compensation, and progression at Summit. Same thoughtful approach, just with additional context.

raw.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a BI Developer / Visualization Specialist to develop dashboards, operational reports, self-service templates, and ad hoc visualizations supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
raw.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a BI Developer / Visualization Specialist to develop dashboards, operational reports, self-service templates, and ad hoc visualizations supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This Journeyman-level position will use Power BI, SQL, Power Query, and DAX to translate mission requirements into accurate, accessible, and understandable reporting products. The specialist will develop intuitive layouts, drill-through experiences, and paginated reports where supported by the approved environment.

The BI Developer / Visualization Specialist will collaborate with the Power BI/Analytics Engineering Lead, business analysts, data engineers, testers, and Government users to demonstrate reporting capabilities, incorporate feedback, and improve usability.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The BI Developer / Visualization Specialist will:

  • Build and maintain Power BI dashboards, operational reports, self-service templates, and ad hoc visualizations.
  • Translate reporting requirements, business rules, KPIs, and acceptance criteria into usable reporting products.
  • Use SQL and Power Query to retrieve, prepare, transform, and validate reporting data.
  • Develop DAX measures and calculations consistent with approved definitions and shared semantic models.
  • Create accessible layouts with clear navigation, meaningful labels, readable visuals, and appropriate use of color.
  • Develop drill-through experiences, filters, tooltips, and other interactions that help users explore results.
  • Develop paginated reports where supported by the approved hosting configuration and reporting tools.
  • Create reusable templates and visual patterns that follow program reporting standards.
  • Validate calculations, totals, filters, relationships, and displayed results against authoritative data and expected outcomes.
  • Test report usability, accessibility, performance, and data refresh behavior.
  • Implement approved report-level access requirements and coordinate access issues with the technical lead.
  • Conduct user demonstrations and gather feedback on reporting functionality, layout, and interpretation.
  • Incorporate approved user feedback and resolve assigned reporting defects.
  • Support user acceptance testing and maintain evidence of corrections and retest results.
  • Coordinate with data engineering and database teams to investigate data discrepancies and source changes.
  • Follow approved version control, review, deployment, and change-management procedures.
  • Maintain report documentation, calculation definitions, data mappings, and user guidance.
  • Help users understand report capabilities, limitations, and appropriate use of self-service templates.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of six years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in information systems, data analytics, computer science, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Experience with Power BI, SQL, Power Query, and DAX.
  • Experience developing accessible dashboards.
  • Experience developing operational reports.
  • Ability to build self-service reporting templates and ad hoc visualizations.
  • Ability to develop drill-through experiences and paginated reports where supported.
  • Ability to conduct user demonstrations and incorporate feedback into reporting products.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300).
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense reporting needs.
  • Experience working with shared semantic models, standardized measures, and enterprise reporting standards.
  • Experience with Power BI Report Builder or comparable paginated reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with data warehouses, dimensional models, data lineage, and metadata.
  • Experience testing report accessibility, usability, calculations, and performance.
  • Familiarity with approved gateways, refresh schedules, and reporting access controls.
  • Experience with version control, controlled deployment, and reporting change management.
  • Strong visual communication, analytical troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

raw.excerpt: Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments.
raw.description:
Metro Vein Centers is a rapidly growing healthcare practice specializing in state-of-the-art vein treatments. Our board-certified physicians and expert staff are on a mission to improve people’s quality of life by relieving the painful, yet highly treatable symptoms of vein disease—such as varicose veins and heavy, aching legs.

With over 70 clinics across 9 states, and still growing, we’re building the future of vein care—delivering compassionate, results-driven care in a modern, patient-first environment.

We proudly maintain a Net Promoter Score (NPS) of 93, the highest patient satisfaction in the industry.

Position Summary

The Director of Real Estate owns every step from market selection to signed lease, and the lease portfolio thereafter. We open roughly 20 clinics a year today and intend to reach 30. Site selection, LOI and lease negotiation currently run out of the VP of Business Development's desk, and that is the constraint on getting there.

This is a builder's role in a lean organization. You will be the first dedicated real estate hire, you will work directly with the CEO, the VP of Business Development and the Board, and you will set how this function operates rather than inherit a playbook. You will partner closely with the Director of Clinic Development & Facilities, who takes each site from lease signature through construction and opening.

This role has no initial direct reports. You will work through an external broker network and alongside internal project management, legal and finance.

Key Opportunities

  • Own a function outright and define how it runs
  • Report up to the VP of Business Development
  • Set the pace of a national expansion moving from 20 to 30 clinics a year
  • Build the site criteria and the market model the company will use for years
  • Lean organization with opportunity to take on significant responsibility quickly

Responsibilities

New markets and densification

  • Analyze and rank new metro opportunities using demographics, payer landscape, competitive density and labor supply; recommend where we go next and defend it to leadership and the Board
  • Assess densification in markets we already serve — where a second or third clinic adds revenue/ebitda rather than splitting the ones we have
  • Build and maintain the scoring model and site criteria behind those recommendations

Site selection and transactions

  • Source and virtually tour sites, manage the broker network, and maintain a pipeline deep enough to sustain 30 openings a year
  • Negotiate letters of intent
  • Negotiate leases and the documents that go with them: commencement terms, tenant improvement reimbursement, move-in allowance, options and renewal rights
  • Hand each signed site to Clinic Development with the delivery condition, TI allowance and landlord obligations documented

Portfolio and asset management

  • Own the lease portfolio: the critical-date calendar, option notice deadlines, renewals, estoppels and CAM reconciliation
  • Analyze the current clinic footprint — square footage against clinic productivity — and recommend where to expand, contract, sublease or relocate
  • Lead exits: lease termination, assignment and subleasing when a site closes or moves

Partnership

  • Work with Recruiting so market selection matches physician supply; a site we cannot staff is a site we should not sign
  • Work with Revenue Cycle on payer access in a prospective market before we commit to it
  • Report pipeline, cycle times and lease economics to leadership and the Board

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 5 to 7+ years in commercial real estate, with direct ownership of site selection and lease negotiation for a multi-site operator
  • A track record of closing sites at volume, you have personally run a pipeline of 15+ locations a year, not supported one
  • Fluent in lease economics: TI allowances, base rent and escalations, CAM, options, delivery condition, landlord work letters
  • Strong analytical skills; you build the market model yourself rather than commission it
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; able to put a site recommendation in front of a CEO and a Board and defend it
  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools. You use large language models and AI-assisted tooling as part of your day-to-day workflow, and you can show us how. We will ask you to walk us through real examples: how you prompt, where you have automated or accelerated your own work, and how you check and validate AI output before relying on it.
  • Comfortable operating without a team, you work through brokers, counsel and internal partners
  • Willing to travel to tour markets and sites
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Nice to Have

None of the following are required. Tell us which ones you have, or which you would be most excited to learn.

  • Healthcare real estate, or another regulated multi-site operator (dental, veterinary, urgent care, dialysis, physical therapy)
  • Experience standing up a real estate function rather than joining an established one
  • Tenant representation background, or time on the brokerage side
  • GIS, site-scoring or trade-area tools — Buxton, Placer.ai, Esri, CoStar
  • Experience with a national tenant-rep relationship at scale

Compensation & Benefits

  • $130k to $190k (based on experience) plus 15% yearly performance bonus
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Flexible paid time off
  • 401K

Compensation for this role varies based on years of experience, skill set, and alignment with position requirements.

Hiring Process

The hiring process consists of three rounds:

  1. Phone screening interview
  2. Formal hour-long interview
  3. Case study: assess a prospective market and a specific site, and present the recommendation

You are welcome to use AI tools during the case study. We will ask you to show your work and explain your reasoning, including where you used AI and how you verified the results.

The Metro Vein Centers Difference

Healthy legs. Happier lives.
At Metro Vein Centers, we believe exceptional care begins with an exceptional experience. Our mission is to make vein care approachable, empowering, and connected to overall well-being. From the first conversation to the final follow-up, every patient interaction reflects our commitment to compassion, expertise, and trust.

A team united by purpose.

Our values guide everything we do:

  • Patients First, Always – Every interaction should make our patients feel valued, heard, and cared for.
  • Stronger Together – Teamwork and collaboration drive our success. We lift each other up to deliver the best for our patients.
  • A Can-Do Spirit – We meet every challenge with positivity, flexibility, and problem-solving energy.
  • Results That Make a Difference – We’re driven to improve lives through meaningful, measurable outcomes.
  • Commitment to Growth – We invest in our people, fostering advancement and professional development at every level.

Metro Vein Centers is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels seen, heard, and supported. This policy applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, benefits, and termination.

Legal & Compliance Notice:
Metro Vein Centers complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws, including those related to nondiscrimination, equal opportunity, and pay transparency.
