raw.excerpt: Lumenci is hiring a remote Director of Marketing to lead US marketing for a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform.
raw.description:
Lumenci is hiring a remote Director of Marketing to lead US marketing for a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform. In this hands-on, senior individual contributor role, you will own IP industry events, demand generation, ABM, content, and brand for our patent litigation, monetization, and iLumOS AI businesses, working closely with Sales and collaborating with teams globally.

About Lumenci

Founded in 2018, Lumenci is a full-lifecycle intellectual property platform specializing in patent litigation, expert witness testimony, and patent monetization for leading corporations and global law firms across the software, telecommunications, semiconductor, and emerging technology sectors.

A key part of our model is the integration of deep technical expertise with litigation strategy. Our teams support high-stakes disputes by developing technical narratives, performing rigorous analysis, including reverse engineering and source-code review, and partnering with world-class expert witnesses whose testimony shapes case outcomes in courts and arbitration forums worldwide. Alongside our services business, our iLumOS platform delivers expert-guided AI for patent intelligence, moving clients from portfolio analysis to action in minutes rather than months.

Today we work with more than 200 clients worldwide. We have analyzed over 100,000 patents, tested more than 1,200 products, and supported clients in raising over $200M in IP financing, with more than $3.5B tied to verdicts, settlements, and cost savings. That work is delivered by 150 consultants and more than 100 technical experts with exceptional academic backgrounds.

Three Lumenci leaders are named in the IAM Strategy 300: The World's Leading IP Strategists 2026, and Lumenci ranks #14 in Vault's 2026 Top Consulting Asia-Pacific rankings. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, we deliver end-to-end support spanning technical analysis, expert strategy, valuation, and monetization execution. We are backed by VSS Capital Partners and Century Equity Partners, and we are growing quickly.

Employment Type: Full-time, exempt
Work Arrangement: Remote
Location: US
Reports To: Senior VP of Sales
Travel: 15–25% (trade shows, industry events, client dinners)

The Opportunity

Lumenci is reshaping how it goes to market. As we grow our client base and expand iLumOS, we need marketing to shape the market story our commercial teams bring to clients. Our work has earned deep trust with the clients who know us. Your job is to make sure the rest of the market knows us too.

This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with a clear path to building a team. With a US focus, you will own Lumenci's US marketing presence: our trade show calendar, client events, collateral, campaigns, and brand. You will support the rollout of our US team and work closely with Sales and sales enablement, while collaborating with Lumenci colleagues globally.

What You'll Do

Events and client experiences

  • Lead Lumenci's US trade show and conference program, including key IP events such as AIPLA, IPO, and LES. Own each event from planning through follow-up, covering booth presence, staffing, materials, and lead capture

  • Plan and run client dinners and hosted events in key markets

  • Own promotional items, giveaways, branded merchandise, and client dinners within Lumenci's gift, entertainment, and expense policies, including vendor management, ordering, and inventory

Content and collateral

  • Audit current collateral and set priorities for what to revise or create first

  • Create overview, introductory, and solution-specific collateral for both Lumenci services and iLumOS

  • Build tailored presentation slides for sales conversations, conferences, and client meetings

  • Manage the webinar, white paper, and use case program, working with internal subject-matter experts to turn complex IP work into clear client stories

  • Work with Legal and delivery leaders to make sure case studies, use cases, and outcome claims protect client confidentiality and are approved before publication

Demand generation and sales enablement

  • Partner with sales enablement to keep sales materials and messaging current and consistent

  • Create content for the SDR team and build targeted outreach campaigns aimed at priority accounts and buyer segments

  • Design and run account-based marketing (ABM) programs for high-value target accounts, coordinating events, content, and digital outreach with Sales

  • Build a demand generation engine that produces measurable pipeline, using HubSpot for campaigns, lead scoring, tracking, and attribution to prove ROI for every program

  • Guide website content, SEO, and visibility in AI-driven search so buyers can find Lumenci and iLumOS

  • Develop thought leadership programs that position Lumenci and iLumOS as authorities in patent monetization and IP strategy

  • Manage the marketing budget, agencies, and external partners to get the most from every dollar

Brand

  • Own the Lumenci brand across every touchpoint, including PowerPoint templates, email signatures, digital assets, and event presence

  • Make sure brand standards are applied consistently across our US and global teams

  • Partner with HR on employer branding, including branded templates for offer and onboarding communications and new-hire welcome kits

What You Bring

Required

  • 7+ years of B2B marketing experience, including 4+ years in the intellectual property industry, such as IP information and analytics, IP software, IP or legal services, litigation support, or licensing

  • Deep knowledge of the IP market, its buyers, and how they evaluate services and technology, including law firms, corporate IP teams, patent owners, and litigation funders

  • Proven success running trade show and event programs from start to finish

  • A track record of demand generation tied to measurable results, such as qualified leads, marketing-sourced pipeline, and closed revenue

  • Experience owning a marketing budget and managing agencies or external partners

  • Strong writing and presentation skills, with the ability to turn technical and legal subject matter into clear, persuasive content

  • A strong sense of urgency and a habit of planning ahead, keeping several priorities moving without last-minute scrambles

  • Comfort working as a hands-on individual contributor who personally delivers the work while also setting strategy

  • Ability to build alignment and work well with sales and with global, cross-functional teams across time zones

  • Ability to travel 15–25% for trade shows, industry events, and client dinners. Event work may involve standing for extended periods and setting up booth materials. Reasonable accommodations are available.

Preferred

  • Director-level marketing experience in an IP-focused company

  • Experience marketing both professional services and a software or AI platform, across multiple business lines

  • Hands-on HubSpot experience, including campaigns, lead scoring, lead flow, and ROI reporting

  • Experience building account-based marketing programs

  • Familiarity with SEO and generative engine optimization (GEO) for AI-driven search

  • Existing relationships across the IP event and association circuit, such as AIPLA, IPO, and LES

  • Experience leading cross-functional teams or managing marketing staff

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Review all existing collateral and agree with leadership on what to revise first. Take ownership of promotional items and giveaways. Get up to speed quickly on events already scheduled for conference season.

First 60 days: Deliver refreshed priority collateral and presentation templates. Run upcoming trade shows and client dinners. Start building SDR content and targeted outreach campaigns with sales enablement.

First 90 days: Set clear brand standards that every team is using. Put a regular webinar and white paper calendar in place. Put pipeline and ROI reporting in place for marketing programs. Present a US marketing plan that supports Lumenci's broader go-to-market strategy and iLumOS growth.

Why You Will Love Working for Lumenci

Be Part of a Global Team: Joining Lumenci means joining a diverse and globally distributed team. You'll collaborate with talented individuals from different backgrounds and cultures, bringing unique perspectives to every project.

Growth and Development Opportunities: At Lumenci, we believe in recognizing and rewarding merit. We offer opportunities for merit-based promotions, allowing you to advance your career based on your performance, contributions, and dedication. We are committed to supporting your professional growth and development, providing the resources and mentorship needed to excel in your role and take on new challenges.

Benefits & Total Rewards

  • Comprehensive Health & Well-being: We offer robust medical, dental, and vision insurance options that include significant company contributions toward employee premiums to support the health of our "Luminaries" and their families.

  • Retirement Strategy: Lumenci provides a 401(k) program with a competitive employer-matching contribution, enabling employees to build long-term financial security.

  • Performance-Based Incentives: Our total cash compensation includes a variable pay component designed to reward both individual goals and overall company success.

15 Jours, c’est le délai que nous souhaitons tenir pour conclure un process de recrutement.

As a leader in Lawful and Location Intelligence, SS8 helps make societies safer. Our commitment is to extract, analyze, and visualize the critical intelligence that gives law enforcement, intelligence agencies, and emergency services the real-time insights that help save lives. Our high performance, flexible, and future-proof solutions also enable mobile network operators to achieve regulatory compliance with minimum disruption, time, and cost. SS8 is trusted by the largest government agencies, communications providers, and systems integrators globally.

Overview

SS8 recently implemented NetSuite Financials as its ERP system and is seeking an experienced independent contractor to provide on-demand technical and functional support for NetSuite Financials. The primary focus will be to resolve outstanding implementation issues, refine system configurations and workflows, and identify opportunities to improve financial processes, reporting, and overall system efficiency. This is an as-needed, hourly engagement with an indefinite term and no guaranteed minimum hours.

What You’ll Do

  • Build, customize, and troubleshoot financial reports, saved searches, and dashboards to meet accounting and management reporting requirements.
  • Troubleshoot issues with customized invoices, billing configurations, transaction forms, and invoicing workflows.
  • Troubleshoot revenue recognition schedules, rules, configurations, and related accounting entries; assist with resolving revenue recognition discrepancies.
  • Provide guidance on general ledger transactions, journal entries, accounting periods, and month-end close issues.
  • Diagnose NetSuite financial system issues, recommend solutions, and provide practical guidance on system functionality and best practices.

Required Experience & Qualifications

  • NetSuite certification and demonstrated hands-on experience with NetSuite Financial Management.
  • 5+ years of hands-on NetSuite Financials experience.
  • Strong experience building customized financial reports, saved searches, and reporting dashboards.
  • Proven experience troubleshooting custom invoicing and billing processes.
  • Working knowledge of NetSuite revenue recognition functionality and related accounting processes.
  • Ability to provide flexible, on-demand support as issues arise.

Nice to Have

  • NetSuite implementation experience.
  • Post-go-live support experience.

Join a company where your ideas, expertise, and ambition can make a real difference.
At SS8, we’re committed to fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. Whether you’re developing new solutions, supporting customers, or driving business success, you’ll be part of a team that values your contributions and invests in your future.

Compensation

This is an independent contractor engagement billed hourly. The expected rate range is $130 – $170 per hour, depending on the candidate’s skills and experience. Hours are as needed, with no guaranteed minimum.

At SS8 Networks, our approach to flexible work is centered on trust and optimized for culture, connection, and clarity. This role is remote, performed from home, as determined by business needs.

raw.description:
Job Title: Senior Director, Chapter Impact

Department: Chapter Impact

Location: Remote/Virtual within the continental US

Reports to: Vice President, Chapter Impact & Outposts

Direct Reports: Chapter Executive Directors in an assigned portfolio of five to six Chapters

Classification: Exempt

Anticipated Pay Range At Commencement of Employment: $106,000 - $146,000

Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families is the largest nonprofit dedicated to making military life better for families. Each year, we support over 1.5 million military- and veteran-connected family members through a national network of 450,000+ members and local chapters in communities across the country.

Our mission is simple and bold: We make military life awesome for families.

We listen, share, partner, and act to deliver evidence-based, data-driven solutions that work for real people. We’re a lifestyle organization, a friend and neighbor, and a trusted partner. Our approach is collaborative, human-centered, and designed with the whole family in mind.

A Blue Star Family is one with an immediate family member — a spouse, parent, or child — actively serving in the U.S. Armed Forces, including the Guard and Reserves. These families face unique challenges: frequent relocations, deployments, career disruption, and isolation. We respond with research-informed programs that create connection, build resilience, and foster a true sense of belonging.

We serve with urgency but build trust over time — because change happens at the speed of trust. Whether we’re driving spouse employment, supporting caregivers, or helping communities welcome military families, we strive for upstream solutions.

Who We’re Looking For:

  • Bold thinkers. Fast movers. Smart collaborators. People who want to build, lead, and drive measurable change — and who care deeply about making an impact that matters.

What You’ll Do Here:

  • Solve complex challenges with data, heart, and humility
  • Build cross-sector partnerships that get things done
  • Help military families feel at home wherever they live

If you're ready to work in a high-performance, mission-driven environment — and to make life better for those who serve — Blue Star Families is where you belong.

General Description

Blue Star Families is building a network of high-performing Chapters. Each is led by an exceptional Executive Director who is an influential community leader, a strategic thinker, a strong relationship builder and a recognized voice for military families. To advance this vision, we are introducing a new executive coaching and regional leadership model.

The Senior Director, Chapter Impact serves as executive coach and regional manager for a portfolio of five to six Chapters. The role goes beyond operational oversight. Its main purpose is to develop exceptional leaders by helping Executive Directors:

  • strengthen their executive presence
  • build influence in their communities
  • think strategically
  • cultivate meaningful relationships
  • lead sustainable, successful organizations

The Senior Director also directly supervises these Executive Directors. They hold them accountable for financial sustainability, community impact, member experience, operational excellence and overall performance.

We are seeking accomplished leaders who can turn their own career success into effective coaching. They should act as trusted advisors, strategic thought partners, candid mentors and accountability partners. We know great coaching isn't about directing every decision. It's about building the judgment, confidence, and capability of others.

We are intentionally recruiting from diverse backgrounds, with deep expertise in at least one of these areas:

  • Executive influence and community leadership: building influential relationships, navigating complex stakeholder environments and establishing organizational credibility
  • Entrepreneurship and strategic growth: building, growing or transforming organizations through entrepreneurial leadership and opportunity development
  • Strategic communications and thought leadership: raising executive visibility, shaping organizational reputation and driving public influence through persuasive communication

Each Senior Director brings a distinct perspective to their portfolio and shares their expertise across the broader Chapter network.

As a fully remote organization, we rely on regular in-person gatherings to fulfill core business functions, including strategic planning, cross-functional collaboration, and culture-building. This role requires the ability to travel overnight several times per year to attend team offsites, leadership sessions, donor meetings, and company-wide events. Attendance and participation in these gatherings is a non-negotiable component of the position.

Key Job Functions

Executive Coaching & Leadership Development

  • Serve as the primary executive coach, mentor, and strategic advisor to Chapter Executive Directors, strengthening their leadership effectiveness, strategic thinking, executive presence, and decision-making.

  • Develop individualized leadership development plans, providing candid feedback, mentorship, and accountability to accelerate professional growth.
  • Coach EDs to become confident, influential executives who lead with initiative, sound judgment, emotional intelligence, and strategic vision.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, peer learning, and leadership excellence across the Chapter network.

Community Influence, Strategic Growth & External Leadership

  • Coach EDs in building power, influence, and credibility within their communities, positioning themselves as respected leaders and recognized voices for military families.
  • Strengthen EDs' ability to cultivate high-value relationships with military, civic, corporate, government, and philanthropic leaders.
  • Develop EDs' capabilities in executive communications, public speaking, thought leadership, strategic partnerships, and community engagement.
  • Mentor EDs in entrepreneurial thinking, opportunity identification, innovation, and strategic growth to expand Chapter influence, sustainability, and impact.

Chapter Portfolio Leadership & Performance Accountability

  • Provide direct management oversight for approximately five to six Chapters, establishing clear expectations and accountability for financial sustainability, community impact, member experience, and operational excellence.
  • Maintain a regular cadence of executive coaching, strategic performance reviews, and leadership development conversations with assigned EDs.
  • Coach EDs in strengthening their ownership of fundraising, strategic partnerships, team leadership, and overall Chapter performance.
  • Serve as the rating official for assigned EDs, conducting performance evaluations, identifying leadership development needs, and recommending appropriate performance interventions, subject to Vice President approval.
  • Provide strategic guidance on Chapter priorities, budgets, staffing, and organizational challenges while empowering EDs to lead independently.

Organizational Collaboration & Network Leadership

  • Serve as a strategic partner to the Vice President, providing insight and recommendations on Chapter performance, leadership development, emerging risks, and opportunities.
  • Collaborate with national departments to connect Chapters with the resources, expertise, and support necessary for success.
  • Contribute specialized subject matter expertise to the broader Chapter network through cross-portfolio coaching, leadership development, and sharing of best practices.
  • Elevate significant personnel, resource allocation, and organizational decisions to the Vice President with clear recommendations, ensuring consistent management standards across the network.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Required Experience, Skills & Background

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
  • 8+ years of progressive professional experience, including at least five years in senior leadership, executive management, strategic advisory, or comparable roles.
  • Demonstrated success leading organizations, major initiatives, teams, or complex stakeholder relationships.
  • Proven ability to coach, mentor, advise, or develop senior-level professionals and leaders.
  • Significant professional accomplishment and demonstrated expertise in at least one of the three specialized areas identified above.
  • Strong executive presence, credibility, interpersonal judgment, and the ability to engage confidently with senior executives and influential stakeholders.
  • Exceptional strategic thinking and the ability to help others navigate complex leadership challenges, identify opportunities, and make effective decisions.
  • Strong emotional intelligence, active listening, and the ability to build trust while providing candid and constructive feedback.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, motivate, and develop others without relying exclusively on positional authority.
  • Experience managing performance, establishing accountability, and delivering difficult feedback.
  • Ability to translate professional expertise into practical, individualized coaching and measurable leadership development.
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, facilitation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to balance leadership development with organizational performance expectations and management responsibilities.
  • Commitment to Blue Star Families' mission and values.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly to assigned Chapters and organizational meetings.

Desired Experience, Skills & Background

  • Prior experience as a CEO, Executive Director, entrepreneur, senior executive, regional leader, or strategic advisor.
  • Formal executive coaching training or substantial demonstrated experience mentoring and developing senior leaders.
  • Experience supporting geographically distributed organizations, regional operations, or chapter-based networks.
  • Experience engaging influential stakeholders across corporate, civic, military, government, or philanthropic sectors.
  • Demonstrated success developing individuals who have advanced into positions of greater leadership responsibility or organizational influence.
  • Experience with organizational transformation, leadership development, or strategic growth initiatives.
  • Familiarity with the military community and the challenges facing military-connected families.
  • Experience working in a remote or geographically distributed organization.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or comparable organizational management systems.

More About Blue Star Families

Blue Star Families empowers military and Veteran families to thrive by connecting them with their civilian neighbors — both people and organizations — to create strong communities of mutual support. We believe we're all stronger when we take care of one another.

Our groundbreaking research is raising the nation's awareness of the unique challenges of military family life. With the help of neighbors across the country, Blue Star Families is overcoming the isolation and alienation of frequent moves, deployments, and reduced support from the government. Our innovative programs are solving specific challenges for military families, including fighting economic insecurity with resources that foster spouse career development, creating family strength with rich family programming, and providing critical peer support for caregivers, whose numbers are only increasing.

Blue Star Families is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization.

EEO Policy

Blue Star Families is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Why Blue Star Families?

Virtual/remote nonprofit organization that moves with you (position specific)

Career growth opportunities

Excellent benefits (403(b) with matching, Flexible Spending, Medical Insurance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, Communications Allowance, and more)
Permanent Change of Station (PCS) Leave for Active-Duty Military Spouses
On-the-job professional development training
Front-line opportunity to positively impact the military experience
Competitive salaries

Workplace flexibility

raw.description:
IT Help Desk Specialist

  • Location: Remote. International applicants welcome.

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, 7:30 AM to 3:30 PM US Central Time

  • Type: Full-time independent contractor

About the role

We run sales and support teams across several health and wellness brands. Everything they do runs on Salesforce, a cloud phone system and a business texting platform. When something breaks, you're the one who fixes it.

You'll be the first point of contact for 150+ users: their accounts, their phone setup and their support tickets. You'll escalate only what truly needs a system change.

How we work

This role is built for someone who doesn't need to be managed. There's no daily task list handed to you. Your work lives on a dashboard that shows every open ticket, pending request and system alert, and your goal is to keep it empty.

We're looking for someone who:

  • Starts the day by checking the dashboard, not by waiting for direction

  • Figures things out before asking

  • Manages their own time and priorities, and knows what's urgent and what can wait until the afternoon

  • Follows through without reminders and closes the loop with the person who asked

  • Can be trusted with admin access to the tools the whole company depends on

If you do your best work with clear ownership and little supervision, this is that job.

What you'll do

  • Keep the help desk dashboard at zero: open tickets, pending account requests and system health alerts

  • Resolve most support tickets yourself, and escalate the rest with the investigation already done

  • Set up and remove user accounts across Salesforce, Vonage, SMS Magic and our other tools as people join, change roles or leave

  • Troubleshoot calling, callback and voicemail issues with agents, and work with Vonage support on open cases

  • Manage our business phone numbers: assignments, releases, and requesting spam-label removal with the carriers (AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile)

  • Maintain users and numbers in our business texting platform

  • Process requests to delete call recordings under our privacy process

  • Correct sales and order records when automated checks flag a mismatch

What you'll need

  • 2+ years in IT help desk, technical support or contact center support

  • Salesforce experience strongly preferred, especially managing users, permissions and records

  • Strong troubleshooting skills: you can take a vague "it's not working," find the cause, and fix it or explain it clearly

  • A track record of working independently: self-motivated, organized and good at managing your own time

  • Excellent written and spoken English; most communication is written, in tickets and Slack

  • Reliable internet and a quiet workspace for the full 7:30 to 3:30 CT schedule

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator certification

  • Vonage Contact Center (VCC) or another cloud contact center platform

  • SMS platforms, telecom or phone number management

  • Experience supporting sales teams

description: What’s in it for you?  Ready to make a serious impact?

raw.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
raw.excerpt: What’s in it for you?  Ready to make a serious impact?
raw.description:
What’s in it for you?

Ready to make a serious impact? Millions of people already rely on Calendly, and we’re still in the midst of exciting product growth — it’s a fantastic time to join us. Everything you’ll work on here will accelerate your career to the next level. If you want to learn, grow, and do the best work of your life alongside the best people you’ve ever worked with, then we hope you’ll consider allowing Calendly to be a part of your professional journey.

About the Role

Calendly is looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help shape how we position, launch, and grow our products, including new AI capabilities.

This is a full-stack product marketing role on a small team. You'll work closely with Product and Research to understand customers, develop compelling positioning, and influence product direction. You'll also roll up your sleeves to turn that strategy into work customers actually see, from writing messaging and launch copy to managing go-to-market plans and coordinating execution with other teams.

You'll have genuine influence over product decisions and the ownership to bring that thinking to market yourself.

We're looking for someone who enjoys both sides of product marketing: developing a strong point of view and doing hands-on work to bring it to life. You'll present strategies and go-to-market plans directly to executive leaders, including our CEO, and be expected to explain your recommendations, answer tough questions, and incorporate feedback. You'll also need to be comfortable working independently, navigating changing priorities, and taking projects from early ideas through execution and results.

What You’ll Do:

Shape product positioning and influence decisions

  • Bring customer and market insights into product decisions. Analyze customer research, feedback, competitive trends, and product data to identify opportunities and make recommendations to Product and Marketing leaders.
  • Own product positioning and messaging. Define who our products are for, the problems they solve, what makes them different, and how we communicate their value. Develop and maintain product narratives and messaging that other teams can use.
  • Partner with Product and Research early. Help identify important use cases, questions to investigate, and messaging to test as new products and features take shape, especially emerging AI capabilities.
  • Bring a clear point of view. Make thoughtful recommendations, explain the evidence and tradeoffs behind them, and work with stakeholders to reach decisions.

Lead go-to-market execution

  • Own launches from start to finish. Develop the go-to-market strategy for new products and major features, including the audience, messaging, channel plan, and success metrics.
  • Create the actual marketing work. When needed, write clear, compelling copy for product launches, including customer emails, website messaging, in-product education, demo scripts, and sales materials.
  • Drive execution across teams. Build launch briefs and project plans, coordinate with Lifecycle, Growth, Web, Brand, and other partners, and make sure deliverables get completed on time.
  • Keep teams informed and aligned. Maintain up-to-date messaging, launch documentation, and product updates so other teams know what's changing and how to communicate it.
  • Measure results and improve. Work with Product, Research, and Growth to understand campaign performance, product discovery, and adoption. Use what you learn to refine messaging and improve results.

Use AI to make product marketing more effective

  • Use AI regularly in your work. Apply AI tools to research, insight synthesis, content development, and other tasks to improve speed and quality.

  • Build reusable AI workflows. Find opportunities to automate repetitive work and create AI workflows that make PMM outputs (product positioning, messaging, and market insights) easier for other teams to access and use. Share what you build with the broader teams for consistent use.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of product marketing experience in SaaS (PLG or hybrid GTM preferred), with a track record of leading major launches and driving discovery and adoption of AI-features
  • Strategic and hands-on. You can develop a clear recommendation, build a plan around it, and personally do the work needed to deliver it. You've worked in environments where you owned both strategy and execution.
  • Strongcritical thinking and judgment: can zoom out from day-to-day product decisions to identify the bigger strategic questions, tradeoffs, and second-order impacts that need leadership discussion.
  • An excellent writer and storyteller. You can turn complex product concepts into simple, compelling, human language and have strong examples of messaging, launch copy, and other materials you've personally written (vs outsourcing copywriting entirely to AI).
  • An AI-native PMM with experience building AI workflows. You regularly use AI tools in your work and have built repeatable workflows that save time or improve quality. You can share specific examples of what you've built, how you use it, and the results.
  • A strong, reliable operator. You can manage several projects, keep cross-functional partners informed, meet commitments, and deliver high-quality work without needing extensive direction.
  • Collaborative and adaptable. You communicate clearly, seek and incorporate feedback, and are comfortable working through ambiguity and changing priorities on a small team.
  • Confident, resilient product marketer with a growth mindset who stays steady under pressure: able to navigate ambiguity, competing opinions, and changing priorities without losing momentum, conviction or confidence.
  • Executive-ready communicator: can hold the room, communicate clearly, and advocate effectively up and across the org. You also know when to back off and listen, go back to the drawing board. You are comfortable engaging in healthy debate (you can disagree, commit, and move on); you don’t freeze when decisions are imperfect or your POV is questioned.

Bonus Points

  • Experience positioning and launching AI-powered products and features.
  • Experience marketing to both self-serve and enterprise customers.
  • Experience with product-led growth, lifecycle marketing, and in-product adoption campaigns.
  • Experience working on early-stage products, from initial customer validation through launch.
  • Experience with product analytics, project management, and AI automation tools.

What’s in it for you?

Calendly is at an inflection point: millions of people rely on us, and we’re building the next exciting chapter of our platform. You'll join a small team with meaningful ownership, direct access to Product and Marketing leaders, and opportunities to shape how we introduce new products and AI capabilities to customers.

If you enjoy developing the strategy and doing the work to make it happen, this role offers plenty of opportunity to do both.

Tier 1 Salary Hiring Range
$187,272—$220,320 USD
Tier 2 Salary Hiring Range
$171,666—$201,960 USD
Tier 3 Salary Hiring Range

The ranges listed above are the expected annual base salary for this role, subject to change.

Calendly takes a number of factors into consideration when determining an employee’s starting salary, including relevant experience, relevant skills sets, interview performance, location/metropolitan area, and internal pay equity.

Base salary is just one component of Calendly’s total rewards package. All full-time (30 hours/week) employees are also eligible for equity awards, and competitive benefits. Eligible Sales employees also qualify for a Sales Incentive program.

Calendly uses the zip code of an employee’s remote work location, or the onsite building location if hybrid, to determine which metropolitan pay range we use. Current geographic zones are as follows:

We are looking for a detail-oriented and tech-savvy Data & Systems Administratorto support product, customer, pricing, and e-commerce data maintenance across business systems.
This role is ideal for a professional who enjoys working with data, learning new technologies, and ensuring information is accurate and up to date.
You will assist with SAP maintenance, e-commerce platform support, data quality checks, system testing, reporting, and process documentation.
Training and development opportunities are available for candidates who demonstrate strong digital skills, logical thinking, and a willingness to learn.
Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain accurate product, customer, and approved pricing information in SAP and related business systems.
  • Assist with new product creation, product updates, lifecycle changes, data validation, and exception reporting.
  • Support customer account setup, onboarding, product catalogue updates, and routine queries on the e-commerce platform.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in data administration, master data management, product administration, pricing administration, or a similar administrative role.
  • Strong Excelskills, including data validation, sorting, filtering, lookups, and preparing basic reports.
  • Proven ability to maintain accurate records, identify missing information, correct inconsistencies, and perform data quality checks.
  • Experience updating product information, customer records, price lists, and effective or expiry dates.
  • Experience using SAP/ERP systems, CRM or E-Commerce platforms is a great plus.

Work Environment & Expectations

raw.description:
Position Overview

The Librarian manages and supports digital library operations in support of the institution's academic mission. Under the direction of the Dean, this position provides research assistance, maintains digital library resources, supports information literacy efforts, and ensures access to learning materials for students, faculty, and staff. The Librarian is responsible for delivering high-quality service and support while fostering student success in a virtual learning environment.

Pay range: $23.00 - $26.00 an hour


What You'll Do

  • Maintains a welcoming and accessible virtual library environment that supports online students, faculty, and staff
  • Oversees digital library operations and online service delivery; provides guidance and support regarding library policies, procedures, and available resources
  • Assists students, faculty, and other patrons through virtual research support, answering questions, troubleshooting issues, and providing instruction on library resources and services
  • Manages and organizes digital library resources to ensure they are easily accessible and available to users
  • Processes and maintains digital library materials, databases, and electronic resources to ensure accurate access and discoverability
  • Monitors inventory and licensing of digital resources and coordinates with vendors or internal departments as needed
  • Maintains library databases and online resource platforms; updates records, compiles usage data, and prepares reports on library services and resource utilization

What You'll Bring

  • Monitors and supports library-related technology and online learning resources; coordinates troubleshooting with appropriate support teams as needed
  • Coordinates virtual tutoring and academic support resources as needed
  • Assists with remote testing support as needed
  • Collaborates with faculty and academic departments to support curriculum needs, instructional resources, and student success initiatives
  • Participates in virtual campus events, orientations, and student engagement activities as needed
  • Reports student concerns or issues to the Dean and Program Director

Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities

Education / Experience

  • Master's degree in Library and Information Science (MLIS) or Master of Information Science (MIS) (required; required where bachelor's programs are offered)
  • Knowledge of library systems, procedures, and academic library services (preferred)
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience and demonstrated skills in virtual library services, online database research, digital resource management, and support of students and faculty in a remote learning environment (preferred)
  • Familiarity with Learning Resource Center (LRC) resources, online library resources, and reference interview techniques (preferred)
  • Broad knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, including Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and internet-based technologies (preferred)
  • Experience troubleshooting basic computer and technology-related issues (preferred)

Skills

  • Apply knowledge and skills to complete tasks with minimal supervision
  • Identify straightforward problems and recommend potential solutions
  • Communicate clearly and effectively with peers and stakeholders
  • Demonstrate active listening and empathy in interactions
  • Participate in presentations or facilitate small group discussions
  • Manage multiple tasks in a dynamic environment
  • Use productivity software and collaboration tools with confidence
  • Show initiative and accountability for assigned outcomes
  • Perform routine tasks and seek guidance for new situations
  • Make timely decisions that keep the organization moving forward
  • Apply effective and efficient processes with a focus on continuous improvement
  • Build open and comfortable relationships with diverse groups
  • Learn actively from both successes and failures while solving new problems

Abilities: requirements are categorized by frequency of activity during the workday.

Standard Abilities

  • Able and willing to:
    • Communicate, think, learn, and reason
    • Use computers and computer systems (including hardware and software) to process transactions, store documents, enter data, or perform assigned tasks
    • Safely ambulate and/or maneuver when on-site at Company locations
    • Demonstrate and utilize active listening, inductive reasoning, information ordering and category flexibility
  • Ability to use good judgment, problem-solving and decision-making skills
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and manage sensitive information with discretion
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment where deadlines are essential and multiple projects are worked simultaneously
  • Ability to gain, understand and apply information and data as it relates essential functions of the position
  • Ability to foster long-term relationships with stakeholders

About Us

Universal Technical Institute, Inc. is a national leader in workforce solutions for transportation, skilled trades and healthcare/dental. Across our two brands, Universal Technical Institute (UTI) and Concorde Career Colleges, we share a common purpose: to prepare students for careers in high-demand fields. Just as we invest in our students’ futures, we invest in our people by creating opportunities to grow, contribute and build rewarding careers while making a lasting difference in the lives of students, employers and the communities we serve.

At Phasor, we're focused on the big picture and the small details.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of Quanta Services, we provide engineering and design services across transmission & distribution, substations, protection & control, geomatics, civil & structural design, telecommunications, panel fabrication, and the testing and commissioning of medium and high-voltage electrical infrastructure.

Be part of a team that delivers projects from conceptual engineering and detailed design through construction support, commissioning, and startup. Built on technical excellence, collaboration, and a commitment to safety and quality, we take on complex challenges together.

The Opportunity

We're looking for an Intermediate Electrical Engineer - Substation to join our growing engineering team.

In this role, you will support the design and engineering of high-voltage substation projects, contributing to all phases of project execution from concept development and detailed design through construction support, commissioning, and startup.

If you enjoy solving technical challenges, working alongside experienced engineers, and building your expertise across a variety of utility and industrial projects, this role offers meaningful work, diverse project exposure, and opportunities for continued professional growth. #phasorinclusive

What You'll Do

  • Prepare and develop outdoor substation design packages for voltage levels ranging from 25 kV to 240 kV, including layouts, plot plans, bus elevations, grounding systems, cable layouts, and control building electrical design
  • Perform engineering calculations and studies, including grounding, lightning protection, lighting, AC/DC load studies, station service transformer and battery bank sizing, insulation coordination, rigid bus studies, and MV cable ampacity calculations using CYMCAP
  • Support the development of equipment, apparatus, and material specifications
  • Review vendor drawings and technical documentation for compliance with project requirements
  • Develop and maintain bills of materials for substation projects
  • Coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams to support integrated project delivery
  • Provide engineering support during construction and commissioning activities
  • Collect, organize, and interpret project engineering and vendor information
  • Assist in the development and continuous improvement of engineering standards, procedures, and best practices
  • Resolve technical issues and support project teams in delivering high-quality engineering solutions

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering
  • Registered or eligible for registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) with APEGA or another Canadian professional engineering association
  • 4-8 years of high-voltage substation engineering experience
  • Strong understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals and power system design principles
  • Experience with outdoor substation design and engineering deliverables
  • Familiarity with construction support and commissioning activities
  • Working knowledge of Canadian electrical codes and standards, including CEC, CSA, AEUC, and OESC
  • Experience with CYMCAP or similar engineering analysis software is considered an asset
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams and manage multiple priorities

Expected annual salary:$100,000-$140,000 (actual compensation may vary based on qualifications, experience, and current market conditions).

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering
  • Registered or eligible for registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) with APEGA or another Canadian professional engineering association
  • 4-8 years of high-voltage substation engineering experience
  • Strong understanding of electrical engineering fundamentals and power system design principles
  • Experience with outdoor substation design and engineering deliverables
  • Familiarity with construction support and commissioning activities

Benefits

Why Phasor Engineering

At Phasor Engineering, you'll have the opportunity to be part of some of North America's most complex utility, industrial, and infrastructure projects while collaborating with a highly skilled multidisciplinary team. We offer a supportive and entrepreneurial environment where innovation, professional growth, and teamwork are valued.

As part of Quanta Services, you'll benefit from the resources and stability of an industry leader while maintaining the agility and culture of a growing engineering consultancy.

Whether you're looking to deepen your expertise, take on new challenges, or advance your career, you'll find opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

We offer:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Comprehensive health, dental, vision, life, and disability benefits
  • RRSP matching
  • Paid time off, wellness programs, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

Phasor Engineering is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse workforce. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds. We thank everyone for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates.

As an AI Engineer, you'll design, build, evaluate, and deploy intelligent systems combining Large Language Models, retrieval architectures, AI agents, and enterprise integrations.

You'll own AI behavior, quality, and reliability while collaborating with Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Architects, and Governance specialists.

You're a hands-on engineer who understands that successful AI goes beyond model performance. You combine strong software engineering fundamentals with practical problem-solving, technical judgment, and a focus on reliable, measurable business outcomes.

🛠️ What you bring

Experience

Technical skills

Local benefits and working arrangements will be confirmed before publication.

At Keyrus, we help organizations move from experimental AI to industrialized AI, from isolated agents to orchestrated systems, and from insight to execution.

Powered by our proprietary Human Orchestrated Model™ (HOM), we build intelligent environments around three pillars: Intelligence Foundations, Human in Command, and Performance Steering.

raw.description:
About Surefire Cyber

Surefire Cyber is redefining the incident response model by delivering a swifter, stronger response to cyber incidents such as ransomware, email compromise, malware, data theft, and other threats. Our client-centric approach reduces stress and provides clients the confidence needed to prepare, respond, and recover from cyber incidents – and fortify their cyber resilience after an event.

Surefire Cyber’s approach and delivery are designed by industry veterans who have worked shoulder-to ­shoulder with law firms, insurance carriers, brokers, law enforcement, and impacted organizations in responding to cyber incidents. We are marshaling this experience to address the industry’s persistent challenges of efficiency, predictability, and transparency.

Job Title: Senior Consultant, Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR)

Location: Remote, USA / Exempt

What Makes You Stand Out

You are an experienced cybersecurity professional with advanced knowledge in the specialty of Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR). You have former client-facing, forensic analysis, and investigation experience. Your passion lies in identifying, analyzing, and mitigating security incidents, demonstrating a solid grasp of the ever-evolving threat landscape.

You have a proven track record of conducting forensic analysis and have worked independently on small to medium investigations. You approach investigations with analytical proficiency, and an experienced perspective, while consistently yielding high quality results.

How You'll Make An Impact

Surefire Cyber is actively seeking a Senior Consultant for our dynamic Digital Forensics and Incident Response team. This opportunity is a full-time position remote opportunity on our team that embraces a collaborative environment, a competitive salary, equity in the company, excellent benefits, and fosters continuous professional development.

In this role, you will represent Surefire Cyber as a skilled technical and consulting resource for clients across diverse industries during active incident response engagements. You will leverage your experience and technical skills to detect and analyze intrusions and offer guidance to clients to navigate through high-pressure response situations with clear communication and after-hours support as needed.

Your Role In Action

  • Demonstrate a commitment to learning and contribute valuable insights, actively seeking guidance when necessary.
  • Contribute to client-facing incident response engagements, working with other team members to guide clients through the entire incident response lifecycle from detection to recovery.
  • Conduct advanced forensic analysis to precisely identify the scope and impact of security incidents, including malware analysis and reverse engineering when necessary.
  • Lead the forensic investigations on small to medium investigations such as Business Email Compromises and Ransomware engagements, leveraging the expertise of Engagement Leads and Principal Consultants on advanced and more complex investigations.
  • Provide mentorship and assist less experienced team members by sharing your knowledge and expertise to help others grow in their roles.
  • Identify, articulate, and explain attack vectors, threat tactics, and attacker techniques to guide mitigation and prevention efforts.
  • Convey complex forensic findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders clearly and understandably.
  • Provide comprehensive supporting evidence for written reports detailing incident findings, and analysis.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, external partners, and clients to refine and document incident response processes and best practices.
  • Engage in research and development activities to stay up to date with the latest forensic tools, techniques, and methodologies.
  • Contribute to the development of internal processes and support broader organizational initiatives.
  • Provide after-hours (on-call/weekend rotational) support as required to address critical incidents and maintain continuous coverage.

Your Expertise

  • Experience in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, related degree, industry certifications, or former professional experience as a Senior Forensic Consultant, Senior Cybersecurity Consultant, or as a Senior Incident Responder.
  • Proficiency in common digital forensic artifacts and tools such as ELK, Axiom, Encase, FTK (Forensic Toolkit), Open-Source, or other comparable tools.
  • Professional experience with network analysis and intrusion detection tools.
  • In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity principles and best practices.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure, manage multiple competing priorities, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Eagerness to mentor, share, and expand knowledgebase.
  • Ability to provide after-hours (on-call/weekend rotational) support as required to address critical incidents and maintain continuous coverage.

Expertise in all these areas is not required, but you should be excited by the opportunity to learn new things and comfortable with working with other team members to expand your knowledge base and experience. We at Surefire Cyber invite you to apply even if you do not feel you have mastery in all the requirements listed on the job description and welcome a further discussion.

Interview Process

  • Submit Application on our website
  • Preliminary phone interview with the People Team (approx., 30 minutes)
  • Technical Virtual interview with Forensic Team (approx., 60 minutes)
  • Virtual interview with Chief Delivery Officer and an Engagement Lead (approx., 45 minutes)
  • Virtual interview with CEO (approx., 30 minutes)

Benefits for Full-Time Surefire Cyber Team Members

  • Competitive compensation plan and equity for all team members
  • Remote workforce
  • Generous paid time off plan and floating holidays
  • Employer paid premiums for both team members and their dependents for medical, dental, and vision
  • Comprehensive health, vision, dental, 401K matching program, disability, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA), Life and AD&D benefits.
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development and career advancement opportunities
  • We prioritize employee growth and development through a robust performance management platform to provide ongoing coaching, clear feedback, recognition, and opportunities for career growth

Surefire Cyber is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex, or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

raw.excerpt: Why EntersektFounded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks.
raw.description:
Why Entersekt

Founded over 16 years ago, with more recent investments from Accel-KKR, Entersekt is a leader in digital banking fraud prevention and payment security, including mobile authentication, mobile app security, and 3D Secure authentication for issuers, acquirers and payment networks. We offer highly scalable products with a track record of success across multiple continents.

Entersekt enables secure digital transactions for leading financial institutions globally. We exist to create a world where everyone can transact digitally without fear or compromise. Currently, we protect the digital transactions of over 210 million active users on our platform and hold 120 active patents that recognize innovation in digital security, payments, and user experience. Entersekt offers customers secure authentication and digital payments experiences that remove unnecessary friction. Entersekt has a diverse product portfolio and aggressive roadmap that positions the company well to sustain competitive advantage as it expands globally with emphasis on North America and European markets.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a strategic and commercially minded product leader who combines strong platform thinking with a relentless focus on adoption and business value. You’re comfortable operating across product, technology and commercial considerations, turning complex and sometimes competing needs into clear priorities and scalable platform solutions.

You build credibility quickly and influence effectively across teams, including where you don’t have direct authority. You’re equally comfortable shaping strategy with senior leaders, making tough roadmap and investment trade-offs, and developing a high-performing product team.

The Role

Owns the end-to-end success of the Platform components, as a horizontal capability that other portfolio solutions build on and consume. Accountable not just for the health of the platform components individually, but for the penetration and value they deliver when embedded across the broader portfolio. Success is measured as much by cross-portfolio adoption as by each component’s standalone quality.

Responsibilities

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and business performance for the Entersekt Platform including Portal, Administration, Reporting, Detection & Decisioning capabilities.
  • Set the product vision for how these & future components serve as reusable building blocks rather than siloed products
  • Partner with your Pier GMs to drive an explicit adoption strategy and targets for each component across all portfolio solutions (e.g., % of solutions integrated, active usage within each solution, time-to-integrate) and identify evolving needs that should be served via reusable platform components
  • Remove adoption blockers - technical debt, integration friction, packaging/pricing barriers, or lack of awareness - that slow uptake
  • Build the internal "go-to-market" motion for the platform itself: enablement, documentation, migration support, and success stories that make adoption easy for other product teams
  • Balance platform roadmap decisions against the sometimes-competing needs of multiple consuming product lines - arbitrating trade-offs transparently
  • Own cost, investment, and value-capture model for the platform
  • Define and track health metrics per component (usage, reliability, performance, satisfaction)
  • Build and lead product management (and potentially design/eng-partnership) for the three components
  • Represent Platform in executive/portfolio planning forums

Skills and Experience

Successful candidates for this role will generally possess the following qualifications and experience:

what are the main performance objectives in this role?

We're a fast-moving, international team of around 80 people and we're looking for our next AdOps Team Lead! This role sits at the heart of our Ops function, leading our AdOps team (4 members) and working directly with our COO to keep campaigns running smoothly across a complex ecosystem of OEM partners, MMPs, and direct clients.

As our AdOps Team Lead, you'll own campaign quality and technical delivery end-to-end, while leading and developing the team responsible for execution. Concretely, that means:

  • Leading and mentoring a team of AdOps specialists, overseeing workload distribution and quality of output
  • Running campaign QA, link testing, and launch readiness checks (ensuring nothing goes live with issues)
  • Leading new partner integrations with Everflow and other performance platforms
  • Handling escalations and troubleshooting queries from clients, media partners, and MMPs, from discrepancy investigations to tracking failures
  • Keeping our attribution setup tight (postback URLs, S2S tracking, deep-linking, and MMP configuration)
  • Being the technical go-to for the business teams when things don't add up
  • Partnering with the COO on process improvements and team performance
  • Owning / monitoring the support ticket board + SLAs and proactively resolving issues with the rest of the AdOps team

what are the strengths, transferable skills, and behaviors that drive success in this role?

  • Experience Digital Ad Operations within the mobile advertising ecosystem (OEM, programmatic, or performance marketing), including prior experience leading or mentoring a team
  • Solid knowledge of MMP platforms: AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, Branch - ideally with existing contacts at these partners for direct escalation when needed
  • Strong grasp of attribution mechanics (S2S tracking, postback URLs, deep-linking)
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot delivery issues: discrepancies, latency, tracking failures, reporting mismatches
  • Experience owning campaign setup, QA, and launch using standard AdOps tooling
  • Comfortable managing team workload and priorities in a fast-paced environment

Nice-to-haves (valuable, but not required):

  • Familiarity with Google Tag Manager and mobile web campaigns
  • Hands-on experience with S2S postbacks on Everflow, Affise, or similar platforms
  • Knowledge of iOS attribution: SKAN, Apple's App Tracking Transparency (ATT) framework
  • Experience identifying and resolving discrepancies between internal dashboards and OEM/MMP reporting
  • Coming from an MMP

Two notes before you apply:

  1. We know that individuals who identify as women, trans, or non-binary tend to hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet almost all the requirements. If that resonates with you, we want to be clear: we're more interested in your potential than your ability to tick every box. Apply anyway.

  2. On compensation: At AVOW, pay is structured around a clear grade and level framework, with decisions based on objective criteria: your experience, qualifications, scope of responsibility, and role-specific requirements. We're transparent about how we make these decisions and will be discussing the details from our very first engagement.

what does our hiring process look like?

  1. Intro call: A casual conversation with our TA team. We'll tell you about the role and the team; you tell us about yourself.

  2. Deep dive: A transparent conversation with your future hiring manager about the role, what success looks like, and where the team is headed.

  3. Problem solving & presentation: You'll work through a real AdOps challenge and walk us through your thinking.

  4. Meet the team (optional): An informal coffee chat with a potential future colleague. No agenda, just people.

what do we offer?

  • Long-term growth:

    • Learning & development budget

    • An experienced, innovative, diverse team

    • Sabbatical policy

  • Health & Wellbeing:

    • Health insurance for you and your family

We're looking forward to hearing from you!

Our Newest Opportunity:

OneDigital is looking for a Senior Compensation Analyst to own the data, processes, and cycles that keep our pay programs accurate and running smoothly. This is an independent, internal-facing role split evenly between analysis and hands-on process ownership. You will serve as the subject matter expert and administrator for our merit, bonus, and promotion cycles, and you will help shape how we use new compensation technology and AI tools. This role reports into the People Technology and Innovation function.


What You'll Do

  • Own salary survey submissions, including data cleanup, validation, and market pricing using multiple market survey sources.
  • Administer the merit, bonus, and promotion cycles end to end, from planning, configuration, and testing through data loads, communications support, and post-cycle audits.
  • Test new compensation functionality, including system releases, new modules, and merit-cycle configuration, and partner with HRIS on validation and rollout.
  • Pilot, validate, and manage AI tools for compensation work, reviewing outputs for accuracy, managing prompts, workflows, and agents, and ensuring appropriate use.
  • Deliver ongoing compensation analysis, market pricing, and offer and pay recommendations that help leaders make sound decisions.
  • Build costing and cost models that give leaders a clear view of the impact of pay decisions.
  • Partner with HRIS, Payroll, Talent Management, and HR colleagues to resolve issues and keep pay programs running smoothly.
  • Document processes and recommend improvements that make our compensation practices more accurate, efficient, and scalable.

  • You are an advanced Excel user, comfortable with lookups, pivots, data manipulation, and large data sets.
  • You bring analytical rigor and close attention to detail, and you can explain your findings clearly to HR partners and business leaders.
  • You use AI tools effectively and critically, getting real value from them while verifying outputs and applying sound judgment.
  • You take ownership of processes, manage competing deadlines during cycle periods, and work well with cross-functional partners.

This role gives you real ownership of high-visibility compensation cycles and a direct hand in how AI and new system capabilities change the way compensation work gets done. You will work with a high degree of independence, and your analysis will directly inform pay decisions across the organization. If you want to build better processes as well as run them, you will find plenty of room to make your mark and grow your expertise here.

This includes using AI to filter candidates based on their qualifications and to rediscover potential candidates from our existing applicant pool. Our AI systems help us efficiently identify the best fit for our open positions, ensuring a streamlined and effective hiring experience. However, AI does not replace the humans in our process. If you have concerns about our use of AI, you may opt out where laws allow.


If you have questions about our hiring policies and practices, we would be happy to discuss upon receiving your application. We hope to welcome you to OneDigital and look forward to hearing from you.

Thank you for your interest in joining the OneDigital team!

raw.description:
Clinical Pharmacist

Job Purpose:

Provide integrated support to patients and physicians by providing a "hands-on" approach to improve the quality of patient care. This is accomplished by developing personalized relationships with patients and prescribers to improve medication adherence and promote evidence-based care.

Salary: An employee in this position who performs the job duties in Oregon can expect a salary rate between $125,000-$145,000 (Hourly Equivalent: Approximately $60.00-$69.71 per hour, based on a 40-hour workweek.) plus bonus pursuant to the terms of an any bonus plan if applicable. The actual salary will depend on experience, geographic location, and other factors permitted by law.

What You’ll Get:

  • $10,000 Sign-on Bonus
  • Salary + Bonus
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance starting day one
  • 401(k) with match, 4 weeks PTO, 10 paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave, short-term disability, and professional development
  • Access to employee resource groups and wellness programs

Job Duties:

  • Reviewing and interpreting clinician's patient care note/assessments for supportive clinical data needed for prior authorization approvals and development of care plan recommendations.
  • Develop and refine disease and drug specific clinical protocol to maximize patient adherence and promote evidence-based cost-effective care.
  • Monitor on-going patient adherence (PDC reports, patient assessment data, and mobile platform data) across all sites and disease categories with focus on oncology and other specialty specific disease states.
  • Evaluation of EMR to review: drug and disease interaction, medication selection, labs/vitals, allergies, RX orders/renewals and direct MD communication, and other relevant information important to maximize medication adherence and optimize patient outcomes.
  • Recommending alternative therapeutic drug regimens and disease specific treatments according to guidelines as appropriate.
  • Monitor and evaluate therapies for side effects or other medication related issues, recommend drug therapy changes to prescribers as appropriate.
  • Medication therapy management (MTM): including reviewing and monitoring of medication regimens, advising clinicians on evidence based therapy as indicated, documenting interventions; assessing patient adherence rates.
  • Clinical interventions including but are not limited to comprehensive pharmacist consultation, motivational interviewing/coaching, drug regimen optimization, medication reconciliation, medication lists or reminders, medication synchronization, coordinate home nurse visits, transitions between liaison/PSC, use of mobile app or other technologies.
  • Productivity monitoring and reporting weekly stats for growth development
  • Overseeing tech's daily activities and verification for accuracy on: delivery coordination slips, prior authorizations submitted, ongoing PA log activity and proactive management care utilization within each specialty as per protocol.
  • Identifying and resolving insurance related issues, recognizing situations where financial assistance can be applied.
  • Supervising communication of support personnel compliant with HIPPA rules and regulations;
  • Maintaining current registration and all remote pharmacist activity to comply with local, state and federal drug laws as regulated by each state board of pharmacy and the DEA.
  • Direct communication with other health professionals as necessary regarding patient care;
  • Develops own knowledge by participating in education programs; training pharmacy staff, students, interns, externs, and health care professionals;
  • Manage, organize, and update relevant data using database applications;
  • Apply observations and recommendations to operational issues, increased productivity, quality, and customer-service standards;
  • Assist with research projects and peer reviewing articles as needed.
  • Identify trends, resolves problems; recommend improvements; implements change;
  • Actively participates in process improvement initiatives;
  • Protects organization's value by keeping information confidential;
  • Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations;
  • Willing to do whatever is necessary for the betterment of the Company;
  • Other duties as assigned;

Skills: Analyze information, exercise good judgment, possess strong verbal and written communication skills, have deep knowledge of specialty medication pharmacology, local/state/federal pharmacy regulations, able to manage processes, exhibit strong technical and clinical skills, excellent leader and manager of people, constant focus on legal compliance, highly productive, quality focused and attention to detail. Must be computer literate with proficiency and working knowledge of database and reporting tools such as: Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.(***Knowledge using EPIC/QS1/WILLOW software a plus***) Must have the ability to identify barriers to medication adherence and implement and monitor plans to improve medication adherence. The ability to motivate and coach patients to help them achieve better outcomes and identify goals of therapy.

Traits: Organized, high-integrity, attention to detail, dependable, quality focus, empathetic, good listener/communicator

Other: Energetic, highly motivated, team player with strong personal and communication skills; discretion and confidentiality essential as position deals with highly sensitive and private data

Specialties: Knowledge of complex/chronic diseases states and therapies used within specialty pharmacy: Oncology, Transplant, Hepatitis C, Infectious Disease (including HIV), Multiple Sclerosis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, GI disorders (including IBD), Cystic Fibrosis, Psoriasis, Hyperlipidemia and many various inflammatory conditions (including Lupus) preferred.

Experience/ Education:

Required Licensure/Certification: Applicant must hold a Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) or equivalent advanced degree and be a licensed Pharmacist in state of Oregon

Years of Experience: 1+ years' experience is strongly preferred but not required. Should additional licensure need to be obtained, the applicant will commit to obtaining the required licensure within a mutually agreed upon timeframe. Continued employment is contingent upon meeting these requirements.

Education: PharmD or equivalent advanced degree required

By providing your mobile number, you agree to receive text messages from Shields Health Solutions related to job opportunities, interview scheduling, and recruiting updates. Message and data rates may apply. You may opt out at any time by replying 'STOP.' Consent is not a condition of employment.

Solid computer skills are required, including proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) for communication, documentation, and data management, as well as, navigating the internet and web-based platforms. Data entry and computer skills will be evaluated through an assessment as part of the pre-employment process.
