raw.excerpt: Treasure AI:Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers.
raw.description:
Treasure AI:

Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers. Powered by AI, Treasure AI is shaped by human creativity and always-on through continuous, context-driven action.

Furthermore, Treasure AI employees are enthusiastic, data-driven, and customer-obsessed. We are a team of drivers—self-starters who take initiative, anticipate needs, and proactively jump in to solve problems. Our actions reflect our values of honesty, reliability, openness, and humility.

Your Role:

Treasure AI is hiring a Security Engineer, GRC to architect, build, and automate the systems that power our Trust & Assurance (T&A) program. The right person for this role gets frustrated by manual compliance work — not because it's beneath them, but because they know it doesn't have to exist.

This role sits at the intersection of security engineering and GRC. You will design, operate, and maintain the systems that make compliance continuous, visible in real-time, and GRC insights actionable. You will treat the GRC platform as a programmable surface, extend it via APIs and agent workflows, and integrate it with the rest of Treasure AI's tech stack.

You will work closely with GRC Specialists, taking program requirements and translating them into technical implementations — automations, integrations, dashboards, guardrails, and tooling. You will also work directly with Security, IT, Engineering, and Product teams to embed compliance into the systems and pipelines they already use.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation. You will use agentic tools to accelerate your own work and will build AI-powered automations into GRC workflows — from evidence ingestion to questionnaire response to executive reporting.

Responsibilities & Duties:

  • Build AI agent workflows (using Claude, MCP integrations, or similar) to automate repeatable GRC tasks.

  • Configure and maintain the technical configuration and extension of our GRC platform — architect data relationships, configure control workflows, build custom rules, and extend the platform via APIs and webhooks rather than relying on the default UI.

  • Build automated executive readout workflows so monthly and quarterly GRC reporting is a 30-minute review, not a multi-day build.

  • Design and operate automated evidence collection pipelines and continuous control monitoring — pulling signals directly from source systems in real time so drift is surfaced before audit time, not during it.

  • Translate controls into testable, codified checks. Identify gaps in compliance coverage across CI/CD pipelines and IaC (Terraform) and contribute compliance logic where gaps exist.

  • Embed lightweight compliance checkpoints into design review workflows, ensuring control-relevant changes are flagged before deployment.

  • Support FAIR-informed quantitative risk modeling with data pipelines and tooling that make risk scenarios computable rather than narrative-only.

  • Build and maintain automation for the TPRM lifecycle — vendor intake, risk scoring, questionnaire distribution, evidence analysis, and remediation tracking — using AI-assisted tooling to reduce per-vendor manual effort.

  • Build tooling and dashboards that give the GRC Specialist and business stakeholders a continuous view of privileged access, access exceptions, and open remediation items — replacing point-intime UAR reports with an always-on IGA posture.

  • Build and maintain automation across the customer trust surface — AI-assisted questionnaire response pipelines, RFP contribution workflows, and trust center content management — so customer assurance accelerates deals rather than bottlenecking them.

  • Build automation across the security awareness and training lifecycle — detecting end-user risk signals or policy violations to improve the culture of security.

Required Qualifications:

  • At least 3+ years in Security Engineering, DevSecOps, Technical GRC, or a closely adjacent function — with a demonstrably strong engineering track record in automation and tooling, not just program ownership.

  • Strong coding foundation: proficient in Python and/or TypeScript, comfortable calling REST APIs, handling JSON/YAML payloads, building webhooks, and shipping integrations from scratch without hand-holding or assistance. You treat Jira, Confluence, Slack, and similar enterprise tools as systems to integrate with, not just UIs to click through.

  • Hands-on experience building automation and integrations in enterprise environments — not just configuring OOTB features, but writing code to extend or connect systems.

  • Practical hands-on experience with a modern GRC platform (Vanta, anecdotes, Drata, Secureframe, or similar) — you've configured custom workflows, written rules, and used the APIs; not just the UI.

  • Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001/17/18, ISO 42001 and HIPAA — enough to read a control and determine how to test it programmatically.

  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI-assisted automation: agent workflows, prompt pipelines, LLM-integrated integrations, or similar. Comfort with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent).

  • Familiarity with the AWS security control surface (IAM, CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty) and how to consume compliance signals via API; working knowledge of CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions or similar) and IaC (Terraform or equivalent) — you understand where compliance checks can be embedded in a deployment pipeline.

  • Strong collaboration and written communication skills — able to work across multiple Security domains, IT, Engineering, Legal/Privacy, and GTM, and able to write clear technical documentation.

Travel Requirements:

Annual team on-site in the US/CAN (total travel: <10%)

Perks and Benefits (US):

Our benefit package showcases our culture of care and empathy with

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision plans and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Competitive compensation packages

  • Company paid life insurance 3x salary

  • Company paid short- and long-term disability coverage

  • Retirement planning (401K) with 4% company match

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSU)

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)

  • Up to 26 weeks paid parental leave including a post-partum night nurse

  • Comprehensive support and access to care for everyone, everywhere through Carrot - our global reproductive health and family-building benefit.

Our Dedication to You:

We value and promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our business and at all levels. Success comes from acknowledging, welcoming, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Diverse representation alone is not the desired outcome. We also strive to create an inclusive culture that encourages growth, ownership of your role, and achieving innovation in new and unique ways. Your voice will be heard, and we will help amplify it.

Agencies and Recruiters:

We cannot consider your candidate(s) without a contract in place. Any resumes received without having an active agreement will be considered gratis referrals to us. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation!

This description captures the core of the role today. As we adopt AI and new ways of working, responsibilities may evolve, and we encourage team members to take initiative, lean into change, and help expand the impact of their role beyond what’s listed here.

title: Plastic & Material Science Intern
description: World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a Plastic & Material Science Intern with demonstrated skills in technical writing, research and analysis, project management, and stakeholder engagement.

raw.title: Plastic & Material Science Intern
raw.excerpt: World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a Plastic & Material Science Intern with demonstrated skills in technical writing, research and analysis, project management, and stakeholder engagement.
raw.description:
World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a Plastic & Material Science Intern with demonstrated skills in technical writing, research and analysis, project management, and stakeholder engagement. The intern will work closely with members of WWF’s Private Sector Engagement department on the Plastic & Material Science team, specifically on projects related to biobased and biodegradable materials, alternative materials, and responsible feedstock sourcing.

WWF believes we need to reimagine how we source, design, reuse, and dispose of the plastic materials communities most depend on. We need holistic systems change that includes reduction, reuse, substitution of materials, recycling, and better waste management. To do this, we need to use less plastic, make the plastic that we do use better, and ensure that it gets used more than once—creating circularity. WWF’s approach to tackling global plastic pollution unites a global network of industry leaders, policymakers, and the public to transform our systems so the plastics we discard can become plastics we use again. The intern will support WWF's Bioplastic Feedstock Alliance efforts, where we are advancing thought leadership on responsibly sourced biobased plastic, so companies are equipped with the best science and sourcing practices as they shift to sustainable inputs for their new plastic needs.

This internship provides an opportunity to engage with business stakeholders, improve research, analysis, and project coordination skills in a professional setting, gain knowledge about supply chains and sourcing, corporate sustainability, public policy, and environmental issues, and contribute to WWF’s mission. The work will involve research, technical writing, and project management in support of programs that address plastic pollution. 

Responsibilities

  • Support technical writing and content development for sustainability initiatives within the Plastic & Material Science team.

  • Conduct research and analysis on environmental performance, supply chain risks, and emerging trends related to materials and packaging.

  • Analyze alternative materials, product applications, and policy measures relevant to sustainable materials and plastics.

  • Contribute to project management and administrative coordination across team initiatives and partnerships.

  • Support stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration with internal and external partners.

  • Develop written materials and engagement assets by synthesizing technical information and aligning findings with WWF’s broader conservation mission.

  • Assist in planning and executing multi-stakeholder events, including coordination with external partners such as companies, NGOs, and WWF network offices.

Learning Outcomes

  • Develop project management and coordination skills through sustainability-focused initiatives and multi-stakeholder event planning.

  • Strengthen research and analytical abilities by assessing environmental performance and supply chain risks of recovered and biobased materials.

  • Enhance technical communication by producing reports, presentations, blogs, and other corporate engagement materials.

  • Gain exposure to corporate sustainability strategies and stakeholder engagement with companies, NGOs, and WWF offices.

  • Build foundational knowledge of environmental policy, circular economy, and commodity sourcing risks.

  • Experience professional collaboration in a mission-driven organization aligned with WWF’s core values of courage, respect, integrity, and collaboration.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Current student or recent graduate in a relevant field such as corporate sustainability, natural resources, material science, environmental science, or sustainable development are preferred; highly qualified undergraduate students may be considered. Those studying outside these areas are still highly encouraged to apply.

  • Ability to work full-time (35 hours per week) for 6 months is required.

  • Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team setting.

  • Excellent research, analytical, and professional communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and willingness to learn new platforms.

  • Preferred experience in managing research projects, engaging external collaborators, and familiarity with environmental impacts and corporate sustainability.

  • Preferred knowledge of topics related to circular systems, biobased plastic, alternative materials, agriculture, forestry, and climate.

  • Fluency in English is required.

  • Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values: Courage, Integrity, Respect, and Collaboration:

  • Demonstrates courage by speaking up even when it is difficult, or unpopular.

  • Builds trust with colleagues by acting with integrity, owning mistakes, and holding oneself accountable.

  • Welcomes other points of view and ideas, recognizing and embracing different and contrary perspectives with kindness, curiosity, and encouragement.

  • Makes conscious efforts to promote cooperative practices, behaviors, and ways of working across many groups and individuals.

  • Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values:

    • COURAGE – We demonstrate courage through our actions, we work for change where it’s needed, and we inspire people and institutions to tackle the greatest threats to nature and the future of the planet, which is our home.

    • INTEGRITY – We live the principles we call on others to meet. We act with integrity, accountability, and transparency, and we rely on facts and science to guide us and to ensure that we learn and evolve.

    • RESPECT – We honor the voices and knowledge of people and communities that we serve, and we work to secure their rights to a sustainable future.

    • COLLABORATION – We deliver impact at the scale of the challenges we face through the power of collective action and innovation.

US Remote – WWF employs in all states with the exception of: Hawaii, Kentucky, Nevada, Oklahoma.

Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.  In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

WWF does not provide VISA sponsorship to interns.

World Wildlife Fund (WWF) promotes equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals regardless of age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Founded in 1961, WWF works to help people and nature thrive. As a global conservation organization, WWF operates in more than 100 countries, partnering with communities, companies, and governments to protect wildlife, conserve vital habitats, and advance sustainable solutions. Grounded in science and driven by collaboration, WWF works to help nature by conserving biodiversity, supporting resilient communities, and addressing climate change. Nearly 1 million people in the United States and more than 5 million globally are WWF members.

ABOUT ADVANTMED

Advantmed is a leading provider of risk adjustment, quality improvement, and value-based solutions to health plans and providers. We drive market leading performance with integrated technology, service, and program solutions that improve the risk adjustment and quality programs of our partners. Our solutions focus on identifying, managing, and documenting risk and quality performance, and the proactive clinical engagement of high acuity populations.

Job Summary

The IHA Account Manager (PAM - Prospective Services Account Manager) is the client-facing operations subject matter expert for In-Home Health Assessment programs, from implementation through ongoing delivery. The PAM works with Operations, Planning, Implementation, and Client Success to meet client requirements, ensure delivery of production goals and SLAs, resolve escalations promptly, and manage process changes effectively. This is a non-sales individual contributor role.

Advantmed IHA Account Manager Overview -

Key Responsibilities

Client Communication

  • Support in new client implementation calls with clients as an Ops SME. Review requirements and liaise with Operations Teams on deliverables
  • Attend weekly client calls led by Client Success Team as an Ops SME on calls. This may be video calls via MS Teams.
  • Share production plans with clients and explain the reasons for any changes. Answer pertinent questions
  • Present IHA guidelines on client calls and answer related questions.
  • Support discussions related to the client portal, including queries, requested changes, and solutions.
  • Participate in discussions related to additional volume and liaise with internal teams as needed.

Service Delivery & Coordination

  • Address client service questions and escalations.
  • Support the complaint handling process, including closing the loop with clients.
  • Review project health and liaise with Operations when status is Amber or Red to develop a Plan of Action (POA). POA formulation is the responsibility of the Operations/Planning Team; presenting the POA to the client is the responsibility of the PAM.
  • Coordinate with Operations and support items critical to client SLAs.
  • Liaise with respective teams to manage client deliverables.
  • Monitor tasks to ensure timely close-looping with the client and Front Office.
  • Support the Process Change Request process by facilitating discussions with Operations and supporting solutioning once approved, including follow-up with Operations and communication with the PM/CE teams.
  • Participate in cross-functional OKRs and Initiatives led by various teams
  • Review all client-facing ad hoc reports prepared by the Planning Team to ensure they align with client needs.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Certification in Business Administration, Account Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience is an added advantage

Experience

  • Minimum of 2–3 years of Account Management (or similar) experience in the healthcare industry.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy requirements.
  • Experience working with Operations/multiple stake holders
  • Computer Savvy. Experience working with MS Excel, PowerPoint and other relevant tools
  • Experience managing SLAs, service health reporting (RAG status), and corrective action plans.
  • Project management or account management certification (e.g., PMP, CAPM) is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a commitment to exceptional customer service.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to analyze data and prepare basic reports.
  • Effective organization, time management, multitasking, and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a team.
  • Proactive, results-oriented approach with flexibility to adapt to evolving industry trends and client needs.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Proactive approach to Client Production Goals achievement
  • Adherence to client SLAs including client satisfaction
  • Timeliness of escalation and complaint resolution, including closing the loop with clients.
  • Timely closure of client action items and deliverables.
  • Achievement of IHA_AM and cross-functional OKRs.

Key Working Relationships

  • Internal: Operations, Planning, Implementation, PM/CE, Client Success, Sales, Marketing, Front Office, and Finance/Invoicing teams.
  • External: Client stakeholders, including program, operations, and quality contacts.

Benefits

The annual salary range for this position is $55,000 - $60,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications.

raw.description:
About Our Company:
At Infinx, we're a fast-growing company focused on delivering innovative technology solutions to meet our clients' needs. We partner with healthcare providers to leverage automation and intelligence, overcoming revenue cycle challenges and improving reimbursements for patient care. Our clients include physician groups, hospitals, pharmacies, and dental groups.
We're looking for experienced associates and partners with expertise in areas that align with our clients' needs. We value individuals who are passionate about helping others, solving challenges, and improving patient care while maximizing revenue. Diversity and inclusivity are central to our values, fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and heard.

A 2025 Great Place to Work®

In 2025, Infinx was certified as a Great Place to Work® in both the U.S. and India, underscoring our commitment to fostering a high-trust, high-performance workplace culture. This marks the fourth consecutive year that Infinx India has achieved certification and the first time the company has earned recognition in the U.S.

Location: Remote or Hybrid in Houston, TX or New Orleans, LA preferred

Summary Description

The Director – Revenue Cycle Operations serves as the Revenue Cycle Management domain lead within the Strategic Delivery function and is responsible for ensuring successful operational design, implementation, stabilization, and transition of strategic client engagements. The role provides deep functional expertise across billing, charge entry, payment posting, accounts receivable, denials, appeals, collections, and related back-end revenue cycle functions. Primary accountability includes translating contractual commitments and client expectations into executable operating models, validating workload and staffing assumptions, supporting operational readiness, resolving delivery challenges, and helping strategic engagements achieve defined service, quality, productivity, and financial outcomes. This position works closely with Customer Success, Onshore and Offshore Operations, Product, Technology, Quality, Training, Compliance, and client stakeholders. Direct ownership of routine steady-state production is not the primary focus. Strategic Delivery involvement will typically extend from contract execution through implementation and the initial stabilization period, followed by structured transition to the designated Operations team with periodic delivery assurance reviews thereafter.

Job Responsibilities
  • Strategic Delivery & Implementation
    • Lead Revenue Cycle delivery planning for strategic client implementations and complex operational transitions
    • Translate contract scope, client expectations, workflows, volumes, and service requirements into executable operating plans
    • Conduct operational discovery and validate assumptions before implementation
    • Perform detailed inventory analysis across AR, billing, denials, payment posting, charge entry, and related workflows
    • Develop effort estimates, productivity assumptions, staffing requirements, skill profiles, and capacity models
    • Identify operational risks, dependencies, access requirements, and implementation gaps before go-live
    • Establish implementation milestones, readiness criteria, ownership, and escalation pathways
    • Partner with Patient Access and Coding Strategic Delivery leads to ensure end-to-end alignment across the revenue cycle
  • Revenue Cycle Domain Leadership
    • Provide subject matter expertise across charge entry, claims submission and billing, payment posting, AR follow-up, denial management and appeals, collections, credit balances and refunds, payer follow-up, reimbursement workflows, and inventory management
    • Evaluate existing client workflows and recommend scalable, efficient operating models
    • Analyze payer behavior, aging trends, denial patterns, reimbursement issues, and revenue leakage opportunities
    • Support Operations teams with complex functional issues and critical client escalations
    • Recommend solutions based on operational data, root-cause analysis, and industry best practices
  • Pre-Go-Live Readiness
    • Validate scope, volumes, productivity benchmarks, staffing assumptions, and client expectations prior to launch
    • Support workforce planning, hiring profiles, candidate assessment, and staffing readiness
    • Define operational service levels, key performance indicators, quality expectations, turnaround times, and productivity standards
    • Ensure process documentation and standard operating procedures are complete and aligned with contractual requirements
    • Support development and validation of training programs, knowledge assessments, and operational readiness plans
    • Confirm system access, payer portal access, reporting requirements, workflow queues, and client dependencies
    • Partner with Product and Technology teams to validate product configuration and workflow readiness
  • Go-Live & Delivery Assurance
    • Provide hands-on delivery leadership during strategic client go-lives
    • Establish and lead daily governance during critical implementation periods
    • Monitor production volumes, inventory, backlog, quality, productivity, turnaround time, and staffing utilization
    • Support production planning and workload prioritization
    • Coordinate resolution of operational, product, system, workflow, access, and training issues
    • Provide functional guidance to Onshore and Offshore Operations teams
    • Participate in client implementation and delivery meetings as needed
    • Maintain structured risk, issue, dependency, and action tracking
    • Escalate material risks with clear recommendations, owners, and recovery plans
  • Stabilization – First 90 Days
    • Lead delivery assurance through the initial stabilization period for assigned strategic engagements
    • Monitor performance against agreed SLAs, KPIs, productivity, quality, and financial expectations
    • Conduct root-cause analysis for recurring operational issues and implement corrective action plans
    • Review staffing against actual production demand and recommend adjustments where appropriate
    • Identify training gaps and facilitate targeted retraining or knowledge reinforcement
    • Ensure SOPs remain current as workflows evolve during implementation
    • Partner with Operations leadership to build independent delivery capability
    • Drive timely resolution of customer concerns and delivery escalations
    • Support account-level gross margin improvement by identifying operational inefficiencies and staffing opportunities
  • Transition to Steady-State Operations
    • Develop and execute a structured transition plan to the designated Onshore or Offshore Operations team
    • Ensure complete knowledge transfer, documentation, training, reporting, and ownership before handoff
    • Establish clear steady-state roles and responsibilities across Operations, Customer Success, Product, and support functions
    • Define exit criteria and validate operational readiness before Strategic Delivery ownership is reduced
    • Continue periodic delivery assurance reviews for strategic accounts following transition
    • Re-engage when material delivery risk, escalation, or performance deterioration is identified
  • Performance Management & Analytics
    • Establish performance scorecards for strategic implementations and stabilization programs
    • Monitor and analyze key RCM indicators including Days in AR, aging distribution, denial rates, clean claim rate, first-pass yield, collection efficiency, cash acceleration, productivity, quality, backlog, and turnaround time
    • Convert operational data into recommendations, corrective actions, and measurable improvement plans
    • Provide concise executive reporting on implementation status, risks, client impact, and required actions
  • Client & Stakeholder Governance
    • Serve as a senior operational subject matter expert for strategic client engagements
    • Participate in implementation calls, operational reviews, MBRs, QBRs, and escalation discussions as required
    • Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure client commitments are reflected accurately in operational delivery
    • Maintain strong alignment between client expectations, contractual commitments, product capabilities, and operational execution

If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This is a remote/work-from-home (WFH) production underwriting role focused on Commercial Lines Middle Market accounts within the Human Services and Nonprofit industry segment.


Territory: New England

This territory will be focused on and include all of New England (CT, MA, ME, NH, RI, VT), with the potential for 1-2 states in another region, depending on the business need and respective book of business.

The selected candidate may be based anywhere within the Eastern Time Zone but must be able to regularly travel to key agency partners throughout the assigned territory, with an expectation of at least 25 agency visits per year. Preferably, this individual will be based in the Mid-Atlantic or Northeast regions.


Qualified candidates must possess:

  • Multi-line commercial insurance underwriting experience, including underwriting authority
  • Human Services and Nonprofit industry-specific experience
  • Strong business development skills, with a production & agency management orientation

Highly competitive candidates will have at least five years of experience handling Human Services and Nonprofit accounts and a strong skill set in underwriting Casualty lines, including General Liability, Professional Liability, and Abuse & Molestation.


This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.


The internal title for this role is Territory Manager, Specialty Care Business Development.


Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As a Territory Manager, you'll market, manage and underwrite commercial business with select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through developing, negotiating and implementing business plans. You'll lead and influence agencies by creating sales strategies and implementing sales processes and practices that drive new sales, increase shelf space, profit and customer retention. To succeed, it will be important to collaborate with internal business partners to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and other factors to win the account.

  • Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement plans. Analyzes regional underwriting performance experience, identifies problems on a territory level and proposes plans to resolve those situations.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis. Decisions require review of multiple variables, using agency relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions. Reviews for acceptability and handles those within authority using company underwriting guidelines and standards.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting assigned work by utilizing company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, sophisticated work and coordinates work with others to meet service level agreements. Effectively influences activities of the team to facilitate the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, accountabilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to improve profit and pipeline management. Proactively finds opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the Middle Market Underwriting Team on new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all products that may improve offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and developing business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Consults with agents and internal partners to develop business solutions. Shares understanding of organizational capabilities and opportunities to drive maximum value of relationships. Consults regarding the appetite, acceptability, terms, conditions, pricing and sales techniques of large or unique business. Provides industry trend observations to leadership. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options and to improve retention and profitability.

  • Communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates market intelligence to agencies and leaders. Communicates and collaborates actively with team and leaders to share industry trends and field underwriting experience.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance and enhance agency relationships. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter authority.

  • Manages a significant workload effectively and backs up others as needed. Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Director or Associate Vice President.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU or CIC is preferred.

Experience: Seven years of progressively more responsible underwriting and sales experience in commercial business preferred. Expertise in markets consistent with our underwriting preferences and product portfolio preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Detailed working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for middle market business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and within company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid driver’s license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

The Colleague Relations (CR) Managerleads and develops a team of People Advisors to deliver a responsive, professional, and confidential CR service.

This role ensures the consistent, fair, and timely handling of complex colleague relations matters, while supporting legal compliance, best practice, and a culture of engagement across PortmanDentex.

As a key member of the People team, the CR Manager provides expert advice to senior leaders and People Business Partners, supports strategic initiatives through proactive intervention, and helps shape CR policies and practices that align with our values and business goals.

Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Management:

  • Leads, coaches, and develops a team of People Advisors, ensuring effective performance, continuous learning, and high standards in ER case management.
  • Allocates cases, monitor case progress, and provide expert guidance on complex or high-risk matters.
  • Fosters a values-led performance culture that values integrity, collaboration, and efficient process management.

ER Case Management:

  • Oversees the end-to-end management of all ER cases; including disciplinary, grievance, capability, absence, investigations, and appeals.
  • Ensures all cases are managed in an efficient manner in accordance with our policies, employment law, and best practice guidelines.
  • Acts as an escalation point for high-risk, sensitive, or legally complex ER issues.
  • Maintains clear documentation, data integrity, and reporting standards for case outcomes and trends.

Policy Development:

  • Manages the development, review, and implementation of people policies, procedures, and “how to” guides.
  • Ensures compliance with employment legislation, regulatory frameworks (e.g., CQC), and internal governance.
  • Keeps abreast of legal updates and healthcare-specific ER challenges, providing insights and mitigation strategies.

Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Builds trusted relationships with internal stakeholders, including Leadership team, People Business Partners and People Support Office.
  • Develops strong relations with our Legal team
  • Manages our commercial relationship with our external legal support teams.
  • Enhances capability of people managers and People BPs by developing and participating in training programmes on key CR topics.

Change Management:

  • Supports an effective ER process for organisational change initiatives (e.g., restructures, acquisitions, divestments), including the design and execution of consultation frameworks in compliance with employment legislation

Analytics & Reporting:

  • Monitor ER case trends, identify emerging risks, and deliver actionable insights to PLT and the Exec.
  • Produce monthly dashboards and reports to track ER performance, volumes, and resolution times.

We welcome your application to our CRM vacancy if you have the following qualifications and skills:

Skills and Experience:

  • Leading ER case management in a complex, regulated environment.
  • Strong understanding of UK & I employment law and best practice ER procedures.
  • Demonstrated leadership of an ER team, including performance management and coaching.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to manage sensitive issues with discretion, impartiality, and sound judgment.
  • Experience in developing and implementing CR policies and documentation
  • Experience with Case Management Systems

Competencies:

  • Strong judgement and subject matter expertise
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills
  • High attention to detail and excellent written communication skills
  • Ability to contribute to the broader People agenda
  • Ability to support and influence others across the organisation

Personal Attributes

raw.excerpt: About High ScaleWe’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media.
raw.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a UGC Video Editor who can take raw creator footage and turn it into high-converting, "scroll-stopping" ads.

Why This Role Matters

Authenticity, pacing, and performance are your playground. As a UGC Video Editor, you are the bridge between a raw influencer review and a profitable ad campaign. You understand that in 2026, a polished cinematic commercial often loses to a well-edited, authentic-looking TikTok shot on an iPhone.

Your job is to craft the narrative, nail the hook, and apply the specific editing language of the internet (captions, sounds, pacing) to drive sales. If you are obsessed with why some videos go viral and others flop, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Transform Raw Assets into Ads

    • Ingest raw footage from creators and influencers (testimonials, unboxings, demos) and craft them into cohesive direct-response video ads.

    • Structure edits around proven marketing frameworks (Hook → Problem → Solution → Social Proof → CTA).

    • Ensure the "vibe" feels native to the platform (TikTok/Reels/Shorts), avoiding the "over-produced" look that kills engagement.

  2. Master the "Hook"

    • Create multiple variations of the first 3 seconds of every video to test what grabs attention best.

    • Utilize visual disruption, sound effects, and trending audio to prevent viewers from scrolling past.

  3. Apply Native Visuals

    • Implement platform-native text styles, dynamic captions (e.g., Alex Hormozi style), emojis, and stickers that enhance the storytelling without looking cluttered.

    • Clean up audio levels and apply basic color correction to ensure mobile viewing quality.

  4. Iterate at Speed

    • Produce high volumes of iterations (e.g., same body, different hook; same hook, different music) to feed our testing machine.

    • Respond quickly to data feedback from the media buying team (e.g., "Shorten the intro," "Make the text bigger").

Who You Are

  1. A Social Media Native

    • 1–3 years of experience editing UGC or social-first content (Agency or Freelance).

    • You understand the "visual language" of TikTok and Instagram. You know what trending fonts, sounds, and cuts are working right now.

  2. Technically Proficient

    • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro is required for our agency workflow.

    • Familiarity with CapCut features/styles and how to replicate them in Premiere is a massive plus.

    • Basic skills in After Effects or Photoshop for static asset integration.

  3. A Storyteller

    • You can take 20 minutes of rambling raw footage and cut it down to a sharp, persuasive 30-second story.

    • You have a good sense of rhythm and comedic timing.

  4. Fast & Adaptable

    • You are comfortable with high-volume workflows. You can churn out quality edits quickly.

    • You don't get attached to your cuts—you iterate based on what the data says.

  5. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You can interpret creative briefs accurately and collaborate with producers remotely.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative strategy of major DTC brands and sharpen your direct-response marketing skills.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one viral hook at a time.

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Account Partner to grow Veeva Commercial Basics, a suite of highly scalable medical and commercial applications that significantly impact how emerging Biotechnology and MedTech companies transition more efficiently and effectively from a clinical to a commercial organization. These are standardized, pre-configured applications without implementation and maintenance costs.

The Veeva Commercial Basics Account Partner will be responsible for meeting annual sales goals and helping the team achieve the long-range growth targets. In this role you will be responsible for generating new opportunities, winning new business, and managing executive level relationships with emerging Biotech and MedTech companies.

What You’ll Do

    • You’ll be a foundational member of the Veeva Commercial Basics sales organization and help make the product recognized as the go-to solution for emerging Biotechs and MedTech companies
    • Achieve team quarterly and annual sales goals
    • Execute fast sales cycles working directly with C-level Executives
    • Become knowledgeable on the Veeva Commercial Basics Commercial product suite
    • Responsible for running demos and fielding questions
    • Keep current with industry trends and engage customers in addressing their business challenges
    • Act with urgency, integrity, and a relentless focus on customer success

    • Including 3 years of Sales experience; a minimum of 1 year of software sales experience
    • Experience selling complex, out of the box solutions

    • Ability to sell directly to C-Level executives
    • Strong track record of hitting or exceeding sales quotas
    • We require candidates to be based in the general vicinity of the location posting

Nice to Have

    • A history of working with or selling to Life Sciences companies
    • Strong computer skills and experience with Gmail, Excel, PPT, CRM, Sigma or other reporting and analytics software
    • Entrepreneurial mindset and experience.
    • Familiarity with Veeva’s Commercial software and data products.

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs

Job Description

Role Summary:

Galvanize is seeking an Enterprise Sales Manager to drive new business growth across our enterprise training and workforce development solutions. This role will play a critical part in accelerating the Galvanize mission to help organizations build the skilled talent they need for an AI-driven future. By creating new enterprise relationships and expanding access to our training solutions, the Enterprise Sales Manager will directly contribute to the growth and impact of Galvanize across the workforce development landscape.

This is a highly proactive, quota-carrying sales role focused on acquiring new enterprise customers, generating pipeline, and closing business. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying opportunities, engaging decision-makers, navigating complex sales cycles, and converting prospects into long-term customers.

Success in this role requires strong prospecting skills, strategic outreach, relationship building, and consistent execution against ambitious revenue targets. We are looking for someone who is energized by creating opportunities, opening new doors, and winning new business.

While our sales approach is consultative and solution-oriented, this role is not focused on account maintenance or customer success. The primary responsibility is driving new customer acquisition and revenue growth for the Galvanize learning and workforce development solutions.

You will thrive here if you enjoy building something from nothing. You're energized by prospecting, opening new doors, and engaging senior decision-makers. You are persistent, resourceful, and motivated by ambitious goals. You don't wait for opportunities to come to you, you create them.

If you're excited by the challenge of identifying new customers, solving workforce development challenges, and winning business in a competitive market, you'll be successful at Galvanize.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of enterprise prospects through outbound prospecting, networking, referrals, and strategic outreach

raw.description:
Term position through July 31, 2027, with potential for extension

Type: Full-time; exempt; term position. This position is grant-funded and is budgeted through July 31, 2027, with potential for extension based on funding.

Salary: $70,000 - $85,000 commensurate with experience and qualifications

Location: Remote (U.S. Based)

Reports to: Senior Director, Local Initiatives

Benefits: Health, dental, vision insurance, retirement contribution, personal time off, flexible work schedule

About IREC

IREC is an independent nonprofit that builds the foundation for rapid adoption of clean energy and energy efficiency to benefit people, the economy, and our planet. Our vision is a 100% clean energy future that is reliable, resilient, and equitable. IREC develops and advances the regulatory reforms, technical standards, and workforce and community-based solutions needed to enable the streamlined integration of clean energy. IREC provides independent leadership and trusted clean energy expertise through three interrelated strategies:

  • Workforce Development - IREC leads initiatives to build a diverse and qualified clean energy workforce while ensuring that clean energy workers have access to family-sustaining careers.
  • Local Initiatives - IREC supports communities to develop policies and promote best practices that accelerate the equitable deployment of clean energy.
  • State Regulatory Engagement - IREC represents the public interest in state regulatory proceedings and develops and disseminates best practices to ensure that distributed energy resources (DERs) can be equitably and efficiently integrated on the electric grid.

About the Position

The Interstate Renewable Energy Council (IREC) is seeking a highly motivated Sr. Program Manager to support the Local Initiatives team in achieving aggressive goals to increase the adoption of electric vehicles (EV) and EV charging. The Sr. Program Manager will work with partners to recruit communities and provide technical assistance to local governments pursuing designation under the U.S. Department of Energy-funded Charging Smart program. You will work as part of a small, dynamic team to help communities reduce local barriers to the adoption of EV charging. You will focus on permitting and inspection, planning and zoning, government operations, utility engagement, and market development as well as other federal, state, and local EV and EV charging topics. You will also work with a broad coalition of other stakeholders, demonstrating thought leadership at both the strategic and tactical levels. The Sr. Program Manager will occasionally perform other duties and support other programs as needed to meet the objectives of a small and dynamic national nonprofit organization. This is a term position ending July 31, 2027, with potential for extension based on funding.

Responsibilities

  • Support outreach efforts and work with partner organizations to recruit new communities to the Charging Smart program;
  • Promote the Charging Smart program by effectively communicating program benefits to stakeholders;
  • Assist local governments in identifying and implementing programs and practices to build robust local EV and EV charging markets;
  • Evaluate local government policies to determine if they meet Charging Smart best practices;
  • Design and deliver presentations to local government officials;
  • Manage external contractors to ensure project goals and deliverables are met;
  • Facilitate meetings and build relationships with local government officials and their stakeholders;
  • Lead and/or participate in internal working groups on program evaluation, outreach and recruitment strategies, criteria development, and technical assistance;
  • Support designation review process and maintain program data in Salesforce;
  • Develop new resources (e.g., white papers, fact sheets, presentations, tools) to help local governments learn from and replicate model practices;
  • Develop and refine program-related supporting documents;
  • Provide research, writing, and coordination support for Charging Smart and other projects at IREC;
  • Support accurate, timely program reporting in compliance with federal grant requirements; and
  • Support other IREC programs and initiatives as needed.

IREC team members collaborate primarily in a virtual environment, leveraging remote meeting, project management, and other collaboration tools to stay connected and on task.

Knowledge, Skills, Experience, and Qualities for This Role:

The successful candidate will bring the following qualities to our organization:

Required:

  • An undergraduate degree in public policy, economics, planning, local government management, public affairs, environmental studies, or a related field;
  • 4+ years of relevant work experience, preferably in municipal/regional government affairs, public affairs, the solar industry, EV charging, or other renewable energy field;
  • Demonstrated success with stakeholder outreach and program recruitment;
  • Strong interpersonal skills and clear, persuasive technical writing skills;
  • Proven ability to provide high-quality customer service;
  • Ability to work independently and with a geographically distributed team to meet deadlines (experience managing large groups of external stakeholders is a plus);
  • Ability to build a professional network, travel (approximately 5% of time), and present effectively at local, regional, and national meetings, conferences, and other events;
  • A demonstrated passion for transportation electrification or renewable energy; and
  • Willingness to be flexible, adapt to new technologies, learn, and shift course as needs arise.

Preferred:

  • A Master's degree in a related field;
  • Experience managing federally funded programs;
  • Knowledge of local and regional planning, zoning, and permitting processes; and
  • Education or experience in EV charger deployment.

Apply with: Cover letter and resume. All application materials must be submitted in English and include a cover letter to be considered.

IREC Foundational Values

  • We value diversity of backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and thoughts and believe they result in better outcomes and greater organizational impact.
  • We value the uniqueness and dignity of each individual and their right to be their true and complete self.
  • We believe in the potential of the clean energy transition to advance equity in our nation.

IREC is proud to be an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and embracing a workplace with diverse voices and perspectives. We strongly encourage and seek applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds. Applicants are not discriminated against because of race, religion, sex, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, color, marital status, medical conditions, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The application window is expected to close on November 15, 2026.

Applicants must be based in and authorized to work in the United States.

We are looking for a Senior Customer Success Manager to be the trusted partner of our US clients across the full customer lifecycle. You will own a portfolio of enterprise and mid-market accounts, drive adoption and program performance, and turn healthy relationships into renewals and expansion. You will work closely with Sales, Delivery, Product and Support, and be the voice of the US customer inside Jifiti.

Responsibilities

  • Own a portfolio of US enterprise and mid-market clients (banks, lenders, merchants) across the full lifecycle, from implementation through renewal and expansion.

  • Experience with financial institutions or fintech: consumer lending, BNPL / POS financing, payments or banking software.

raw.description:
The Talent Enablement (TE) Partner helps Fortive Operating Companies (OpCos) solve business and leadership challenges by translating them into practical talent actions that improve performance. This role serves as a dedicated partner to assignedOpCosand corporate functions — helping leaders focus on the few development and capability shifts that matter most, activating the right solutions, and staying accountable until those changes take hold.

Reporting to the VP Talent Enablement, the TE Partner works closely withOpCoHR Vice Presidents, HR business partners, peopleto listen, diagnose, confirm, recommend, co-create, and sustain solutions over time. This is not a traditional program-building role. TE Partners use enterprise tools and content first, shape practical solutions for theOpCocontext, and only build something new when nothing else will work. The role requires someone who can learn a new business quickly, build credibility without a lot of infrastructure, operate comfortably in ambiguity, and stay with the work long enough to see behavior and business outcomes improve.

Primary Responsibilities

1. Business & Talent Diagnosis

  • Build a deep understanding of each assigned Operating Company’s strategy, leadership strengths, and talent risks through an embedded partnership withOpCoHRVP and HR Business Partners.

  • Partner with operating company HR teams to clarify the real business problems to solve and shape targeted responses.

  • Translate business challenges into clear leadership, capability, and talent implications.

2. Solution Shaping & Enablement

  • Shape, recommend, co-create, and embed practical solutions by drawing from enterprise curriculum, assessments, coaching, development plans, and learning assets as options. Use what already exists when it works. When no enterprise solution fits, the TE Partner may design a net-new approach with theOpCoHR team and flag recurring needs back to the Enterprise Development & Delivery Specialist.

  • Adapt and contextualize solutions so they fit the Operating Company’s realities and operating cadence.

3. Selective Delivery & Coaching

  • Co‑design and deliver withOpCoHR and other leaders when the circumstances make sense to build internal activation capability.

  • Personally facilitate and deliver high impact workshops, team installations, and leadership sessions when expertise, behavior change, or alignment is critical.

  • As needed, partner withOpCoHR to coach leaders and teams in the flow of work, reinforcing new behaviors and practices over time.

  • For Partnership Programs (e.g., PLE, GEM, Talent Edge): support the reinforcement, practice, and coaching moments that follow center-delivered core experiences — helpingOpCosembed new behaviors in their daily work and operating cadence.

4. Sustained Outcome Ownership

  • Maintain ongoing partnership with the Operating Company HR team to monitor progress, adjust the approach, and reinforce follow-through until the change is sticking.

  • Stay accountable for outcomes over time — not just design and delivery — and prioritize solutions that support the business strategy and maximize business impact.

  • Surface risks, tradeoffs, and priority tensions early and transparently.

  • Own the ‘20% localization’ for Partnership Programs — adapting enterprise curriculum to theOpCo’scontext, use cases, and operating cadence in partnership with theOpCoHR team.

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in Leadership, Learning & Development, Organizational Development, Human Resources, or a related field preferred.
  • Proven experience partnering with business & HR leaders to identify capability gaps and design targeted learning, coaching, and development solutions that address business priorities and performance challenges.
  • 7+ years of experience designing, developing, deploying, and facilitating leadership and professional development programs, with demonstrated success driving adoption, skill/capability growth, and performance improvement that accelerate business results.
  • Strong expertise in creating and continuously refining learning solutions, frameworks, and development experiences based on business needs, stakeholder feedback, learner insights, and measurable outcomes.
  • Highly adaptable and scrappy; able to learn a new business quickly, build credibility & trust without a lot of infrastructure, and operate comfortably in ambiguity.
  • Experience establishing success metrics and evaluating learning effectiveness, behavior change, and business impact, using data and insights to continuously improve program quality and relevance.
  • Exceptional coaching, consulting, and facilitations skills, with the ability to influence leaders, foster meaningful learning experiences, and translate development initiatives into tangible business results.

Fortive Corporation Overview

Fortive’s essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.

We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We’re a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.

We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.

At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.

At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.

At Fortive, we believe in growth. We’re honest about what’s working and what isn’t, and we never stop improving and innovating.

Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.

raw.excerpt: The roleYou’ll visit our care homes and retirement villages, see for yourself how they’re run, and turn what you find into clear insight that helps keep clinical, operational and quality standards high across the portfolio.
raw.description:
The role

You’ll visit our care homes and retirement villages, see for yourself how they’re run, and turn what you find into clear insight that helps keep clinical, operational and quality standards high across the portfolio. If you’re an experienced social care nurse or practitioner looking for a new challenge, this role builds on what you know and helps you develop specialist skills in risk management, quality assurance and portfolio oversight within a health and social care investment fund.

This role can be based from anywhere in the UK as it's a work from home setup. However, you will need to travel to our London office on a monthly basis.

The team

You’ll join the Quality Assurance team, a small, established function supporting an extensive healthcare investment fund. As our investment in care grows, so does the team’s role in overseeing quality, risk and operational standards. You’ll report to the Clinical Assurance Director and work with colleagues across Octopus Capital, who’ll turn to you for healthcare and regulatory expertise.

What you’ll do

Site visits and oversight

  • Visit our facilities across the UK and write detailed visit reports
  • Give operational insight from each visit, covering regulatory compliance and service quality
  • Produce clear written reports for the Quality Assurance team

Regulatory insight

  • Track CQC reports, or equivalent regulator inspection outcomes, for operators in the fund
  • Review and analyse regulatory reports, and feed back to the relevant teams

Sharing knowledge

  • Support our educational days and networking events
  • Attend sector conferences to keep up with best practice

Essential
✔️ Experience as a social care nurse or practitioner
✔️ Confidence carrying out site visits on your own and reporting back on what you find
✔️ Excellent written and verbal communication, and comfort presenting findings to internal and external stakeholders
✔️ Skill in building and managing working relationships
✔️ Ease with technology, digital applications and media platforms
✔️ A full UK driving licence, and willingness to travel nationally, including overnight stays

Desirable
✔️ Experience at clinical lead, deputy manager level or equivalent
✔️ Experience delivering sessions or workshops at educational and networking events
✔️ Experience advising colleagues on regulatory or healthcare sector matters

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway. If you meet most of the requirements, we’d like to hear from you.

What we offer

💰 A competitive salary, bonus, pension and share incentive plan

✈️ Untracked holiday

🏡 Hybrid working – three days in the office, two days from home
⚓ Anchor (our wellness hub) which includes Headspace, one to one coaching through Wellness Cloud, Digital GP, employee assistance program & more
👪 Up to 6 months paid parental leave regardless of gender
❤️ Life insurance, critical illness cover and income protection
🏥 Private medical insurance for you and your family
🚗 Electric vehicle leasing
🌍 The option to work overseas up to a month per year

Our Values
At our core, we believe that how a company behaves is just as important as what it does. That’s why we chose to become an accredited B Corp (the equivalent of a Fairtrade coffee stamp but for companies) and to change our Articles of Association so that the interests all our stakeholders – employees, customers, communities, environment and shareholders – are considered in every decision we make.  

We are committed to building a workplace where diversity is valued, and inclusion is a priority. By providing equal opportunities for growth and development, we embrace and celebrate all races, genders, religions, sexual orientations, ages, disabilities, and socio-economic backgrounds. We believe teams achieve their best when every member feels safe, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves.

We're proud to be disability confident and are committed to supporting candidates with a disability, including neurodiversity and mental health conditions, throughout the recruitment process. Applicants are welcome to opt-in to the disability confident scheme as part of our application process. If you require any adjustments to the interview process, we’ll be happy to accommodate where possible.

At Octopus, we’re investors and entrepreneurs on a mission to back the people, ideas and industries that will change the world. We believe there’s a brighter way to do business, which is why we’re an accredited B Corp, and why we changed our Articles of Association so that employees, customers, communities, the environment and shareholders all count in every decision we make. Our healthcare fund invests in care homes and retirement villages across the UK.

Description

Vega is one of the fastest-growing startups in cybersecurity, redefining security analytics and operations with an AI-native platform for the SOC. We are building the next-generation operating system for security teams. Vega is already delivering real impact at some of the world’s largest organizations - improving detection, unlocking the value of their security data, and reducing cost and complexity. With HQs in New York and TLV, we're looking for people who want to be a part of the next rocket-ship in cyber.

Reporting to the Field Marketing Director, we’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to act as thein-region marketing owner for our go-to-market team.

You’ll align with the RD Sales in the region to build quarterly territory plans, run high-impact programs that drive pipeline, and help scale repeatable field motions across events, ABM, partners, and community.

This role is available to candidates located in the following states: Illinois, Indiana, Ohio, Michigan, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Iowa, Missouri, Kansas, Nebraska, North Dakota, South Dakota.

﻿WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Own the regional field plan: Build quarterly plans aligned to regional sales priorities (new logos + expansion), target account lists, and pipeline goals.
  • Run pipeline-driving programs end-to-end: Executive roundtables, workshops, partner events, third-party conferences, and virtual experiences. You will own everything from concept to execution to follow-up.
  • Execute ABM in the field: Partner with Sales to activate account-based plays (1 to few and 1 to many) that expand territory coverage and accelerate deals.
  • Co-market with partners: Build and execute joint programs with channel partners, including co-branded events and regional activations.
  • Plug into community and alliances: Work to activate local cyber alliances, memberships, advisory boards, and user programs to deepen engagement and create advocates.
  • Operational excellence: Own logistics, vendors, timelines, promotion, SDR/AE handoffs, and post-event conversion paths
  • Measure what matters: Report weekly/monthly on pipeline sourced/influenced, meeting creation, stage progression, target account engagement, and ROI.
  • Own the regional budget: Plan spend, forecast, track, and optimize

Requirements

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • 2-4 years in B2B field marketing / integrated demand (cybersecurity or technical SaaS strongly preferred).
  • Proven success partnering with Sales on territory planning and delivering measurable pipeline impact.
  • Strong project management; you can run multiple programs simultaneously without dropping details.
  • Experience with Salesforce and Hubspot and comfortable with basic attribution reporting.
  • Clear communicator who can collaborate with Sales, SEs, partners, and executive stakeholders.
  • Up to 25% travel in region (some international trips may be required)

﻿NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience running partner/channel co-marketing motions.
  • Experience with ABM tools and field ABM playbooks.
  • Familiarity with SOC/SIEM/security analytics audiences.

UPSTARS – продуктова IT-компанія, з якою злітають і люди, і бренди. Наш основний фокус – технологічні рішення та B2B-послуги для міжнародних клієнтів. Запускаємо зіркові проєкти у сфері iGaming, які отримують визнання та найвищі оцінки профільних рейтингів ✨

І так, підтримувати легальний та прозорий ринок України – це маст хев, тому третіми в країні отримали B2B-ліцензію на надання послуг у сфері азартних ігор.

У 2026 ми активно масштабуємо і проєкти, і дрім тім. Тому для підсилення Conversion департаменту шукаємо Competitive & Market Researcher.

✅ Твої майбутні задачі:

  • робота з інструментами аналізу конкурентів (SimilarWeb, Adplexity, Meta Ads Library, Tyver, Humble, Blask та інші);

  • аналіз ринків: визначення найбільших гравців, виявлення нових та перспективних конкурентів, оцінка динаміки та змін на ринку;

  • аналіз трафік-сорсів конкурентів (paid, organic, referral, affiliate), визначення структури каналів та їх пріоритетності;

  • виявлення воронок залучення, додаткових доменів і дзеркал продуктів, повʼязаних проєктів та інфраструктури конкурентів;

  • структурування та візуалізація даних;

  • підготовка аналітичних звітів з чіткими висновками та інсайтами.

💪 Твої скіли:

  • практичний досвід роботи з інструментами конкурентного аналізу / spy-сервісами;

  • розуміння digital-маркетингу та принципів залучення трафіку;

  • вміння виявляти схожості і/або розбіжності в маркетингових воронках;

  • досвід роботи з Google Sheets;

  • досвід роботи з клоакінгом;

  • аналітичне мислення та увага до деталей;

  • здатність працювати з великим обсягом інформації та робити чіткі висновки.

🤞 Бажано, але не критично:

  • досвід у сфері iGaming або Dating/Adult;

  • досвід на аналогічних або схожих посадах;

  • досвід роботи з інструментами аналітики.

🌟 Наші цінності та переваги:

  • командність – гуртом не лише працюємо, а ще й відпочиваємо, двіжуємо і робимо добрі справи;

  • позитив – з легкістю йдемо по життю і отримуємо драйв від круто зробленої роботи, цікавих задач і фідбеку тіммейтів;

  • можливості – пропонуємо чіткий кар’єрний план з Performance Review, тренінги, менторинг-програми та інші інструменти для реалізації як у карʼєрі, так і у житті;

  • сміливість – беремося за задачі із зірочкою, не боїмося викликів і амбітних планів;

  • відкритість – говоримо прямо і просто навіть про складне, чуємо ідеї та фідбеки і цінуємо проактивність;

  • маємо власні потужності для створення технологічних рішень з нуля;

  • автоматизуємо рутину, щоб використовувати час для розвитку та професійного зростання всередині компанії;

  • не любимо бюрократію та застарілі підходи – ми за свободу дій.

🍪Маст-хев:

  • працюй там, де комфортно та безпечно – в хабах у Києві та Варшаві або віддалено;

  • 20 робочих днів оплачуваних дей офів, державні вихідні і лікарняні – ми за ворк-лайф беленс;

  • медичне страхування у топових клініках і покриття витрат на психолога на платформі Pleso;

  • Benefit cafe – щомісячно витрачай кошти на уподобання, хобі, спорт тощо;

  • івенти – бери участь у майстер-класах, відвідуй тімбілдинги та корпоративи;

  • навчання під будь-який запит – індивідуальний бюджет на курси, корпоративна англійська, воркшопи та онлайн-бібліотека.

І ще про важливе:

❗️Не маємо клієнтів, які б використовували наші розробки та послуги на українському ринку.

❗️Не працюємо з клієнтами ринку країни-агресора чи будь-якого іншого російськомовного ринку.

Відчуваєш метч за цінностями і бажання професійно зростати? Давай знайомитися! 😉

P.S. Якщо після відгуку не бачиш нашого листа – зазирни у “Спам” або інші розділи. Іноді наші відповіді губляться там 👀
