raw.description:
Wir sind ein inhabergeführtes und global tätiges Unternehmen im Bereich Speciality-Pharma mit einer klaren Mission: DIE nachhaltige Plattform für langjährig etablierte und vertraute pharmazeutische Markenprodukte diverser Therapiegebiete zu sein. Als verlässlicher Partner der forschenden Pharmaindustrie sichert CHEPLAPHARM die Verfügbarkeit und die Versorgung mit diesen Medikamenten für den Weltmarkt.

Davon profitieren nicht nur unsere Partner, sondern auch Patient:innen auf der ganzen Welt. Wir sind stolz darauf, uns mit unserem spezialisierten Geschäftsmodell innerhalb von 20 Jahren zu einem der weltweit führenden Unternehmen bei der Übernahme von Originalpräparaten entwickelt zu haben und wir wachsen weiter. Der Anspruch unserer rund 800 Mitarbeitenden: Gemeinsam „MEHR BEWIRKEN“.

Als Specialist HR IT Solutions (m/w/d) bist Du Teil unserer aktuell 12-köpfigen HR-Abteilung.

Was Deinen Tag bei uns ausmacht:

HR-Systembetreuung und Anwenderunterstützung

Du betreust unser HR-IT-System „rexx“ und stellst dessen reibungslosen Betrieb sicher. Dazu gehören die Verwaltung von Benutzerrollen und Zugriffsrechten sowie die Analyse und Behebung von Systemstörungen. Darüber hinaus unterstützt Du die Mitarbeitenden durch technische Hilfestellung und führst Schulungen durch, um den sicheren und effizienten Umgang mit den HR-Softwareanwendungen zu fördern.

Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung von HR-Prozessen

Du unterstützt die Digitalisierung von HR-Prozessen mit dem Ziel, Abläufe effizienter und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten. Zudem arbeitest Du an HR-Projekten mit und bringst dabei Deine Expertise hinsichtlich der IT-seitigen Systemunterstützung ein. Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt Deiner Tätigkeit ist die Entwicklung und Implementierung individueller Berichte und Dashboards, um relevante HR-Kennzahlen transparent bereitzustellen.

Datenschutz, Datensicherheit und Dokumentation

Du stellst die Einhaltung von Datensicherheits- und Datenschutzanforderungen innerhalb der HR-Systemlandschaft sicher. Außerdem unterstützt Du die Erstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von HR-Systemdokumentationen sowie der zugehörigen Prozesse und trägst so zu einer hohen Transparenz und Nachvollziehbarkeit bei.

Was Dich auszeichnet:

Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung

Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre mit Schwerpunkt Personal, Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Darüber hinaus bringst Du mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich HR-IT, Human Resources, der HR-Systemadministration oder in einer vergleichbaren Funktion mit.

Fachliche und technische Kompetenzen

Du besitzt fundierte Kenntnisse moderner HR-IT-Systeme wie beispielsweise rexx, SAP SuccessFactors, Workday, Oracle HCM, Personio oder vergleichbarer Lösungen. Zudem hast Du Erfahrung in der Einführung, Administration und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung von HR-Anwendungen sowie digitalen HR-Prozessen. Dein grundlegendes technisches Verständnis von Systemintegrationen, Schnittstellen und Datenstrukturen ermöglicht es Dir, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu analysieren und praxisorientierte Lösungen umzusetzen.

Datenschutz und Kommunikation

Du verfügst über gute Kenntnisse im Bereich Datenschutz, Datensicherheit sowie im Umgang mit Berechtigungs- und Rollenkonzepten. Abgerundet wird Dein Profil durch sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, die Dir eine sichere Kommunikation in einem professionellen Arbeitsumfeld ermöglichen.

Was wir Dir neben dem Job bieten:

Unternehmenskultur & Internationalität
Wachsendes Unternehmen mit einem diversen, offenen Arbeitsumfeld und Mitarbeitenden aus rund 40 Nationen.

Flexible Arbeitsmodelle & Work-Life-Balance
Individuell anpassbare Arbeitsmodelle, inklusive der Möglichkeit, bis zu zwei Monate pro Jahr aus dem EU-Ausland zu arbeiten. Arbeitszeitkonto mit Freizeitausgleich sowie 30 Tage Urlaub.

Individuelle Benefits & Vorsorge
Flexibel nutzbares Benefits-Budget, z. B. für eine erhöhte betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote oder Zuschüsse zu Fahrt- und Verpflegungskosten.

Vergünstigungen & Zusatzleistungen
Zugriff auf die Corporate-Benefits-Plattform mit Rabatten bei hunderten von Partnerunternehmen.

Weiterentwicklung & Teamkultur
Interne und externe Fortbildungen abgestimmt auf persönliche Ziele sowie Firmen- und Teamevents zur Stärkung des Zusammenhalts und zum gemeinsamen Feiern von Erfolgen.

SupportYourApp is an international Intelligent Support-as-a-Service company that has been providing business process outsourcing services to other IT companies around the globe (technical and customer support, services to improve customer experience) for the past 15 years. We have 1500+ people in our international community.

We operate globally, supporting clients in 60 languages, partnering with industry leaders like MasterCard, Calm and MacPaw. With international hubs and coworking spaces around the world, we also develop innovative products like Quidget and improve the customer experience every single day.

About the role:

We are looking for a Legal Assistant to join our community — someone who is eager to apply their knowledge of international law, gain experience working with a global IT company, communicate with clients from all over the world, and collaborate on interesting and complex tasks together with our Chief Legal Officer.

Sounds exciting? There’s more to come 💛

What you will do:

  • Draft, review, and help manage standard commercial agreements (NDAs, service agreements, assignment agreements), escalating non-standard terms to senior colleagues;
  • Send documents for signing, track signatures, and upload signed documents to the appropriate folders;
  • Maintain legal registers and ensure their accuracy;
  • Assist with due diligence on clients, suppliers, contractors, and partners, and flag potential risks for review;
  • Provide day-to-day legal support to HR, IT, Marketing, Finance, and Operations on routine contractual and compliance questions;
  • Help maintain legal templates and policies, and track relevant regulatory changes.

What you need to succeed in this role:

  • 1+ year of legal experience in commercial, corporate, or technology law (internships or legal assistant roles in a law firm or in-house team count);
  • At least Upper-Intermediate (B2) level of spoken and written English, with fluency in Ukrainian (including legal drafting and business communication);
  • Hands-on experience drafting and reviewing contracts (NDAs, service agreements, DPAs), with the ability to work independently on standard documents;
  • Good analytical, legal research, and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail;
  • Strong organizational skills and accuracy in document and register management;
  • Master’s degree in Law (final-year students may be considered);
  • Comfort working with AI tools and automated workflows, along with the ability to critically review AI-assisted output;
  • Proactive and comfortable working in a fast-paced, business-driven environment.

Will be an advantage:

  • Experience with e-signature and document management tools;
  • Experience working in IT, outsourcing, SaaS, or international business environments;
  • Familiarity with GDPR, data protection, or compliance-related matters.

Benefits and Perks:

  • Providing services during business hours;
  • Opportunity to cooperate fully remotely;
  • Inclusive international environment;
  • Compensation in USD;
  • Rewards for referring friends;
  • Balance between project workload and personal time, but also – internal health policy;
  • Responsive leadership interested in your growth and long-lasting cooperation;
  • Greenhouse conditions for self-development;
  • A culture built on trust, with no time-tracking requirements.

*The items listed in this section may vary depending on the terms of your engagement. Certain benefits and conditions typically apply to employees; independent contractors may not be eligible for all of these. The specific terms, including compensation, benefits, and work conditions, will be clearly defined in your agreement if selected.

You can learn more about the company and its culture by visiting our official website and social pages on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn.

Do you thrive in dynamic environments where you can navigate complex legal matters, provide clear guidance, and collaborate closely with experts to deliver excellent results?

Grab the chance to join us and send your CV in English, pointing out your outstanding skills!

raw.description:
Key Responsibilities

Channel Partner Management & Strategy

  • Provide strategic and technical business support to Channel Partners (CPs) to develop sales, achieve regional targets, and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Develop and strengthen long-term, win-win business relationships with existing CPs in assigned SEA territories.
  • Identify and establish relationships with new Channel Partners, including market development, goal setting, and contract negotiations.
  • Achieve win-win scenarios where gaps exist between customer demands and our current portfolio by fostering co-creation initiatives with CPs.
  • Hold Channel Partners accountable for annual sales targets, marketing activities, and overall performance metrics.

Sales Execution & Business Development

  • Collaborate with CPs to identify growth opportunities by product line and market segment.
  • Manage the prospect lifecycle in cooperation with CPs, which includes:
    • Defining analytical problems and proposing tailored solutions.
    • Organizing product demonstrations, application work, and local customer activities.
    • Preparing quotations and leading sales and contract negotiations where required.
  • Provide accurate business forecasting, pipeline management, and regular reporting to regional leadership.

Partner Enablement & Marketing

  • Mentor newly recruited CPs, providing comprehensive sales and technical training to ensure they possess the required knowledge and tools for effective selling.
  • Develop and implement programs to continuously elevate the technical, commercial, and sales skills of the CP network.
  • Collaborate with CPs to identify and coordinate local marketing activities, including seminars, user days, and customer meetings.

Compliance & Operations

  • Ensure Malvern Panalytical’s Code of Business Ethics (CoBE) and compliance standards are regularly communicated, understood, and strictly adhered to by all Channel Partners.

Qualifications & Experience

Education & Technical Knowledge

  • Degree: BSc, MSc, or PhD in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Physics, or a closely related scientific field.
  • Technical Acumen: Strong working knowledge of Physics and Chemistry, with a deep understanding of analytical problems and solutions.

Professional Experience

  • Sales Experience: Minimum of 5 years of B2B sales experience, specifically within the Analytical/Scientific Instrumentation industry.
  • Product Knowledge: Proven track record selling scientific instruments/equipment/systems (e.g., spectroscopy, microscopy, image analysis, X-ray analysis, particle characterization, physisorption).
  • Regional Experience: Prior experience managing channels or direct sales within the South East Asian market is highly desirable.

Skills & Competencies

  • Communication: Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills. Ability to articulate complex scientific concepts to both technical and commercial audiences. (Note: Fluency in English is required; proficiency in regional languages such as Mandarin, Bahasa, or Thai is an advantage).
  • Negotiation & Closing: Substantiated capability to negotiate complex contracts and close business effectively.
  • Interpersonal Skills: Strong interpersonal skills, active listening, and a mature, positive disposition with a strong sense of commitment.
  • Coordination & Independence: Ability to work independently with initiative, good ethical/business judgment, and the ability to coordinate activities across diverse, cross-functional teams.
  • Organization: Strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills to handle multiple partners and territories simultaneously.
  • Adaptability: Highly adaptive to dynamic, changing environments and diverse cultural contexts within Southeast Asia.

Working Conditions & Travel

  • Localisation : Strong preference for Singapore but other countries in SEA can be considered.
  • Travel Requirement: Ability and willingness to travel frequently and extensively across Southeast Asia (approximately 50% international/regional travel).

We provide market-leading, material characterization technologies for the world's most innovative companies, academic institutions, and government laboratories in the analytics of advanced materials.


We support our customers through their biggest challenges, from developing lifesaving vaccines to sustainable fuels. We wake up every day to delight our customers through innovation, high-quality solutions and workflows, and excellence in customer satisfaction.


We are a recognized leader for quality and insights in material characterization; winning customers with performance and keeping them with service. With more than 2,000 employees operating in over 20 countries across the world, and R&D sites in North America, Europe and Asia.

We are part of Spectris, a company which combines precision with purpose to equip customers to solve some of their greatest challenges to make the world cleaner, healthier and more productive. In 2025, Spectris acquired Micromeritics as part of Malvern Panalytical.

raw.description:
About the Role

We are seeking a skilled and innovative Senior Small Business ClientOnboardingPartner to lead new clients through a seamless integration process into our Small Business Services. This role is vital in creating exceptional first impressions and ensuring a fast, consistent, and strategic client experience. As a Senior Small Business ClientOnboardingPartner, you will guide our clients through converting their bookkeeping and payroll services to new systems while collaborating with internal teams to ensure they are prepared for long-term success.
The Senior Small Business ClientOnboardingPartner will serve as a trusted advisor, identifying opportunities to maximize client workflows and ensuring compliance with financial and payroll regulations.

Day-to-day, you'll...

  • Act as the primary point of contact for new clients during the onboarding process.
  • Develop and execute tailored onboarding plans that align with client needs and business goals.
  • Guide clients through setup on accounting, payroll, and virtual platforms, including assisting with state ID registrations and compliance requirements.
  • Review and optimize historical client data, including bookkeeping, payroll records, tax filings, and financial statements.
  • Identify and address discrepancies by preparing adjustments, amendments, or corrective filings as needed.
  • Proactively communicate with clients via email, text, and phone to gather necessary documents and ensure timely completion of onboarding tasks.
  • Partner with internal teams, including sales and account management, to ensure a smooth handoff to ongoing services.
  • Conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure clients meet compliance standards and are set up for success with recurring services.
  • Document and share insights on onboarding trends and client needs to refine processes and enhance the overall client experience.

Required Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelors

Work Experience:

  • Ability to anticipate customer needs and match them with appropriate products and services
  • 1 year Client onboarding experience
  • Comfort with working under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent listening, negotiation, and presentation abilities
  • Knowledge or familiarity with bookkeeping, payroll, or accounting
  • 5 years minimum related work experience
  • Proven ability to juggle multiple projects at a time, while maintaining sharp attention to detail
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills as you will work remotely with clients across the country

Preferred Qualifications

Work Experience:

  • account management experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or related field.
  • Bilingual skills
  • Experience with CRM, Xero, Small Business Service, Client Service

Why work for us

At H&R Block, our purpose is simple: to provide help and inspire confidence in our clients and communities everywhere. For more than 70 years, we’ve led the tax industry and we continue to evolve through our Block Next strategy, blending human expertise with digital innovation.

That same commitment to care extends to our associates. When you join us, you become part of a High Performing, Connected Culture built on strong relationships, continuous learning, and a shared commitment to making a meaningful impact. We invest in your well-being through competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and support for life both in and outside of work.
Pay Range Information

The pay range for this position is listed below. Local minimum wage laws apply. This information is posted pursuant to local requirements to provide applicants with information about what they might be eligible to receive. Individual pay decisions will depend on job-related factors such as experience, education, skill, performance, and geographic location where work will be performed. Successful candidates may be able to participate in one or more incentive compensation or short-term incentive plans, which could generate additional earnings in accordance with the terms of each plan. Qualifying associates can enroll themselves and/or their eligible dependents in medical and prescription drug coverage; can participate in the H&R Block Retirement Savings Plan (401(k) Plan), the Employee Assistance Program, (virtual) fitness center programs, and the associate discount program; are automatically enrolled in Business Travel Accident Insurance; and receive Associate Tax Prep benefit.

$62,800.00 - $94,200.00/Yr.

raw.description:
Category: Legal / Security / Law

Location:


Senior Adult Social Care Lawyer – 3 Month Contract

Location: Northamptonshire
Rate: £55.00 per hour (Umbrella)
Contract: 3 Month Contract
Hours: Full Time
Working Pattern: Remote Working
Office Attendance: Required on the first day to collect IT equipment
Pay: Bi-Weekly

Summary

A Local Authority is in search of a seasoned Senior Adult Social Care Lawyer to join its Legal Services team on a temporary basis. This role offers a unique opportunity for a legal expert in adult social care to handle a diverse and challenging caseload, deliver specialized legal counsel on a wide array of adult social care issues, and contribute to the provision of top-tier legal services. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with Adult Social Care teams, senior officials, and various stakeholders, offering guidance on statutory duties, Court of Protection cases, safeguarding, and mental health laws.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee a complex caseload related to Adult Social Care.
  • Offer legal counsel on:
    • Care Act 2014
    • Mental Capacity Act 2005
    • Mental Health Act 1983
    • Health and Social Care Act 2008
  • Provide advice on:
    • Ordinary Residence
    • Safeguarding
    • Provider Failure
    • Section 117 Aftercare
    • Community Care Responsibilities
  • Prepare and file applications to:
    • Court of Protection
    • High Court
  • Handle cases involving:
    • Deputyship Applications
    • Welfare and Best Interests Applications
    • Deprivation of Liberty Matters
    • Section 21A Challenges
    • Judicial Reviews
    • Inherent Jurisdiction Applications
  • Attend court hearings and perform advocacy as needed.
  • Negotiate settlements and represent the Local Authority in legal proceedings.
  • Offer legal advice and support to Adult Social Care services and partner organizations.
  • Provide training and guidance to various departments and directorates.
  • Support the Principal Lawyer and step in as needed.
  • Assist with supervisory and management duties within the legal team.
  • Stay updated on legal developments to ensure advice is aligned with current laws and case law.
  • Contribute to the enhancement of a customer-focused legal service.

Essential


Requirements

Requirements:
  • Qualified Solicitor, Barrister, or Fellow of CILEX eligible to practice in England and Wales.
  • Valid practising certificate.
  • Extensive post-qualification experience in Adult Social Care Law.
  • In-depth knowledge of:
    • Care Act 2014
    • Mental Capacity Act 2005
    • Mental Health Act 1983
    • Health and Social Care Act 2008
  • Significant experience with Court of Protection cases.
  • Proven ability to manage complex Adult Social Care cases independently.
  • Experience in advocacy and court appearances.
  • Exceptional skills in legal drafting, communication, and negotiation.
  • Strong research and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to handle a demanding caseload and meet deadlines.

Desirable

  • Previous experience in a Local Authority legal setting.
  • Experience in supervising or mentoring junior staff.
  • Experience acting as a deputy for senior legal managers.
  • Experience in delivering legal training to operational services.
  • Experience working in a Lexcel-accredited legal practice.

What's on Offer?

  • £55.00 per hour (Umbrella)
  • 3 Month Contract
  • Remote Working
  • First Day Office Attendance Required for IT Collection
  • Bi-Weekly Pay
  • Opportunity to manage a diverse Adult Social Care caseload.
  • Extensive work with Court of Protection and safeguarding.
  • High degree of autonomy and responsibility.
  • Supportive environment within the Local Authority legal team.
Ideal for candidates with experience as a Senior Adult Social Care Lawyer, Adult Social Care Solicitor, Court of Protection Lawyer, Senior Solicitor, Community Care Lawyer, Mental Capacity Lawyer, Local Government Lawyer, or Adult Services Legal Advisor.

Senior Logistics Sales Executive – High-Value & Data Center Logistics

Location: Remote (Chicago preferred, but open nationwide for the right candidate)

Compensation:

  • Base Salary: $100,000–$125,000+ (Highly flexible for the right candidate)
  • Commission: 10% of Gross Margin after covering salary threshold
  • Uncapped Earnings
  • Leadership growth opportunity

Our client is a rapidly growing transportation company operating both asset-based and brokerage divisions with a unique specialization in high-value, high-security transportation.

The company expects to generate approximately $40–50 million in combined revenue this year, with brokerage revenue growing from approximately $11–12 million last year to an anticipated $20–25 million this year.

Unlike traditional brokerages competing strictly on price, the company has intentionally built a niche around freight requiring exceptional service, security, and specialized handling.

Their customer base includes:

  • Data Centers
  • Technology Companies
  • Pharmaceutical
  • Government
  • Freight Forwarders
  • Manufacturing
  • Consumer Products
  • Anheuser-Busch
  • USPS

The company also provides value-added services including:

  • White Glove Delivery
  • Final Mile
  • Liftgate Service
  • Pallet Jack Service
  • Debris Removal
  • Shrink Wrapping
  • Specialized Straight Truck Solutions

This is not a commodity brokerage. It's a specialized logistics provider focused on premium service and high-value freight.

Position Summary

We are seeking a proven Senior Logistics Sales Executive to accelerate the growth of its brokerage division.

This individual will focus on developing strategic customer relationships within industries where the company's specialized capabilities create a competitive advantage, particularly:

  • Data Centers
  • Technology
  • High-Value Freight
  • Government
  • Pharmaceutical
  • Freight Forwarding

The ideal candidate understands consultative selling and can leverage the company's unique combination of brokerage services, asset capacity, and white glove capabilities to win profitable business.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Develop new brokerage business nationwide
  • Prospect strategic shippers and freight forwarders
  • Sell specialized transportation solutions
  • Build long-term executive relationships
  • Work closely with leadership to help shape the future sales organization
  • Collaborate with operations to ensure flawless execution

Ideal Candidate

Required

  • 5+ years of freight brokerage sales experience
  • Strong hunter mentality
  • Demonstrated new business success
  • Experience selling truckload transportation
  • Executive-level communication skills
  • Self-starter who requires minimal management

Highly Preferred

Experience selling into one or more of:

  • Data Centers
  • Technology
  • High-Value Logistics
  • White Glove Transportation
  • Government Logistics
  • Pharmaceutical Transportation
  • Freight Forwarding

Candidates with relationships in these verticals will receive strong consideration.

Why Someone Would Join

A Specialized Brokerage

Rather than trying to be everything to everyone, the company is intentionally building expertise in niche transportation markets where service and security matter more than price.

Asset-Based Advantage

The company operates both brokerage and asset operations.

The asset fleet provides additional credibility with prospective customers while giving sales professionals another solution to offer clients when appropriate. All company assets are dry van equipment.

Technology Without Losing the Human Element

Leadership believes technology should make employees more productive—not replace relationships.

The company is actively developing proprietary in-house technology to eliminate redundant work while preserving the personalized customer service that differentiates the business.

Accessible Leadership

Sales professionals report directly to experienced leaders who pride themselves on being approachable, responsive, and committed to helping employees succeed.

The culture emphasizes collaboration, trust, and solving problems quickly—without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Opportunity to Build Something

This is more than another sales role.

The successful candidate will be one of the company's first dedicated outside sales professionals. Leadership is looking for an individual contributor who wants to roll up their sleeves, build meaningful revenue, and potentially help build and lead a larger sales organization in the future.

raw.description:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

About the Role

At 6sense, we believe exceptional people experiences are powered by great technology, trusted data, and meaningful insights. As the Sr. Manager, People Technology & Analytics, you will lead the strategy, governance, and evolution of our People technology ecosystem while transforming workforce data into actionable insights that drive business outcomes.

Reporting to the Chief People Officer, this role sits at the intersection of People strategy, technology, analytics, and operational excellence. You will own the vision and roadmap for People systems, data governance, workforce analytics, reporting, and AI enablement, ensuring our People organization can scale effectively while delivering an exceptional employee and manager experience.

You will partner closely with leaders across People, Finance, IT, Payroll, Legal, and the broader business to build a modern, data-driven People function that supports growth, improves decision-making, and creates operational efficiency.

This is a highly visible role for a strategic leader who is equally comfortable shaping long-term direction, influencing senior stakeholders, and working directly in Workday to configure, test, troubleshoot, and optimize the system. The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with the willingness and technical depth to solve complex operational challenges hands-on.

What You'll Do

People Technology Strategy & Operations

  • Own the strategy, governance, and continuous improvement of the People technology ecosystem, including Workday, Greenhouse, Pave, and related platforms.
  • Serve as a hands-on leader who directly configures, tests, troubleshoots, and maintains business processes, security, reports, integrations, and functionality across the Workday modules in use.
  • Develop and execute a multi-year People Technology roadmap aligned with business priorities and organizational growth.
  • Ensure the scalability, effectiveness, security, and reliability of People systems and processes.
  • Partner with IT, Security, Legal, and key business stakeholders to evaluate, implement, and optimize People technology solutions.
  • Lead technology enhancements, vendor management, system upgrades, integrations, and new platform implementations.
  • Drive process standardization and automation to improve efficiency and the employee experience.
  • Establish strong governance practices for system configuration, change management, documentation, and compliance.

People Analytics & Workforce Insights

  • Serve as the organization's trusted leader for workforce analytics, reporting, and People data strategy.
  • Develop executive-level dashboards, reporting frameworks, and workforce metrics that enable informed decision-making.
  • Translate complex workforce data into clear insights and recommendations for business leaders.
  • Partner with Finance and business leaders on workforce planning, headcount management, organizational health, and talent investment decisions.
  • Advance predictive and forward-looking analytics capabilities that help anticipate workforce trends and business needs.
  • Ensure reporting accuracy, consistency, and data integrity across all People systems.

Data Governance & Compliance

  • Establish and maintain best-in-class People data governance practices.
  • Champion data quality, data management standards, and system integrity across the employee lifecycle.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable employment, privacy, and data protection regulations.
  • Create processes and controls that support audit readiness and operational excellence.
  • Partner closely with Legal, Finance, and Security teams on compliance requirements and risk mitigation.

AI, Automation & Innovation

  • Lead the People organization's approach to AI-enabled productivity and automation.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify work, improve employee experiences, and enhance decision-making through emerging technologies.
  • Evaluate new tools and capabilities that support recruiting, talent management, workforce planning, employee engagement, and People operations.
  • Establish responsible AI governance and adoption practices within the People function.
  • Educate and enable People team members on practical applications of AI and automation.

Leadership & Capability Building

  • Build and develop a high-performing People Technology and Analytics function.
  • Create a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Establish clear priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations.
  • Mentor and develop team members while fostering technical expertise, business acumen, and strategic thinking.
  • Serve as a thought partner and trusted advisor to People leadership and business stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

Required Experience

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in HR Technology, People Analytics, Workforce Planning, HRIS, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of people leadership experience.
  • Deep hands-on Workday configuration and administration expertise across HCM, Benefits, Absence, Time Tracking, US Payroll, Talent Optimization, and Advanced Compensation, including business processes, security, reporting, testing, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Working knowledge of Workday integrations, including Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Core Connectors, Cloud Connect, Workday Studio, Reports as a Service (RaaS), REST APIs, and SOAP APIs.
  • Experience leading Workday release planning and regression testing, including assessing release impacts, coordinating end-to-end testing, resolving defects, documenting changes, and ensuring production readiness.
  • Familiarity with AI agents and Model Context Protocol (MCP), including their role in designing and orchestrating secure, scalable workflows that connect AI capabilities with enterprise systems, data, and People processes.
  • Strong understanding of workforce analytics, data management, and reporting practices.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and influencing decision-making through data and insights.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex cross-functional initiatives and technology implementations.
  • Experience managing vendors, software evaluations, and technology roadmaps.
  • Strong understanding of People processes across the employee lifecycle.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in high-growth SaaS or technology companies.
  • Experience supporting global organizations.
  • Workday Pro certifications in one or more relevant functional areas, demonstrating advanced platform expertise and a commitment to Workday configuration best practices.
  • Knowledge of Greenhouse, Pave, Tableau, Power BI, and related analytics platforms.
  • Experience with workforce planning, organizational design, and strategic talent planning.
  • Experience implementing AI-enabled HR technologies and automation solutions.
  • Familiarity with data privacy and compliance requirements, including GDPR and other applicable regulations.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Thinking
  • Project & Program Management
  • Business Acumen
  • Data Governance
  • Analytical Rigor
  • Technology Innovation
  • Executive Communication
  • Cross-Functional Influence
  • Systems Thinking
  • Process Improvement
  • Change Leadership
  • Talent Development

Success in the First 12 Months

  • Establish a clear People Technology and Analytics roadmap aligned with business priorities.
  • Improve overall data quality, reporting consistency, and system governance.
  • Modernize executive workforce reporting and self-service analytics capabilities.
  • Streamline and automate key People processes to improve efficiency and employee experience.
  • Develop stronger workforce planning and organizational insights capabilities in partnership with Finance.
  • Introduce practical AI-enabled solutions that improve the effectiveness of the People function.
  • Build a scalable foundation for future growth through technology, analytics, and operational excellence.

No Sicredi, valorizamos um ambiente colaborativo, em que diferentes conhecimentos se conectam para gerar impacto e apoiar a evolução do negócio. Acreditamos na troca, no desenvolvimento contínuo e na construção conjunta de soluções.

Buscamos uma pessoa Engenheira de Dados SR, em uma oportunidade preferencialmente voltada para mulheres, para atuar com integração, engenharia, governança e disponibilização de dados. A posição terá forte atuação técnica na construção e evolução de pipelines, ingestões, data marts, tabelas e dashboards, além da tradução de necessidades de negócio em soluções de dados. Também terá papel de liderança técnica, mentoria e colaboração com diferentes áreas, contribuindo para a qualidade, escalabilidade e evolução da estratégia de dados.

  • Integrar e automatizar novas fontes de dados ao data lake e data warehouse, garantindo dados acessíveis e utilizáveis.
  • Criar, manter e otimizar pipelines e processos de ingestão de dados, com foco em qualidade, performance, sustentabilidade e custo.

Navitus Health Solutions is seeking a Sr. Analyst, Channel Partner to join our team!

The Sr. Analyst, Channel Partner supports the channel partner division in its efforts to bolster our downstream sales and collaborations. This role independently drives and coordinates day-to-day operational activities for reseller clients, such as health plans, TPAs, and coalitions, from RFP intake through delivery. Among other job responsibilities, this position assesses incoming RFPs and channel opportunities, identifies requirements and appropriate stakeholders, establishes timelines, and works cross-functionally to drive deliverables through completion and ensure internal and external expectations are achieved. The Sr. Analyst serves as the operational foundation by maintaining reporting accuracy, coordinating opportunity execution, supporting partner enablement activities, and ensuring cross-functional alignment across growth initiatives. This Sr. Analyst proactively identifies risks, issues, and operational needs; recommends solutions and priorities; and escalates complex matters as appropriate.

Is this you? Find out more below!

Responsibilities

How do I make an impact on my team?

  • Independently manage operational execution across the Channel Partner function, including reporting, analytics, partner enablement, opportunity coordination, and RFP support.
  • Serve as a central point of coordination across channel partners, internal stakeholders, and strategic growth initiatives to keep work aligned and moving forward.
  • Manage opportunity intake, tracking, and reporting for channel partner requests and downstream sales opportunities; assess requirements and recommend prioritization based on business impact, timing, and partner needs.
  • Coordinate RFP activity from intake through completion, including stakeholder identification, assignments, timelines, deliverables, follow-up items, proposal materials, quality review, and follow-up; identify and escalate issues as appropriate.
  • Maintain visibility into active opportunities, partner requests, pipeline activity, and strategic growth initiatives to support planning and informed decision-making.
  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards to track channel performance, RFP activity, wins/losses, pipeline trends, partner engagement, and growth outcomes; analyze results and provide actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Support executive reporting, quarterly business reviews, and leadership updates by compiling and analyzing data and summarizing key findings and recommended actions.
  • Develop and maintain partner enablement resources, including toolkits, playbooks, training content, sales collateral, templates, and content libraries.
  • Support strategic planning and market research through partner summaries, competitive intelligence, business review materials, and growth opportunity analysis.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

What our team expects from you?

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Marketing, Business, Communications, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or equivalent work experience, required.
  • 5+ years of experience in sales support, account management, channel/partner operations, business operations, or a related function required.
  • Experience independently coordinating multiple priorities across cross-functional teams and driving work through completion required.
  • Experience with reporting and data analysis, including interpreting information to develop insights or recommendations, required.

Are you looking to accelerate your career without having to hide your authentic self - a place where you can be you? A career that’s making a bigger impact on the world? At OneDigital, we are on a mission to help people do their best work and live their best lives. From the services we offer to the way we show up for each other each day, we are fueling dreams, achieving big goals, and embracing each other’s truest selves.


We understand that pursuing a new job is a big deal. Maybe you’re afraid you won’t fit in. Well, here’s the good news. For us, the days of “fit in to get in” are over and being different is not a barrier to getting ahead. Greatness comes in all shapes, sizes, colors, and experience levels. If you are looking for a people-first culture that is wired for growth, driven to serve, and totally committed to having your back, give us a shot. Your best life awaits.


Must be eligible to work in the United States without the need for work visa or residency sponsorship.


We kindly ask that external recruiters, agencies, and search firms do not contact our hiring managers or employees directly regarding open positions. All candidate submissions must go through our official application process and must be made aware to our internal Talent Acquisition team to verify candidate ownership.

Unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles sent to OneDigital without a prior signed agreement will be considered the property of OneDigital. In such cases, OneDigital reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidates without any financial obligation to the agency or recruiter.


Our Newest Opportunity:

OneDigital is looking for a Senior Compensation Analyst to own the data, processes, and cycles that keep our pay programs accurate and running smoothly. This is an independent, internal-facing role split evenly between analysis and hands-on process ownership. You will serve as the subject matter expert and administrator for our merit, bonus, and promotion cycles, and you will help shape how we use new compensation technology and AI tools. This role reports into the People Technology and Innovation function.


What You'll Do

  • Own salary survey submissions, including data cleanup, validation, and market pricing using multiple market survey sources.
  • Administer the merit, bonus, and promotion cycles end to end, from planning, configuration, and testing through data loads, communications support, and post-cycle audits.
  • Test new compensation functionality, including system releases, new modules, and merit-cycle configuration, and partner with HRIS on validation and rollout.
  • Pilot, validate, and manage AI tools for compensation work, reviewing outputs for accuracy, managing prompts, workflows, and agents, and ensuring appropriate use.
  • Deliver ongoing compensation analysis, market pricing, and offer and pay recommendations that help leaders make sound decisions.
  • Build costing and cost models that give leaders a clear view of the impact of pay decisions.
  • Partner with HRIS, Payroll, Talent Management, and HR colleagues to resolve issues and keep pay programs running smoothly.
  • Document processes and recommend improvements that make our compensation practices more accurate, efficient, and scalable.

What You Bring

  • You have 5+ years of progressive experience in compensation or a related analytical field, with a track record of delivering accurate results independently.
  • You have strong data validation skills and catch errors, inconsistencies, and gaps before they reach decision-makers.
  • You are an advanced Excel user, comfortable with lookups, pivots, data manipulation, and large data sets.
  • You bring analytical rigor and close attention to detail, and you can explain your findings clearly to HR partners and business leaders.
  • You use AI tools effectively and critically, getting real value from them while verifying outputs and applying sound judgment.
  • You take ownership of processes, manage competing deadlines during cycle periods, and work well with cross-functional partners.

Why This Role

This role gives you real ownership of high-visibility compensation cycles and a direct hand in how AI and new system capabilities change the way compensation work gets done. You will work with a high degree of independence, and your analysis will directly inform pay decisions across the organization. If you want to build better processes as well as run them, you will find plenty of room to make your mark and grow your expertise here.

The typical base pay range for this role nationwide is $90,000 to $105,000 per year.

raw.description:
Clinical Pharmacist

Job Purpose:

Provide integrated support to patients and physicians by providing a "hands-on" approach to improve the quality of patient care. This is accomplished by developing personalized relationships with patients and prescribers to improve medication adherence and promote evidence-based care.

Salary: An employee in this position who performs the job duties in Oregon can expect a salary rate between $125,000-$145,000 (Hourly Equivalent: Approximately $60.00-$69.71 per hour, based on a 40-hour workweek.) plus bonus pursuant to the terms of an any bonus plan if applicable. The actual salary will depend on experience, geographic location, and other factors permitted by law.

What You’ll Get:

  • $10,000 Sign-on Bonus
  • Salary + Bonus
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance starting day one
  • 401(k) with match, 4 weeks PTO, 10 paid holidays
  • Paid parental leave, short-term disability, and professional development
  • Access to employee resource groups and wellness programs

Job Duties:

  • Reviewing and interpreting clinician's patient care note/assessments for supportive clinical data needed for prior authorization approvals and development of care plan recommendations.
  • Develop and refine disease and drug specific clinical protocol to maximize patient adherence and promote evidence-based cost-effective care.
  • Monitor on-going patient adherence (PDC reports, patient assessment data, and mobile platform data) across all sites and disease categories with focus on oncology and other specialty specific disease states.
  • Evaluation of EMR to review: drug and disease interaction, medication selection, labs/vitals, allergies, RX orders/renewals and direct MD communication, and other relevant information important to maximize medication adherence and optimize patient outcomes.
  • Recommending alternative therapeutic drug regimens and disease specific treatments according to guidelines as appropriate.
  • Monitor and evaluate therapies for side effects or other medication related issues, recommend drug therapy changes to prescribers as appropriate.
  • Medication therapy management (MTM): including reviewing and monitoring of medication regimens, advising clinicians on evidence based therapy as indicated, documenting interventions; assessing patient adherence rates.
  • Clinical interventions including but are not limited to comprehensive pharmacist consultation, motivational interviewing/coaching, drug regimen optimization, medication reconciliation, medication lists or reminders, medication synchronization, coordinate home nurse visits, transitions between liaison/PSC, use of mobile app or other technologies.
  • Productivity monitoring and reporting weekly stats for growth development
  • Overseeing tech's daily activities and verification for accuracy on: delivery coordination slips, prior authorizations submitted, ongoing PA log activity and proactive management care utilization within each specialty as per protocol.
  • Identifying and resolving insurance related issues, recognizing situations where financial assistance can be applied.
  • Supervising communication of support personnel compliant with HIPPA rules and regulations;
  • Maintaining current registration and all remote pharmacist activity to comply with local, state and federal drug laws as regulated by each state board of pharmacy and the DEA.
  • Direct communication with other health professionals as necessary regarding patient care;
  • Develops own knowledge by participating in education programs; training pharmacy staff, students, interns, externs, and health care professionals;
  • Manage, organize, and update relevant data using database applications;
  • Apply observations and recommendations to operational issues, increased productivity, quality, and customer-service standards;
  • Assist with research projects and peer reviewing articles as needed.
  • Identify trends, resolves problems; recommend improvements; implements change;
  • Actively participates in process improvement initiatives;
  • Protects organization's value by keeping information confidential;
  • Updates job knowledge by participating in educational opportunities; reading professional publications; maintaining personal networks; participating in professional organizations;
  • Willing to do whatever is necessary for the betterment of the Company;
  • Other duties as assigned;

Skills: Analyze information, exercise good judgment, possess strong verbal and written communication skills, have deep knowledge of specialty medication pharmacology, local/state/federal pharmacy regulations, able to manage processes, exhibit strong technical and clinical skills, excellent leader and manager of people, constant focus on legal compliance, highly productive, quality focused and attention to detail. Must be computer literate with proficiency and working knowledge of database and reporting tools such as: Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.(***Knowledge using EPIC/QS1/WILLOW software a plus***) Must have the ability to identify barriers to medication adherence and implement and monitor plans to improve medication adherence. The ability to motivate and coach patients to help them achieve better outcomes and identify goals of therapy.

Traits: Organized, high-integrity, attention to detail, dependable, quality focus, empathetic, good listener/communicator

Other: Energetic, highly motivated, team player with strong personal and communication skills; discretion and confidentiality essential as position deals with highly sensitive and private data

Specialties: Knowledge of complex/chronic diseases states and therapies used within specialty pharmacy: Oncology, Transplant, Hepatitis C, Infectious Disease (including HIV), Multiple Sclerosis, Rheumatoid Arthritis, GI disorders (including IBD), Cystic Fibrosis, Psoriasis, Hyperlipidemia and many various inflammatory conditions (including Lupus) preferred.

Experience/ Education:

Required Licensure/Certification: Applicant must hold a Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD) or equivalent advanced degree and be a licensed Pharmacist in state of Oregon

Years of Experience: 1+ years' experience is strongly preferred but not required. Should additional licensure need to be obtained, the applicant will commit to obtaining the required licensure within a mutually agreed upon timeframe. Continued employment is contingent upon meeting these requirements.

Education: PharmD or equivalent advanced degree required

Solid computer skills are required, including proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint) for communication, documentation, and data management, as well as, navigating the internet and web-based platforms. Data entry and computer skills will be evaluated through an assessment as part of the pre-employment process.

raw.excerpt: Treasure AI:Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers.
raw.description:
Treasure AI:

Treasure AI is the agentic experience platform built to acquire, retain, and grow your most valuable customers. Powered by AI, Treasure AI is shaped by human creativity and always-on through continuous, context-driven action.

Furthermore, Treasure AI employees are enthusiastic, data-driven, and customer-obsessed. We are a team of drivers—self-starters who take initiative, anticipate needs, and proactively jump in to solve problems. Our actions reflect our values of honesty, reliability, openness, and humility.

Your Role:

Treasure AI is hiring a Security Engineer, GRC to architect, build, and automate the systems that power our Trust & Assurance (T&A) program. The right person for this role gets frustrated by manual compliance work — not because it's beneath them, but because they know it doesn't have to exist.

This role sits at the intersection of security engineering and GRC. You will design, operate, and maintain the systems that make compliance continuous, visible in real-time, and GRC insights actionable. You will treat the GRC platform as a programmable surface, extend it via APIs and agent workflows, and integrate it with the rest of Treasure AI's tech stack.

You will work closely with GRC Specialists, taking program requirements and translating them into technical implementations — automations, integrations, dashboards, guardrails, and tooling. You will also work directly with Security, IT, Engineering, and Product teams to embed compliance into the systems and pipelines they already use.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation. You will use agentic tools to accelerate your own work and will build AI-powered automations into GRC workflows — from evidence ingestion to questionnaire response to executive reporting.

Responsibilities & Duties:

  • Build AI agent workflows (using Claude, MCP integrations, or similar) to automate repeatable GRC tasks.

  • Configure and maintain the technical configuration and extension of our GRC platform — architect data relationships, configure control workflows, build custom rules, and extend the platform via APIs and webhooks rather than relying on the default UI.

  • Build automated executive readout workflows so monthly and quarterly GRC reporting is a 30-minute review, not a multi-day build.

  • Design and operate automated evidence collection pipelines and continuous control monitoring — pulling signals directly from source systems in real time so drift is surfaced before audit time, not during it.

  • Translate controls into testable, codified checks. Identify gaps in compliance coverage across CI/CD pipelines and IaC (Terraform) and contribute compliance logic where gaps exist.

  • Embed lightweight compliance checkpoints into design review workflows, ensuring control-relevant changes are flagged before deployment.

  • Support FAIR-informed quantitative risk modeling with data pipelines and tooling that make risk scenarios computable rather than narrative-only.

  • Build and maintain automation for the TPRM lifecycle — vendor intake, risk scoring, questionnaire distribution, evidence analysis, and remediation tracking — using AI-assisted tooling to reduce per-vendor manual effort.

  • Build tooling and dashboards that give the GRC Specialist and business stakeholders a continuous view of privileged access, access exceptions, and open remediation items — replacing point-intime UAR reports with an always-on IGA posture.

  • Build and maintain automation across the customer trust surface — AI-assisted questionnaire response pipelines, RFP contribution workflows, and trust center content management — so customer assurance accelerates deals rather than bottlenecking them.

  • Build automation across the security awareness and training lifecycle — detecting end-user risk signals or policy violations to improve the culture of security.

Required Qualifications:

  • At least 3+ years in Security Engineering, DevSecOps, Technical GRC, or a closely adjacent function — with a demonstrably strong engineering track record in automation and tooling, not just program ownership.

  • Strong coding foundation: proficient in Python and/or TypeScript, comfortable calling REST APIs, handling JSON/YAML payloads, building webhooks, and shipping integrations from scratch without hand-holding or assistance. You treat Jira, Confluence, Slack, and similar enterprise tools as systems to integrate with, not just UIs to click through.

  • Hands-on experience building automation and integrations in enterprise environments — not just configuring OOTB features, but writing code to extend or connect systems.

  • Practical hands-on experience with a modern GRC platform (Vanta, anecdotes, Drata, Secureframe, or similar) — you've configured custom workflows, written rules, and used the APIs; not just the UI.

  • Working knowledge of SOC 2, ISO 27001/17/18, ISO 42001 and HIPAA — enough to read a control and determine how to test it programmatically.

  • Demonstrated experience shipping AI-assisted automation: agent workflows, prompt pipelines, LLM-integrated integrations, or similar. Comfort with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or equivalent).

  • Familiarity with the AWS security control surface (IAM, CloudTrail, Config, GuardDuty) and how to consume compliance signals via API; working knowledge of CI/CD workflows (GitHub Actions or similar) and IaC (Terraform or equivalent) — you understand where compliance checks can be embedded in a deployment pipeline.

  • Strong collaboration and written communication skills — able to work across multiple Security domains, IT, Engineering, Legal/Privacy, and GTM, and able to write clear technical documentation.

Travel Requirements:

Annual team on-site in the US/CAN (total travel: <10%)

Perks and Benefits (US):

Our benefit package showcases our culture of care and empathy with

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision plans and Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Competitive compensation packages

  • Company paid life insurance 3x salary

  • Company paid short- and long-term disability coverage

  • Retirement planning (401K) with 4% company match

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSU)

  • Flexible Time Off (FTO)

  • Up to 26 weeks paid parental leave including a post-partum night nurse

  • Comprehensive support and access to care for everyone, everywhere through Carrot - our global reproductive health and family-building benefit.

Our Dedication to You:

We value and promote diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging in all aspects of our business and at all levels. Success comes from acknowledging, welcoming, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

Diverse representation alone is not the desired outcome. We also strive to create an inclusive culture that encourages growth, ownership of your role, and achieving innovation in new and unique ways. Your voice will be heard, and we will help amplify it.

Agencies and Recruiters:

We cannot consider your candidate(s) without a contract in place. Any resumes received without having an active agreement will be considered gratis referrals to us. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation!

This description captures the core of the role today. As we adopt AI and new ways of working, responsibilities may evolve, and we encourage team members to take initiative, lean into change, and help expand the impact of their role beyond what’s listed here.

title: Plastic & Material Science Intern
description: World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a Plastic & Material Science Intern with demonstrated skills in technical writing, research and analysis, project management, and stakeholder engagement.

raw.title: Plastic & Material Science Intern
raw.excerpt: World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a Plastic & Material Science Intern with demonstrated skills in technical writing, research and analysis, project management, and stakeholder engagement.
raw.description:
World Wildlife Fund (WWF), one of the world’s leading conservation organizations, seeks a Plastic & Material Science Intern with demonstrated skills in technical writing, research and analysis, project management, and stakeholder engagement. The intern will work closely with members of WWF’s Private Sector Engagement department on the Plastic & Material Science team, specifically on projects related to biobased and biodegradable materials, alternative materials, and responsible feedstock sourcing.

WWF believes we need to reimagine how we source, design, reuse, and dispose of the plastic materials communities most depend on. We need holistic systems change that includes reduction, reuse, substitution of materials, recycling, and better waste management. To do this, we need to use less plastic, make the plastic that we do use better, and ensure that it gets used more than once—creating circularity. WWF’s approach to tackling global plastic pollution unites a global network of industry leaders, policymakers, and the public to transform our systems so the plastics we discard can become plastics we use again. The intern will support WWF's Bioplastic Feedstock Alliance efforts, where we are advancing thought leadership on responsibly sourced biobased plastic, so companies are equipped with the best science and sourcing practices as they shift to sustainable inputs for their new plastic needs.

This internship provides an opportunity to engage with business stakeholders, improve research, analysis, and project coordination skills in a professional setting, gain knowledge about supply chains and sourcing, corporate sustainability, public policy, and environmental issues, and contribute to WWF’s mission. The work will involve research, technical writing, and project management in support of programs that address plastic pollution. 

Responsibilities

  • Support technical writing and content development for sustainability initiatives within the Plastic & Material Science team.

  • Conduct research and analysis on environmental performance, supply chain risks, and emerging trends related to materials and packaging.

  • Analyze alternative materials, product applications, and policy measures relevant to sustainable materials and plastics.

  • Contribute to project management and administrative coordination across team initiatives and partnerships.

  • Support stakeholder engagement and cross-functional collaboration with internal and external partners.

  • Develop written materials and engagement assets by synthesizing technical information and aligning findings with WWF’s broader conservation mission.

  • Assist in planning and executing multi-stakeholder events, including coordination with external partners such as companies, NGOs, and WWF network offices.

Learning Outcomes

  • Develop project management and coordination skills through sustainability-focused initiatives and multi-stakeholder event planning.

  • Strengthen research and analytical abilities by assessing environmental performance and supply chain risks of recovered and biobased materials.

  • Enhance technical communication by producing reports, presentations, blogs, and other corporate engagement materials.

  • Gain exposure to corporate sustainability strategies and stakeholder engagement with companies, NGOs, and WWF offices.

  • Build foundational knowledge of environmental policy, circular economy, and commodity sourcing risks.

  • Experience professional collaboration in a mission-driven organization aligned with WWF’s core values of courage, respect, integrity, and collaboration.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Current student or recent graduate in a relevant field such as corporate sustainability, natural resources, material science, environmental science, or sustainable development are preferred; highly qualified undergraduate students may be considered. Those studying outside these areas are still highly encouraged to apply.

  • Ability to work full-time (35 hours per week) for 6 months is required.

  • Strong attention to detail, time management, and ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team setting.

  • Excellent research, analytical, and professional communication skills, both written and verbal.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Outlook, Teams, OneNote, Excel, PowerPoint, Word) and willingness to learn new platforms.

  • Preferred experience in managing research projects, engaging external collaborators, and familiarity with environmental impacts and corporate sustainability.

  • Preferred knowledge of topics related to circular systems, biobased plastic, alternative materials, agriculture, forestry, and climate.

  • Fluency in English is required.

  • Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values: Courage, Integrity, Respect, and Collaboration:

  • Demonstrates courage by speaking up even when it is difficult, or unpopular.

  • Builds trust with colleagues by acting with integrity, owning mistakes, and holding oneself accountable.

  • Welcomes other points of view and ideas, recognizing and embracing different and contrary perspectives with kindness, curiosity, and encouragement.

  • Makes conscious efforts to promote cooperative practices, behaviors, and ways of working across many groups and individuals.

  • Identifies and aligns with WWF’s core values:

    • COURAGE – We demonstrate courage through our actions, we work for change where it’s needed, and we inspire people and institutions to tackle the greatest threats to nature and the future of the planet, which is our home.

    • INTEGRITY – We live the principles we call on others to meet. We act with integrity, accountability, and transparency, and we rely on facts and science to guide us and to ensure that we learn and evolve.

    • RESPECT – We honor the voices and knowledge of people and communities that we serve, and we work to secure their rights to a sustainable future.

    • COLLABORATION – We deliver impact at the scale of the challenges we face through the power of collective action and innovation.

US Remote – WWF employs in all states with the exception of: Hawaii, Kentucky, Nevada, Oklahoma.

Please note: Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship.  In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

WWF does not provide VISA sponsorship to interns.

World Wildlife Fund (WWF) promotes equal employment opportunities for all qualified individuals regardless of age, race, color, sex, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Founded in 1961, WWF works to help people and nature thrive. As a global conservation organization, WWF operates in more than 100 countries, partnering with communities, companies, and governments to protect wildlife, conserve vital habitats, and advance sustainable solutions. Grounded in science and driven by collaboration, WWF works to help nature by conserving biodiversity, supporting resilient communities, and addressing climate change. Nearly 1 million people in the United States and more than 5 million globally are WWF members.

ABOUT ADVANTMED

Advantmed is a leading provider of risk adjustment, quality improvement, and value-based solutions to health plans and providers. We drive market leading performance with integrated technology, service, and program solutions that improve the risk adjustment and quality programs of our partners. Our solutions focus on identifying, managing, and documenting risk and quality performance, and the proactive clinical engagement of high acuity populations.

Job Summary

The IHA Account Manager (PAM - Prospective Services Account Manager) is the client-facing operations subject matter expert for In-Home Health Assessment programs, from implementation through ongoing delivery. The PAM works with Operations, Planning, Implementation, and Client Success to meet client requirements, ensure delivery of production goals and SLAs, resolve escalations promptly, and manage process changes effectively. This is a non-sales individual contributor role.

Advantmed IHA Account Manager Overview -

Key Responsibilities

Client Communication

  • Support in new client implementation calls with clients as an Ops SME. Review requirements and liaise with Operations Teams on deliverables
  • Attend weekly client calls led by Client Success Team as an Ops SME on calls. This may be video calls via MS Teams.
  • Share production plans with clients and explain the reasons for any changes. Answer pertinent questions
  • Present IHA guidelines on client calls and answer related questions.
  • Support discussions related to the client portal, including queries, requested changes, and solutions.
  • Participate in discussions related to additional volume and liaise with internal teams as needed.

Service Delivery & Coordination

  • Address client service questions and escalations.
  • Support the complaint handling process, including closing the loop with clients.
  • Review project health and liaise with Operations when status is Amber or Red to develop a Plan of Action (POA). POA formulation is the responsibility of the Operations/Planning Team; presenting the POA to the client is the responsibility of the PAM.
  • Coordinate with Operations and support items critical to client SLAs.
  • Liaise with respective teams to manage client deliverables.
  • Monitor tasks to ensure timely close-looping with the client and Front Office.
  • Support the Process Change Request process by facilitating discussions with Operations and supporting solutioning once approved, including follow-up with Operations and communication with the PM/CE teams.
  • Participate in cross-functional OKRs and Initiatives led by various teams
  • Review all client-facing ad hoc reports prepared by the Planning Team to ensure they align with client needs.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • Certification in Business Administration, Account Management, or a related field, or equivalent work experience is an added advantage

Experience

  • Minimum of 2–3 years of Account Management (or similar) experience in the healthcare industry.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA and healthcare data privacy requirements.
  • Experience working with Operations/multiple stake holders
  • Computer Savvy. Experience working with MS Excel, PowerPoint and other relevant tools
  • Experience managing SLAs, service health reporting (RAG status), and corrective action plans.
  • Project management or account management certification (e.g., PMP, CAPM) is a plus.

Skills & Competencies

  • Excellent communication, interpersonal, presentation, and negotiation skills, with a commitment to exceptional customer service.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to analyze data and prepare basic reports.
  • Effective organization, time management, multitasking, and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet deadlines under pressure.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively within a team.
  • Proactive, results-oriented approach with flexibility to adapt to evolving industry trends and client needs.

Key Performance Indicators

  • Proactive approach to Client Production Goals achievement
  • Adherence to client SLAs including client satisfaction
  • Timeliness of escalation and complaint resolution, including closing the loop with clients.
  • Timely closure of client action items and deliverables.
  • Achievement of IHA_AM and cross-functional OKRs.

Key Working Relationships

  • Internal: Operations, Planning, Implementation, PM/CE, Client Success, Sales, Marketing, Front Office, and Finance/Invoicing teams.
  • External: Client stakeholders, including program, operations, and quality contacts.

Benefits

The annual salary range for this position is $55,000 - $60,000. Final compensation will be determined based on the candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications.

raw.description:
About Our Company:
At Infinx, we're a fast-growing company focused on delivering innovative technology solutions to meet our clients' needs. We partner with healthcare providers to leverage automation and intelligence, overcoming revenue cycle challenges and improving reimbursements for patient care. Our clients include physician groups, hospitals, pharmacies, and dental groups.
We're looking for experienced associates and partners with expertise in areas that align with our clients' needs. We value individuals who are passionate about helping others, solving challenges, and improving patient care while maximizing revenue. Diversity and inclusivity are central to our values, fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued and heard.

A 2025 Great Place to Work®

In 2025, Infinx was certified as a Great Place to Work® in both the U.S. and India, underscoring our commitment to fostering a high-trust, high-performance workplace culture. This marks the fourth consecutive year that Infinx India has achieved certification and the first time the company has earned recognition in the U.S.

Location: Remote or Hybrid in Houston, TX or New Orleans, LA preferred

Summary Description

The Director – Revenue Cycle Operations serves as the Revenue Cycle Management domain lead within the Strategic Delivery function and is responsible for ensuring successful operational design, implementation, stabilization, and transition of strategic client engagements. The role provides deep functional expertise across billing, charge entry, payment posting, accounts receivable, denials, appeals, collections, and related back-end revenue cycle functions. Primary accountability includes translating contractual commitments and client expectations into executable operating models, validating workload and staffing assumptions, supporting operational readiness, resolving delivery challenges, and helping strategic engagements achieve defined service, quality, productivity, and financial outcomes. This position works closely with Customer Success, Onshore and Offshore Operations, Product, Technology, Quality, Training, Compliance, and client stakeholders. Direct ownership of routine steady-state production is not the primary focus. Strategic Delivery involvement will typically extend from contract execution through implementation and the initial stabilization period, followed by structured transition to the designated Operations team with periodic delivery assurance reviews thereafter.

Job Responsibilities
  • Strategic Delivery & Implementation
    • Lead Revenue Cycle delivery planning for strategic client implementations and complex operational transitions
    • Translate contract scope, client expectations, workflows, volumes, and service requirements into executable operating plans
    • Conduct operational discovery and validate assumptions before implementation
    • Perform detailed inventory analysis across AR, billing, denials, payment posting, charge entry, and related workflows
    • Develop effort estimates, productivity assumptions, staffing requirements, skill profiles, and capacity models
    • Identify operational risks, dependencies, access requirements, and implementation gaps before go-live
    • Establish implementation milestones, readiness criteria, ownership, and escalation pathways
    • Partner with Patient Access and Coding Strategic Delivery leads to ensure end-to-end alignment across the revenue cycle
  • Revenue Cycle Domain Leadership
    • Provide subject matter expertise across charge entry, claims submission and billing, payment posting, AR follow-up, denial management and appeals, collections, credit balances and refunds, payer follow-up, reimbursement workflows, and inventory management
    • Evaluate existing client workflows and recommend scalable, efficient operating models
    • Analyze payer behavior, aging trends, denial patterns, reimbursement issues, and revenue leakage opportunities
    • Support Operations teams with complex functional issues and critical client escalations
    • Recommend solutions based on operational data, root-cause analysis, and industry best practices
  • Pre-Go-Live Readiness
    • Validate scope, volumes, productivity benchmarks, staffing assumptions, and client expectations prior to launch
    • Support workforce planning, hiring profiles, candidate assessment, and staffing readiness
    • Define operational service levels, key performance indicators, quality expectations, turnaround times, and productivity standards
    • Ensure process documentation and standard operating procedures are complete and aligned with contractual requirements
    • Support development and validation of training programs, knowledge assessments, and operational readiness plans
    • Confirm system access, payer portal access, reporting requirements, workflow queues, and client dependencies
    • Partner with Product and Technology teams to validate product configuration and workflow readiness
  • Go-Live & Delivery Assurance
    • Provide hands-on delivery leadership during strategic client go-lives
    • Establish and lead daily governance during critical implementation periods
    • Monitor production volumes, inventory, backlog, quality, productivity, turnaround time, and staffing utilization
    • Support production planning and workload prioritization
    • Coordinate resolution of operational, product, system, workflow, access, and training issues
    • Provide functional guidance to Onshore and Offshore Operations teams
    • Participate in client implementation and delivery meetings as needed
