    • Identify training gaps and facilitate targeted retraining or knowledge reinforcement
    • Ensure SOPs remain current as workflows evolve during implementation
    • Partner with Operations leadership to build independent delivery capability
    • Drive timely resolution of customer concerns and delivery escalations
    • Support account-level gross margin improvement by identifying operational inefficiencies and staffing opportunities
  • Transition to Steady-State Operations
    • Develop and execute a structured transition plan to the designated Onshore or Offshore Operations team
    • Ensure complete knowledge transfer, documentation, training, reporting, and ownership before handoff
    • Establish clear steady-state roles and responsibilities across Operations, Customer Success, Product, and support functions
    • Define exit criteria and validate operational readiness before Strategic Delivery ownership is reduced
    • Continue periodic delivery assurance reviews for strategic accounts following transition
    • Re-engage when material delivery risk, escalation, or performance deterioration is identified
  • Performance Management & Analytics
    • Establish performance scorecards for strategic implementations and stabilization programs
    • Monitor and analyze key RCM indicators including Days in AR, aging distribution, denial rates, clean claim rate, first-pass yield, collection efficiency, cash acceleration, productivity, quality, backlog, and turnaround time
    • Convert operational data into recommendations, corrective actions, and measurable improvement plans
    • Provide concise executive reporting on implementation status, risks, client impact, and required actions
  • Client & Stakeholder Governance
    • Serve as a senior operational subject matter expert for strategic client engagements
    • Participate in implementation calls, operational reviews, MBRs, QBRs, and escalation discussions as required
    • Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure client commitments are reflected accurately in operational delivery
    • Maintain strong alignment between client expectations, contractual commitments, product capabilities, and operational execution
    • Present solution-oriented recommendations rather than only identifying delivery problems
    • Support customer confidence through strong domain expertise, structured communication, and timely resolution of issues
  • Product, Technology & AI Enablement
    • Partner with Product teams, including RCM+, PA+, and other relevant platforms, to align technology capabilities with client workflows
    • Identify opportunities for automation, artificial intelligence, workflow optimization, and reduction of manual effort
    • Translate operational pain points into clearly defined product requirements and improvement opportunities
    • Support testing, workflow validation, and implementation of new technology capabilities
    • Capture recurring operational issues that may warrant product or process redesign
  • SOP, Training & Knowledge Management
    • Ensure complete and current SOPs are developed for assigned strategic engagements
    • Build repeatable delivery playbooks and implementation standards
    • Facilitate knowledge transfer between client-facing, onshore, and offshore teams
    • Ensure critical knowledge is institutionalized rather than dependent on individual resources
    • Conduct post-implementation lessons-learned reviews
    • Translate lessons learned into improvements to SOPs, training materials, workflows, implementation frameworks, and product capabilities
  • Global Delivery Collaboration
    • Partner with Offshore Operations leadership to establish scalable delivery models for strategic engagements
    • Support offshore readiness, skill development, staffing, training, and knowledge transfer
    • Ensure alignment between onshore and offshore teams on scope, workflows, performance expectations, and escalation protocols
    • Provide domain guidance during complex production or client situations
    • Facilitate transition of work to offshore teams where appropriate while protecting service quality and client expectations
    • Support development of standardized operating rhythms across geographies
  • Continuous Improvement & Delivery Excellence
    • Identify recurring delivery gaps across strategic accounts and develop repeatable solutions
    • Promote standardization across client implementations while accommodating legitimate client-specific requirements
    • Develop reusable templates, checklists, dashboards, and delivery playbooks
    • Support development and continuous improvement of the Strategic Delivery operating framework
    • Identify opportunities to improve scalability, quality, productivity, customer satisfaction, and gross margin

    • Master’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field

  • 5+ years in a leadership, consulting, implementation, transition, or operational transformation capacity preferred
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of end-to-end physician and/or ambulatory RCM workflows
  • Strong experience across billing, payment posting, AR, denials, appeals, collections, and reimbursement processes

  • Experience developing SOPs, training frameworks, operational controls, and performance metrics

  • Strong understanding of payer processes, reimbursement methodologies, denial management, and revenue cycle performance indicators
  • Relevant certifications preferred, such as:

    • Project management or transition management certification
  • Deep Revenue Cycle Management domain expertise
  • Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving capability
  • Strong operational and financial analytical skills
  • Ability to translate client requirements into scalable operating solutions
  • Strong implementation and transition management capability

  • Strong customer-facing and stakeholder-management capability

If you’re passionate about helping people protect what matters most to them at a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales, as well as innovating and simplifying processes and operations to provide the best customer value, then Nationwide’s Property and Casualty team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.

This is a remote/work-from-home (WFH) production underwriting role focused on Commercial Lines Middle Market accounts within the Human Services and Nonprofit industry segment.


Territory: New England

This territory will be focused on and include all of New England (CT, MA, ME, NH, RI, VT), with the potential for 1-2 states in another region, depending on the business need and respective book of business.

The selected candidate may be based anywhere within the Eastern Time Zone but must be able to regularly travel to key agency partners throughout the assigned territory, with an expectation of at least 25 agency visits per year. Preferably, this individual will be based in the Mid-Atlantic or Northeast regions.


Qualified candidates must possess:

  • Multi-line commercial insurance underwriting experience, including underwriting authority
  • Human Services and Nonprofit industry-specific experience
  • Strong business development skills, with a production & agency management orientation

Highly competitive candidates will have at least five years of experience handling Human Services and Nonprofit accounts and a strong skill set in underwriting Casualty lines, including General Liability, Professional Liability, and Abuse & Molestation.


This role does not qualify for employer-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the Stem OPT Extension program.


The internal title for this role is Territory Manager, Specialty Care Business Development.


Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As a Territory Manager, you'll market, manage and underwrite commercial business with select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through developing, negotiating and implementing business plans. You'll lead and influence agencies by creating sales strategies and implementing sales processes and practices that drive new sales, increase shelf space, profit and customer retention. To succeed, it will be important to collaborate with internal business partners to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and other factors to win the account.

  • Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement plans. Analyzes regional underwriting performance experience, identifies problems on a territory level and proposes plans to resolve those situations.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis. Decisions require review of multiple variables, using agency relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions. Reviews for acceptability and handles those within authority using company underwriting guidelines and standards.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting assigned work by utilizing company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, sophisticated work and coordinates work with others to meet service level agreements. Effectively influences activities of the team to facilitate the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, accountabilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to improve profit and pipeline management. Proactively finds opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the Middle Market Underwriting Team on new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all products that may improve offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and developing business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Consults with agents and internal partners to develop business solutions. Shares understanding of organizational capabilities and opportunities to drive maximum value of relationships. Consults regarding the appetite, acceptability, terms, conditions, pricing and sales techniques of large or unique business. Provides industry trend observations to leadership. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options and to improve retention and profitability.

  • Communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates market intelligence to agencies and leaders. Communicates and collaborates actively with team and leaders to share industry trends and field underwriting experience.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance and enhance agency relationships. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter authority.

  • Manages a significant workload effectively and backs up others as needed. Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Director or Associate Vice President.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is preferred.

License/Certification/Designation: Relevant professional designation such as CPCU or CIC is preferred.

Experience: Seven years of progressively more responsible underwriting and sales experience in commercial business preferred. Expertise in markets consistent with our underwriting preferences and product portfolio preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Detailed working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for middle market business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and within company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and Human Resources Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid driver’s license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

If you are looking to work in a team environment, a place where you are more a name than a number, where you interact with leadership daily, then please send your resume for review!

WE HELP PEOPLE IN DEBT FINDA CLEAR PATH TO FINANCIAL STABILITY

•We treat clients with empathy and respect

•We are honest and build trust

•We deliver quality with urgency

•We learn and improve every day

•We are humble

Perks:

  • Strong culture supported by actively engaged ownership and leadership.
  • Casual and fun work environment
  • Room for advancement
  • 80 Hours of New Hire training
  • PTO

About You:

You’re a positive, motivated person seeking an opportunity with huge financial and career growth potential. You connect quickly with others, enjoy building relationships, appreciate variety in the work you do and the pure pleasure of helping people.

Why You?

raw.excerpt: About High ScaleWe’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media.
raw.description:
About High Scale

We’re High Scale — a future-focused, data-obsessed agency revolutionizing video advertising on TV and social media. Think Amazon’s obsession with customer experience meets SpaceX’s fearless ambition—that’s the DNA behind everything we do.

Our 160-person team of creatives, strategists, and innovators produces thousands of high-impact campaigns weekly for the world’s leading lifestyle, fashion, beauty, and DTC brands. With 50,000 sq. ft. of DTLA studios and a global influencer network, we’re ready to 10x our output in 2026—and we need a UGC Video Editor who can take raw creator footage and turn it into high-converting, "scroll-stopping" ads.

Why This Role Matters

Authenticity, pacing, and performance are your playground. As a UGC Video Editor, you are the bridge between a raw influencer review and a profitable ad campaign. You understand that in 2026, a polished cinematic commercial often loses to a well-edited, authentic-looking TikTok shot on an iPhone.

Your job is to craft the narrative, nail the hook, and apply the specific editing language of the internet (captions, sounds, pacing) to drive sales. If you are obsessed with why some videos go viral and others flop, this is your launchpad.

What You’ll Do

  1. Transform Raw Assets into Ads

    • Ingest raw footage from creators and influencers (testimonials, unboxings, demos) and craft them into cohesive direct-response video ads.

    • Structure edits around proven marketing frameworks (Hook → Problem → Solution → Social Proof → CTA).

    • Ensure the "vibe" feels native to the platform (TikTok/Reels/Shorts), avoiding the "over-produced" look that kills engagement.

  2. Master the "Hook"

    • Create multiple variations of the first 3 seconds of every video to test what grabs attention best.

    • Utilize visual disruption, sound effects, and trending audio to prevent viewers from scrolling past.

  3. Apply Native Visuals

    • Implement platform-native text styles, dynamic captions (e.g., Alex Hormozi style), emojis, and stickers that enhance the storytelling without looking cluttered.

    • Clean up audio levels and apply basic color correction to ensure mobile viewing quality.

  4. Iterate at Speed

    • Produce high volumes of iterations (e.g., same body, different hook; same hook, different music) to feed our testing machine.

    • Respond quickly to data feedback from the media buying team (e.g., "Shorten the intro," "Make the text bigger").

Who You Are

  1. A Social Media Native

    • 1–3 years of experience editing UGC or social-first content (Agency or Freelance).

    • You understand the "visual language" of TikTok and Instagram. You know what trending fonts, sounds, and cuts are working right now.

  2. Technically Proficient

    • Expert proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro is required for our agency workflow.

    • Familiarity with CapCut features/styles and how to replicate them in Premiere is a massive plus.

    • Basic skills in After Effects or Photoshop for static asset integration.

  3. A Storyteller

    • You can take 20 minutes of rambling raw footage and cut it down to a sharp, persuasive 30-second story.

    • You have a good sense of rhythm and comedic timing.

  4. Fast & Adaptable

    • You are comfortable with high-volume workflows. You can churn out quality edits quickly.

    • You don't get attached to your cuts—you iterate based on what the data says.

  5. Excellent Communicator

    • Strong English proficiency is required. You can interpret creative briefs accurately and collaborate with producers remotely.

Perks & Benefits

  • Growth Opportunities: Influence the creative strategy of major DTC brands and sharpen your direct-response marketing skills.

  • Relentless Innovation Culture: Move fast, test constantly, and collaborate with some of the most creative minds in social media and video production.

High Scale is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and believe it’s key to building teams that change the world—one viral hook at a time.

Job Title: Account Partner - Veeva Commercial Basics

Job Location: Boston, MA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

We are looking for an entrepreneurial Account Partner to grow Veeva Commercial Basics, a suite of highly scalable medical and commercial applications that significantly impact how emerging Biotechnology and MedTech companies transition more efficiently and effectively from a clinical to a commercial organization. These are standardized, pre-configured applications without implementation and maintenance costs.

The Veeva Commercial Basics Account Partner will be responsible for meeting annual sales goals and helping the team achieve the long-range growth targets. In this role you will be responsible for generating new opportunities, winning new business, and managing executive level relationships with emerging Biotech and MedTech companies.

What You’ll Do

    • You’ll be a foundational member of the Veeva Commercial Basics sales organization and help make the product recognized as the go-to solution for emerging Biotechs and MedTech companies
    • Achieve team quarterly and annual sales goals
    • Execute fast sales cycles working directly with C-level Executives
    • Become knowledgeable on the Veeva Commercial Basics Commercial product suite
    • Responsible for running demos and fielding questions
    • Keep current with industry trends and engage customers in addressing their business challenges
    • Act with urgency, integrity, and a relentless focus on customer success

Requirements

    • Bachelors degree required
    • 4+ years of work experience
    • Including 3 years of Sales experience; a minimum of 1 year of software sales experience
    • Experience selling complex, out of the box solutions
    • Experience independently managing and driving a full sales cycle
    • Ability to sell directly to C-Level executives
    • Strong track record of hitting or exceeding sales quotas
    • We require candidates to be based in the general vicinity of the location posting

Nice to Have

    • A history of working with or selling to Life Sciences companies
    • Strong computer skills and experience with Gmail, Excel, PPT, CRM, Sigma or other reporting and analytics software
    • Entrepreneurial mindset and experience.
    • Familiarity with Veeva’s Commercial software and data products.
    • Experience prospecting as a SDR, BDR, Associate Account Partner, or Account Partner

Interviewing with Veeva

We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

    • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
    • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
    • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
    • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
        1. A conversation with the hiring manager
        2. A practical case exercise
        3. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
    • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

    • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
    • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
    • Retirement programs
    • 1% charitable giving program

Compensation

Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.

Summary of Primary Function/General Purpose of Position

Develop, implement and achieve grant revenue targets in accordance with BSMH Foundation strategic plan and goals. This position will oversee grant writing including the development and submission of grant documents (letters of inquiry, applications/ proposals, updates and reporting). This person will also coordinate with BSMH staff and program leaders (as well as outside parties when appropriate) the identification, evaluation and development of a case for support for funding priorities aligned with BSMH priorities and funder requirements. This person will also maintain accurate information in Raiser's Edge, facilitate proactive grant stewardship and prepare and submit all required reports as scheduled or assigned.

Essential Job Functions

  • Develop, write, and submit compelling grant proposals, letters of inquiry, applications, and other institutional funding communications that effectively articulate organizational priorities, community impact, and alignment with donor and funding strategies.
  • Partner with program leaders and Foundation staff to identify funding priorities, develop project concepts, and strengthen initiatives for philanthropic investment.
  • Translate complex programs, outcomes, and community impact data into clear, persuasive narratives that demonstrate need, effectiveness, and potential for measurable results.
  • Collaborate with internal partners to define project goals and establish meaningful outcome measures.
  • Development of compelling narratives for support by integrating community needs, program design, measurable outcomes, and beneficiary stories into funding opportunities.
  • Manage the full grant development process, including research, proposal planning, content creation, budgeting support, and submission.
  • Serve as a primary coordinator for grant proposals, organizing timelines, gathering required information from multiple stakeholders, ensuring deadlines are met, and maintaining high standards for proposal quality.
  • Maintain accurate grant records, proposal activity, and reporting schedules in Raiser's Edge and other Foundation systems.
  • Coordinate proposal launches and grant kick-off meetings and facilitate communication among internal stakeholders to support successful implementation of funded projects and compliance with grant requirements.
  • Facilitate a proactive grant stewardship plan to ensure regular and personalized communication, including annual site visits among funders.

Provide grant writing expertise, guidance, and communication support for Foundation fundraising initiatives and special projects as requested.

· Participate in meetings, trainings, committees, events, and professional development activities that support Foundation goals and enhance grant fundraising effectiveness.

  • 5-7 years of successful grant writing and coordination

  • Proven experience researching, developing, writing, and submitting competitive grant proposals, applications, budgets, reports, and supporting materials.
  • Experience managing multiple grant projects simultaneously, including complex proposals with significant funding objectives.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, proofreading, and storytelling skills, with the ability to communicate complex concepts clearly, accurately, and persuasively.

  • Knowledge of prospect research tools and techniques used to identify, evaluate, and qualify institutional funding opportunities.
  • Understanding of grant compliance requirements, restricted funding regulations, reporting expectations, and stewardship best practices.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple priorities, manage competing deadlines, and maintain attention to detail.

Galvanize is seeking an Enterprise Sales Manager to drive new business growth across our enterprise training and workforce development solutions. This role will play a critical part in accelerating the Galvanize mission to help organizations build the skilled talent they need for an AI-driven future. By creating new enterprise relationships and expanding access to our training solutions, the Enterprise Sales Manager will directly contribute to the growth and impact of Galvanize across the workforce development landscape.

This is a highly proactive, quota-carrying sales role focused on acquiring new enterprise customers, generating pipeline, and closing business. The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying opportunities, engaging decision-makers, navigating complex sales cycles, and converting prospects into long-term customers.

Success in this role requires strong prospecting skills, strategic outreach, relationship building, and consistent execution against ambitious revenue targets. We are looking for someone who is energized by creating opportunities, opening new doors, and winning new business.

While our sales approach is consultative and solution-oriented, this role is not focused on account maintenance or customer success. The primary responsibility is driving new customer acquisition and revenue growth for the Galvanize learning and workforce development solutions.

Description

Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable Specialists

About the role

We are hiring Accounts Payable / Accounts Receivable specialists to work 100% remotely from Mexico for small and mid-sized companies in the U.S., mainly construction, distribution, manufacturing and professional services.

What you will do

Accounts payable

  • Receive, code and enter vendor bills; match them to purchase orders and receipts.
  • Prepare weekly payment runs (ACH and checks) for approval.
  • Reconcile vendor statements and resolve discrepancies by email or phone.
  • Collect W-9s and keep vendor records current for 1099 reporting.

Accounts receivable

  • Create and send customer invoices, including progress billing where needed.
  • Apply customer payments and keep the aging report clean.
  • Follow up on overdue invoices by email and phone in English.
  • Support month-end close with AP/AR reconciliations for the bookkeeper or controller.

What you bring

Must have

  • 2+ years in accounts payable and/or receivable.
  • Hands-on QuickBooks Online or Desktop experience.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) for vendor and customer emails and calls.
  • Solid Excel: lookups, pivot tables, reconciliations.
  • Accuracy with numbers and a habit of documenting what you did.

Nice to have

  • Experience with U.S. companies or U.S. accounting (ACH, 1099s, sales tax).
  • Bill.com, Ramp, Sage, NetSuite or similar tools.
  • Construction billing experience: progress billing, retainage, lien waivers.

Requirements

Mandatory Requirements:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in Accounts Payable (AP) and/or Accounts Receivable (AR).
  • Hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online or Desktop.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) for professional emails and phone calls.
  • Strong Excel skills: lookups, pivot tables, and reconciliations.
  • Knowledge of invoice processing, vendor payments, billing, payment application, and collections.
  • Ability to work remotely from Mexico, Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. U.S. Central Time.
  • Ability to work as an independent contractor and issue CFDI invoices (RFC).
  • Experience with U.S. companies and U.S. accounting practices (ACH, W-9, 1099).
  • Experience with Bill.com, Ramp, Sage, or NetSuite.
  • Construction industry or progress billing experience.
  • Degree or studies in Accounting or Finance.

About Forge

At Forge, we strive to foster a diverse and inclusive community. We actively recruit and champion candidates who bring new perspectives from varied professional backgrounds and experiences, and we are intentional about ensuring a positive hiring experience for everyone. Our job postings don’t contain experience inflation, and most don’t require college degrees. Instead, they’re crafted to focus on outcomes and transferable experiences that are assessed in a structured interview process carried out by trained hiring teams.

Elastic is a leading global B2B eCommerce solution, serving the unique business needs of world-class manufacturers and retailers around the world. We’re seeking an AI-forward Product Designer who treats AI as a core part of their design workflow, not an afterthought. As a member of the Product Team, you’ll have a direct impact on how our product evolves. You’ll report to our Director of Product and work cross-functionally with product and engineering to build smart, tailored experiences for customers across regions, languages, and devices.

You’re curious about customer problems, you iterate fast, and you use AI tools to explore more, ship faster, and raise the quality bar. You use AI thoughtfully and take full ownership of your work, so everything you deliver reflects your craft and your standards.

You’re curious about customer problems, you iterate fast, and you use AI tools to explore more, ship faster, and raise the quality bar. You use AI thoughtfully and take full ownership of your work, so everything you deliver reflects your craft and your standards.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end UI design in Figma: user flows, high-fidelity screens, and interactive prototypes tied to product and customer needs
  • Design responsive experiences across mobile, tablet, and desktop
  • Use AI tools (e.g., Figma AI, Claude) to explore faster, generate variations, and prototype more, then refine with craft and judgment
  • Learn our business, our customers, and their buying workflows, and apply that understanding to design decisions
  • Gather feedback from end users and focus groups, and turn it into design improvements

  • Ability to quickly learn a complex business and its users
  • Ability to design for a global, multilingual audience
  • Ability to work independently, drive projects without direction, and prioritize across competing demands
  • Positive attitude, with the ability to give and receive constructive feedback
  • Clear written and verbal communication

Education and Experience

  • 5+ years as a UI/UX designer, product designer, or similar role
  • Expert-level Figma skills (auto layout, components, prototyping)
  • Experience designing accessible interfaces, with working knowledge of accessibility standards
  • Experience contributing to or building a design system (component libraries, documentation)
  • A portfolio showing shipped responsive web products, ideally in eCommerce or B2B
  • Demonstrated use of AI in your design process, with examples in your portfolio or in conversation

Newell Brands is a leading $8.3B consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands such as Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid® and Sharpie®, and 25,000 talented employees around the world. Regional Digital Program Manager – Operational Excellence Engineering, EMEA & APAC

Purpose of the role

Join our regional Operational Excellence Engineering Digital team and play a key role in accelerating digital transformation across our manufacturing network in EMEA & APAC.

Our team owns and develops the shared regional platform connecting machine data, orchestration, analytics and business systems, providing manufacturing sites with the standards and capabilities they need to turn digital solutions into tangible operational improvements.

As Regional Digital Program Manager, you will be the driving force behind the execution of this regional digital program. You will coordinate rollout waves, site engagements, external partners and demand intake, ensuring that priorities translate into action and that regional solutions are successfully adopted across our manufacturing sites.

This is a highly collaborative role for someone who enjoys connecting technology, manufacturing operations and people, bringing structure to complex programs and making things happen across multiple countries and stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

  • Drive regional rollout coordination across manufacturing sites, managing schedules, dependencies, site readiness and open actions.
  • Manage the demand intake process, gathering and structuring requests from sites and business teams and preparing them for prioritisation by the Regional Program Lead.
  • Coordinate external contractor delivery from scope definition and planning through progress tracking and final handover to internal owners.
  • Support the implementation of regional digital standards across all sites, including KPI definitions, templates and applications, while monitoring progress and closing adoption gaps.
  • Act as a key connection point between manufacturing sites and the regional program, surfacing challenges, coordinating decisions and ensuring effective follow-through.
  • Organise capability-building and key-user training, working with internal and external trainers and monitoring adoption across sites.
  • Partner closely with site leadership, IT teams, technical experts, vendors and program stakeholders to keep execution aligned and moving forward.
  • Provide clear, consolidated program reporting, highlighting progress, risks, dependencies and decisions required.
  • Translate the priorities established by the Regional Program Lead into coordinated execution across sites, internal teams and external partners.

What we’re looking for

You are an experienced technical project or program manager who is comfortable operating at the intersection of technology, manufacturing and business.

You bring:

  • Strong technical project/program management experience, with broad exposure to IT, OT and business applications.
  • Experience working in a manufacturing or industrial environment, with a good understanding of how technology and operations come together on the shop floor.
  • A proven ability to coordinate complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives across sites, functions and external partners.
  • Excellent organisational and follow-through skills, with a structured and documentation-oriented approach.
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to engage effectively with site teams, leadership, central functions, IT and vendors.
  • A collaborative, enabling mindset: you know how to influence and coordinate without direct authority.
  • Professional fluency in English.

What will make you successful

You don’t need to be the deepest technical expert in one specific technology. What matters is your ability to understand the technical landscape, connect the right people and turn priorities into execution.

You are someone who brings clarity to complexity, keeps multiple workstreams moving and enjoys seeing digital solutions successfully adopted in real manufacturing environments.

Department: Business Intelligence & Strategy

Location: United States, Remote with Travel to Clients, Conferences, and Events

Senior Vice President, Growth & Commercialization

  • About Underscore

    Underscore is a specialized commercialization partner helping biopharma organizations apply strategic media and professional services to activate healthcare professionals and patients for new treatments, including rare disease and oncology launches and brand growth efforts.

    Our next chapter is powered by deep strategic expertise, data and technology-enabled solutions, productized intellectual property, a repeatable innovation engine, strong commercialization, and a clear market position.

    To help build this next chapter, we are seeking a Senior Vice President, Growth & Commercialization.

    Position Overview

    The SVP, Growth & Commercialization is accountable for Underscore’s market-facing growth engine. This leader owns agency positioning, marketing, business development, pipeline generation, new client acquisition, and the commercialization of new products, services, and capabilities.

    The role does not own Innovation governance or Product development. Instead, the SVP works as the commercial counterpart to the SVP, Innovation, Product & Technology: Growth brings market trends, prospect feedback, competitive intelligence, and client demand signals into the innovation funnel; Product brings selected products and capabilities into commercialization for packaging, positioning, enablement, launch, adoption, and revenue realization.

    The role also partners closely with Client Services, which retains and grows existing accounts, Strategic Solutions, which delivers client solutions and consulting, and with Strategic Operations, which operationalizes new offerings so the organization can deliver them consistently and at scale.

    Position Purpose

    The primary mission of this role is to answer five critical questions:

    Where should Underscore compete and grow?

    How should Underscore continue to position and differentiate itself as market changes occur?

    How do we continue to generate qualified demand and win new clients (strategic approach, staffing, messaging, materials) ?

    How do new products and capabilities in development become market-ready offerings?

    How do we drive adoption, utilization, revenue, and commercial learning after launch of new products and services?

    Own the Growth Strategy and Commercial Engine

    Build and lead the integrated system for market visibility, demand generation, pipeline development, new business, and new client acquisition.

    Responsibilities

    • Develop enterprise growth strategy, annual priorities, and measurable growth plans with support from leaders, consultants and staff
    • Own agency marketing, ongoing brand positioning, thought leadership, and market visibility
    • Lead business development and sales strategy, pipeline governance, and new-client pursuits
    • Translate market trends, competitive activity, prospect feedback, and unmet needs into actionable opportunity signals for product and solution expansion
    • Partner with Client Services on clear boundaries between new-logo growth and organic growth within current accounts as well as integration and onboarding into the agency for new-logo wins
    • Build strategic partnerships and ecosystem relationships that strengthen market reach and commercial opportunity

    Success Measures

    • Forecast accuracy and pipeline discipline
    • Market awareness and thought-leadership reach
    • Qualified pipeline growth and quality
    • New client acquisition and win rate
    • Revenue from new clients
    • Strategic-partnership contribution

    Own Commercialization of New Offerings

    Turn products, services, and capabilities into clear, differentiated, sellable offerings that can be launched, adopted, and scaled.

    Responsibilities

    • Partner with the SVP, Innovation, Product & Technology early in the product lifecycle to define commercial requirements and market viability
    • Own offer design, packaging, value proposition, positioning, and commercialization plans
    • Partner with Client Finance and Finance on pricing strategy, business cases, financial assumptions, and margin expectations
    • Develop go-to-market plans, sales enablement, launch materials, proof points, and buyer narratives
    • Coordinate market readiness with Product, Strategy, Media, Client Services, and external partners
    • Own launch, adoption, utilization, commercial performance, and post-launch learning
    • Feed market response and adoption data back to Product and Innovation to improve the roadmap and portfolio

    Success Measures

    • Time from product readiness to market launch
    • Adoption and utilization
    • Revenue and margin from new offerings
    • Sales enablement readiness
    • Commercial conversion and attach rates
    • Post-launch learning incorporated into product decisions and ongoing improvements

    Create the Market-to-Innovation Feedback Loop

    Ensure Innovation and Product development decisions are grounded in external demand rather than internal ideas alone.

    Responsibilities

    • Monitor healthcare, biopharma, agency, media, data, technology, and buyer trends
    • Bring market, prospect, partner, and client signals into the innovation funnel
    • Partner with the SVP, Innovation, Product & Technology on opportunity assessment, business cases, and prioritization
    • Validate value propositions, buyer audiences, willingness to adopt, and competitive differentiation before significant build investment
    • Identify white-space opportunities that can become new services, products, or partnerships

    Success Measures

    • Quality and usefulness of market inputs to the innovation portfolio
    • Percentage of prioritized ideas validated with market evidence
    • Commercial potential of innovation pipeline
    • Reduced investment in low-demand ideas
    • Speed of learning from market validation

    Lead Positioning and Market Activation

    Create a distinct and consistent market presence across marketing, sales, partnerships, thought leadership, and new offerings.

    Responsibilities

    • Own the agency positioning framework and activation plan
    • Ensure coordinated narratives and team training across company marketing, new business, offerings, and external thought leadership
    • Guide competitive differentiation and category positioning in alignment with growth goals
    • Partner with Strategy and Media leaders to ensure market claims reflect real delivery capabilities
    • Establish positioning governance and reusable messaging tools

    Success Measures

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Payments Gateway
raw.excerpt: About Versapay 🚀Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
raw.description:
About Versapay 🚀

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.
Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!

Your Impact at Versapay:

Product management at Versapay is a craft that blends strategic thinking, customer empathy, and strong execution. As Senior Product Manager, Payments Gateway, you will own Versapay’s payment gateways: the platform every Versapay payment flows through, from authorization to settlement.

You will set the vision and roadmap for a modular, scalable, multi-tenant gateway that connects Versapay’saccounts receivable products to processors, acquirers, and card & bank networks. You ownboth the product and business outcomes for the gateways; authorization and payment success rates, uptime and latency, downgrades, cost per transaction, and more.

This is a platform role. Your customers are Versapay’s product teams, our core processing partners, the developers and ERP partners who integrate with us, and the ledger and finance teams who depend on every payment landing correctly. You will partner directly with engineering on architecture and delivery, work with go-to-market teams on positioning and regularly represent gateway strategy and performance to senior leadership, influencing direction and investment.

This is an opportunity for a product leader who has built/scaled a payment gateway and is ready to grow and modernize a global B2B payments platform.

What You'll Do:

    • Own the gateway strategy and roadmap. Set the multi-year vision for Versapay’s owned gateways across card, bank, and alternative payment methods in every market we serve. Balance near-term improvements with long-term platform investments and make the trade-offs explicit.

    • Drive payment performance. Own the gateway’s core KPIs: authorization and payment success rates, decline and retry performance, uptime, latency, and processing cost. Improve them through connection optimization, failover, smart retries, network tokenization, account updater, 3DS and authentication flows, and B2B card data (Level 2/3).

    • Build the platform others build on. Define the gateway’s APIs, SDKs, hosted payment pages, webhooks, and merchant and MID configuration so Versapay product teams and partners can launch new payment experiences in days, not quarters.

    • Own processor, acquirer, and network connectivity. Lead the evaluation, certification, and launch of processor and acquirer integrations and new network capabilities. Translate network specs and mandates into clear requirements, and keep the gateway compliant with card brand rules, PCI DSS, and regional regulations.

    • Own the transaction lifecycle end to end. Authorization, capture, refunds, voids, disputes and chargebacks, and settlement, including the clean handoff of transaction data to ledger and reconciliation. Partner with risk, compliance, and payment operations to keep money moving safely.

    • Lead engineering teams to deliver. Lead engineering team(s) and oversee execution across pods, from writing requirements to measuring success. Drive trade-off decisions on architecture, reliability, and platform design while keeping the team unblocked and managing the SDLC.

    • Use AI to compound platform value. Apply ML and agentic approaches to retry optimization, decline analysis, anomaly detection, incident triage, and partner integration support. Versapay is rebuilding for an AI-native operating model, and the gateway is core to that.

    • Be the in-house expert. Serve as Versapay’s authority on gateway architecture, payment processing, and network rules. Educate product and engineering teams, brief executives, and represent the platform externally with partners and customers.

What You Bring to the Team:

    • 6+ years in payments or fintech product management, with at least 3 years owning a payment gateway, processing, orchestration, or PSP platform end to end. Senior IC who has driven a roadmap, not just contributed to one.

    • Built or significantly scaled a gateway. You have shipped gateway capabilities in production — not just integrated a third-party gateway — and can speak to what changed and why.

    • Deep transaction lifecycle expertise. You understand authorization flows, network messaging (ISO 8583), tokenization, capture and settlement, chargebacks, interchange, and failover, and how each affects merchants and cost.

    • A record of moving payment performance metrics. You have measurably improved authorization rates, processing cost, uptime, or latency, and can show the data.

    • Global payments expertise. Experience across North America and international markets, including multi-currency processing, local payment methods, and the regimes that govern them (PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, card brand rules).

    • Track record of leading engineering teams in execution. You have overseen engineering pods or squads as the product owner, setting priorities, removing blockers, making architectural trade-offs alongside engineering leadership, and shipping on commitment.

    • AI fluency. Hands-on experience applying LLMs, ML, or agentic systems to payment workflows. You have a clear, defensible point of view on where AI belongs in a gateway and where it must not.

    • Builder mentality. Entrepreneurial, biased to action, comfortable with ambiguity, and energized by net-new initiatives where the path is not yet drawn.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

raw.description:
Vira Games - незалежна ігрова компанія, що спеціалізується на розробці та видавництві мобільних ігор. Наша команда - це творчий альянс, що об’єднує досвід, креативність, драйвовість і професіоналізм.

Шукаємо сильного Senior Game Designer із системним мисленням та досвідом роботи над великими ігровими проєктами.

Основний фокус ролі:проєктування gameplay- та meta-систем, progression, economy, balance і довгострокового розвитку продукту.

Основні обов’язки:

  • Проєктувати та розвивати core gameplay і meta-системи

  • Працювати з progression, economy, rewards, balance і difficulty

  • Будувати зв’язки між різними системами гри

  • Писати та підтримувати GDD і спеки фічей

  • Вести фічі від ідеї до реалізації та аналізу результатів

  • Формувати гіпотези та брати участь в A/B тестах

  • Працювати з аналітикою та продуктовими метриками

  • Працювати разом із Producer, Developers, UI/UX, Analysts, Artists та іншими спеціалістами

  • Рев’ювати реалізацію фічей та стежити, щоб результат відповідав design intent

  • Використовувати AI-інструменти для research, документації, аналізу та прототипування

  • AI-Native Workflow: вільно використовуєте AI-інструменти для ресерчу, генерації ідей, прототипування та написання документації.

Вимоги:

  • 5+ років досвіду на позиції Game Designer у mobile-проєктах (F2P / casual / mid-core).

  • Досвід роботи над великими ігровими проєктами

  • Сильне продуктове мислення: розуміння не тільки як працює фіча, а й навіщо вона потрібна гравцю та продукту

  • Базове володіння Unity (налаштування, складання прототипів)

  • Портфоліо з проєктами над якими працювали

  • Хороше розуміння: core / meta loops, progression, retention mechanics

Буде плюсом:

  • Досвід роботи з проєктом від старту з нуля до запуску та подальшого розвитку live-продукту

  • Глибокі знання Unity

  • Сильна експертиза в game balance та economy

  • Поглиблене розуміння монетизації

  • Досвід роботи з різними жанрами ігор

  • Досвід роботи над online / social games

  • Практичний досвід з LiveOps

  • Досвід mentoring / review інших Game Designers

Процес підбору:

  1. Інтервʼю з рекрутером.

  2. Тестове завдання.

  3. Інтервʼю з наймаючим менеджером.

  4. Збір рекомендацій.

  5. Офер.

Що ми пропонуємо:

Бенефіт-кафе: Свобода вибору — персональний бюджет на страхування, навчання, спортзал чи будь-що для твого балансу.

Бонуси за досягнення: Цінуємо strive for excellence і командну гру, відзначаємо помітні результати, ініціативу та реальний вплив.

Remote First: Працюй з будь-якої точки світу — віддалена робота є стандартом, а не винятком.

Вплив на бізнес: Мінімум бюрократії, максимум свободи дій і можливість втілювати свої ідеї.

Career Boost: Розвиток професійної експертизи, навчання, внутрішні тренінги, стратегічні сесії.

Culture Driver: Атмосфера єдиної команди, де успіх — результат спільної праці.

raw.description:
TransUnion's Job Applicant Privacy Notice

Team Overview

Sontiq is TransUnion's identity protection and cyber safety business, helping consumers affected by identity theft, fraud, and data breaches protect and restore their identities through expert support and guidance. The team works closely with customers, clients, and internal specialists to deliver timely assistance during challenging situations, making a meaningful difference in customers' recovery journeys. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in identity protection and customer support while working in a collaborative, customer-focused environment.

This role reports to the Associate Lead, Customer Support Operations.This is a remote position which may require occasional in-person attendance at work-related events at the discretion of management.

Role Overview And Core Responsibilities

As a Customer Service Incident Coordinator (Dutch Speaking), you will support customers impacted by identity theft, fraud, and data breach incidents, helping them navigate the resolution process and access the support they need. You will play an important role in delivering positive customer outcomes, coordinating with internal and external stakeholders, and providing reassurance and guidance during sensitive situations.

Night Shift: Monday to Friday, 22:30–07:00

  • Conduct customer interviews by telephone to gather information relating to fraud, data breach, and identity theft incidents.
  • Review and analyse case information to assess the nature and severity of incidents and determine appropriate next steps.
  • Provide professional, empathetic, and high-quality customer support to individuals affected by fraud, identity theft, or data breach events.
  • Manage customer expectations by providing clear updates and guidance throughout the incident resolution process.
  • Act as a key point of contact between customers, clients, and internal subject matter experts.
  • Gather, document, and maintain relevant information and supporting evidence to assist with identity restoration and remediation activities.
  • Prepare correspondence and communicate with creditors, government agencies, and other third parties when required to support case resolution.
  • Clearly explain available services, support options, and recommended actions to customers.
  • Support clients and customers in understanding breach-related incidents and identifying appropriate remediation requirements.
  • Escalate cases requiring specialist support and coordinate communications, meetings, and updates across relevant teams.

Required Knowledge And Experiences

  • Fluency in Dutch and English, both written and verbal, to support effective communication with customers, clients, and stakeholders.
  • Previous customer service experience, ideally within a fast-paced, customer-facing, or support environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and provide clear guidance during sensitive customer situations.
  • Ability to review information, assess customer needs, and make informed decisions when managing incident-related cases.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple cases and maintain accurate records.

Required Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.
  • Ability to accurately document, maintain, and manage customer case information within internal systems.
  • Experience using customer service, case management, or customer relationship management platforms.

What’s in it for you?

At TransUnion you will be joining a friendly, forward thinking global business. As well as an excellent salary and bonus scheme or commission scheme (if joining our sales teams) our benefits package comes with:

  • 26 days annual leave and bank holidays (increasing with service)
  • Global paid wellness days off and a bonus day off to celebrate your birthday
  • A generous contributory pension scheme and access to the TransUnion Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Private health care and a variety of physical, mental and financial fitness wellbeing programmes such as access to mindfulness tools
  • Access to our diversity forums and communities so you can get involved in causes close to your heart

TransUnion – a place to grow:

If there’s something on the list of essential or desirable skills that you can’t quite tick off, don’t let that stop you from applying. We are open to exploring training and development opportunities for the right candidate to ensure you are successful. We know imposter syndrome is real, lets confront it so we can continue to grow and thrive together.

Flexibility at TU:

We recognise that our people need the freedom to balance their day-to-day lives with their work. This is why we’ve set out to create inclusive and flexible policies and practices for you to accommodate all your responsibilities and needs: children, family and beyond. If the role is advertised as full time, don’t let this stop you from applying. Let us know if you’re looking for a part time or flexible working arrangement and we can discuss this with you.

Additional support:

raw.excerpt: About the ProgramThe Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI.
raw.description:
About the Program

The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) brings researchers and scientists together to tackle consequential problems in AI. In partnership with Scale Labs, we are building a small cohort of researchers to work on the empirical foundations of AI safety.

That work includes finding where models fail, checking whether safety controls hold up under pressure in realistic settings, and studying how AI agents (mis-)behave over long-horizon tasks. Scholars take open research questions like these and turn them into work that improves how frontier AI systems are evaluated and safeguarded.

Each scholar owns a substantial part of a safety research project. You'll work alongside a mentor from the research question through the experiments to deciding what to test next.

Research Areas

Mentors will guide Research Scholars on projects in selected AI safety research areas in select AI safety research areas, such as:

  • AI control and chain-of-thought monitoring: Developing techniques to oversee and constrain AIs, including detecting harmful intent or deception.
  • Alignment auditing and evaluations: Building scalable methods to test whether models have hidden goals, misaligned behaviors or unsafe tendencies.
  • Multi-agent safety: Studying the risks that emerge when multiple agents interact, such as collusion, coordinated failures, or unexpected collective behavior.
  • Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) safety: Investigating how to keep AI systems safe and aligned as AIs increasingly contribute to their own development.
  • Science of Evaluations: examining when and how models recognize they're being tested, and how situational awareness affects the reliability/validity of evaluations.
  • Misuse risks and evaluations: Developing methods to assess how AI systems could be exploited by malicious actors, including evaluating their potential to enable harmful activities.

Projects are matched to demonstrated expertise; we don’t expect any candidate to cover every area.

Representative Research

  • ASPI: 728 task–attack scenarios testing how clarification-seeking changes prompt-injection vulnerability in LLM agents.
  • PropensityBench: simulating real-world pressure to choose between safe or harmful behavior
  • BioRiskEval: evaluating whether safeguards for open-weight bio-foundation models remain robust under fine-tuning and probing.
  • See more work from the Human Frontier Collective.

What You'll Do

Projects are mentor-guided. By default, you will be given a list of research proposals and match you with one based on your research interests and background. You’ll meet weekly with a Scale researcher who sets the direction and gives feedback, and you will drive the day-to-day work.

  • Own research end to end: Turn a high-level safety question into hypotheses, baselines, and controlled experiments, and produce work that others can inspect and build on.
  • Build the measurement: Implement and debug evaluation harnesses, agent environments, datasets, monitoring methods, or post-training experiments.
  • Exercise research judgment: Identify confounds, separate what a model can do from what it tends to do, make sense of negative results, and decide what to try next without step-by-step direction.
  • Make the work legible: Produce reproducible code, experiment logs, analysis, and precise technical writing. External outputs, where appropriate, remain subject to research, security, and communications review. Outputs also include research papers, which will be submitted to top ML conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).

Who We're Looking For

You may be a good fit if you:

  • are motivated by ensuring the safe and responsible development of advanced AI systems;
  • are interested in technical safety research, such as alignment evaluations, AI control, monitoring, multi-agent safety, or open-weight model safety;
  • are pursuing or have completed a PhD in CS, ML, statistics, mathematics, or a related field (we also encourage researchers with an equivalent track record to apply);

raw.title: Senior Security Engineer – Data Pipeline & Observability - Mid-Atlantic region
raw.excerpt: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk.
raw.description:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

GuidePoint is both a Value-Added Reseller (VAR) and a professional services organization, and an award winning Cribl partner (Cribl Americas Solution Provider Partner of the Year, 2026). In this role you will work directly with our vendor partners and account teams, see the same problems across many client environments, and keep up with a market that is changing quickly.

Security data is growing faster than security budgets. Clients come to us because their SIEM bill is out of control, their data is inconsistent, or they are moving platforms and need the data to arrive clean. You will design and build the pipelines that fix those problems, and you will explain the cost and security trade-offs to the people who pay for them

About our Mid-Atlantic SecOps practice

Our team of data engineers, SecOps engineers, consultants, architects, and platform specialists focuses on data integration, normalization, quality, routing, retention, and platform optimization. We partner with clients, account executives, project managers, source-system owners, security teams, and technology providers to create supportable data services.

Key areas of focus include:

  • Establishing reliable and reusable data pipelines.
  • Improving data quality, accessibility, and processing efficiency.
  • Supporting security, observability, analytics, and operational use cases.

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Architect, deploy, and optimize telemetry pipelines with Cribl Stream, Edge, Lake, and Search, and with comparable platforms such as SentinelOne AI Data Pipelines (Observo AI), CrowdStrike Onum, Palo Alto Networks Chronosphere, Datadog Observability Pipelines (Vector), Splunk Edge Processor, and the OpenTelemetry Collector
  • Onboard, parse, and normalize data from syslog, agents, cloud provider logs, SaaS APIs, identity (Microsoft Entra ID, Okta), EDR, and network sources into common schemas (OCSF, Splunk CIM, Elastic ECS, Google UDM)
  • Build reduction, filtering, enrichment, and tiering strategies that send only high value data to premium analytics platforms, keep full fidelity copies in low cost storage, and support replay on demand
  • Quantify the business cases of baseline ingest, model savings, and present before and after results to technical and financial stakeholders
  • Brief client senior leadership (CISO, CIO, CFO) on findings, progress, and recommendations, framed around the customer’s measured business goals (cost avoided, coverage gained, risk reduced, time to investigate) rather than the technical components alone
  • Size and harden deployments, including worker topology, high availability and disaster recovery, queuing and backpressure, and fleet health monitoring, across on-premises, cloud, hybrid, and regulated environments
  • Build governance into the data flow with masking and redaction of sensitive data, role-based access control, TLS/PKI, and retention policy
  • Lead the data workstream of SIEM and platform migrations (for example Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM, SentinelOne AI SIEM)
  • Deliver pipeline health checks and optimization assessments with prioritized, actionable roadmaps
  • Support pre-sales by joining scoping calls with Solutions Architects and account teams, estimate level of effort, and contribute to statements of work
  • Work with vendor partner engineering teams on joint delivery, escalations, and product feedback and maintain current partner certifications
  • Work alongside Detection & Response and Automation & AI engineers to establish clean and well routed data to help make detection content, automation, and AI SOC agents more effective for our customers.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact on engagements, with clear progress reporting, as-built documentation, runbooks, and knowledge transfer to client teams
  • Contribute to practice intellectual property, including reusable packs, delivery playbooks, and effort baselines, and mentor other engineers

Required Experience and Education:

  • 5+ years in cybersecurity, IT operations, or data engineering, including 3+ years building and running production telemetry pipelines
  • Hands-on production experience with Cribl Stream or a comparable pipeline platform
  • Working knowledge of at least one SIEM or analytics destination (Splunk, Elastic, Microsoft Sentinel, Google SecOps, CrowdStrike, or SentinelOne), enough to know what the data must look like when it arrives
  • Client-facing delivery experience as a consultant with a services firm, VAR, systems integrator, MSSP, or vendor professional services team, or an equivalent internal role delivering to multiple business units
  • Linux administration and networking fundamentals (syslog over TCP/UDP/TLS, load balancing, firewalls), plus logging services in at least one cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Scripting and data skills: JavaScript, Python, or Bash; regular expressions; REST APIs; JSON, key-value, CSV, and XML formats
  • Ability to engage senior leadership and translate technical work into business terms, tying recommendations to the customer’s measurable goals rather than to the technical components alone, in writing and in person
  • Cribl Certified User and Cribl Certified Admin (Stream), held at hire or earned within 90 days
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Experience at a VAR, systems integrator, or MSSP working within vendor partner programs (partner certifications, joint delivery, supporting account teams on deals)
  • Technical writing experience: assessment reports, executive summaries, architecture and as-built documents, and roadmaps written for both technical and executive readers (writing samples welcome)
  • Delivery experience on more than one pipeline platform, with the judgment to recommend the right tool for the client
  • Cribl Certified Admin (Edge); Splunk Certified Admin or Architect; Elastic Certified Engineer; SentinelOne AI Data Pipelines; cloud certifications (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Kubernetes and containers; Terraform or Ansible; Git and CI/CD for pipeline configuration as code
  • Kafka, object storage and data lakes (Amazon S3, Azure Blob, Cribl Lake), and Snowflake or Databricks as destinations
  • OpenTelemetry for metrics and traces, and IT observability use cases alongside security
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK data sources and what detection engineers need from the data
  • Regulated or federal environments (HIPAA, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, CMMC, FIPS); ability to obtain a U.S. security clearance is a plus

Travel Requirements:

  • Up to 15% travel

Physical Requirements:

  • Sedentary work
  • Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day
  • Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day

Note: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for this role.

We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.

Why GuidePoint?

GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers.

Firmly-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company’s success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity.

This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation.

Some added perks….

  • Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on-site may be required for Federal positions)
  • Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options)
  • Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans
  • 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program
  • Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance
  • Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment
  • Pet Benefit Option
