This is Engineering at Lattice

Lattice’s Engineering team continuously works to better our product and our craft. We use a modern, cutting-edge tech stack and love experimenting with new technologies. We strive for maintainable, robust, and performant code. We’re highly collaborative and continuously iterative and work closely with designers and product managers. We prioritize not only great technical architecture but also an amazing product experience.

The Integrations team builds the product and platform capabilities that connect Lattice with the tools our customers rely on. The team has established Lattice’s first outbound integration pattern with Workday, launched an MCP Server now used by more than 100 customers, and is expanding into third-party productivity-data ingestion to power products including Auto Updates and Evidence-Based Reviews.

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to help this team scale its impact: bringing integrations to market, building reusable platform capabilities and playbooks, and creating the operating rigor that allows each new integration to ship more effectively than the last.

What You Will Bring to the Table

You have 4+ years of experience directly managing software engineers. In this capacity, you have been responsible for guiding and coaching the development of your direct reports, providing performance feedback, hiring, and fostering a diverse, collaborative, and inclusive team culture.

  • Experience leading integrations, API/developer platforms, ecosystems, or marketplace teams.
  • Proven record shipping and operating third-party integrations, managing partner dependencies and API reliability.
  • Strong people leadership, including coaching for growth and promotion and addressing sustained underperformance.
  • Builds clear operating mechanisms for prioritization, delivery, quality, and cross-functional decisions.
  • Effective cross-functional partner to Product, TPM, GTM, and external technical stakeholders; able to build alignment across complex discussions.
  • Connects technical strategy to organizational goals and delivers measurable outcomes.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communicator who adapts effectively for executives, technical teams, and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfortable owning ambiguous, high-autonomy work and driving it to completion.
  • Empathetic, employee-centered leader committed to helping team members do the best work of their careers.
  • Demonstrates Lattice’s values: Ship Shipmate Self, Clear Eyes, Own The Outcome, and What’s Next?
  • Preferred: experience with Node.js, React, Flow, GraphQL, Postgres, and AWS.

What You Will Do

  • Lead delivery of third-party integrations and platform capabilities from prioritization through launch and ongoing operation.
  • Create reusable playbooks, technical patterns, and processes that reduce the time and effort required to launch future integrations.
  • Mentor and coach engineers, promoting technical growth and aligning their development with team & company objectives.
  • Bring a relentless passion for continuous improvement for both engineering craft and processes.
  • You will ensure a delightful, reliable experience for Lattice customers around the globe, while simultaneously enabling a rapid pace of development.
  • You will work with your team, Product, and Design to build new customer-facing products, and improve upon existing ones.
  • You will represent your team to the larger org. Ensure they receive public recognition for their success and take ownership of their failures.

___

The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $146,250 - CAD $195,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.

Benefits: The Company offers the following benefits for this position, subject to applicable eligibility requirements: Medical insurance; Dental insurance; Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance; Natural Disaster Support Program; Wellness Apps; Paid Parental Leave, Paid Time off inclusive of holidays and sick time; Working Remotely Stipend; One time WFH Office Set-Up Stipend; Retirement Plan; Financial Planning; and Learning & Development Budget.

Compensation may vary based on (a) location, as Lattice factors in specific location when benchmarking compensation for most roles; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience. About Lattice

Lattice is on a mission to build cultures where employees and their companies thrive. In an age where employees have more choices than ever before, businesses that put employees first are winning 🏅– and Lattice is building the tools to empower those people-centric companies.

Lattice is a people success platform that offers performance reviews, employee engagement surveys, real-time feedback, weekly check-ins, goal setting, and career planning in a way that allows companies to focus on employee development, growth, and engagement – yielding stronger employee retention, performance, and impact to the bottom line 📈. Since launching in 2016, we have grown to over 5,000+ customers globally, including brands like Loom, Robinhood, and Gusto.

Company Description

IntellaQuest builds mission-critical software for industrial organizations operating in highly regulated environments. Our integrated Quality Management (QMS) and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) system helps manufacturers like Honda, Subaru, Shell, and Magna promote quality, increase productivity, and stay “always audit ready.”

As part of ASG, IntellaQuest is backed by Alpine Investors and connected to a community of market-leading SaaS companies. ASG believes in the power of people and data to build great organizations, and in the value of sharing knowledge, expertise, and resources across its portfolio to drive long-term, sustainable growth.

Job Description

The Senior Account Manager owns renewals and expansion across a book of roughly 80 enterprise manufacturing accounts, working alongside an existing Account Manager on a growing team. The core mission is shifting expansion from inbound-driven to proactively sold, from new modules to full rollouts at new sites. This role reports to the VP of Customer Experience.

You’re Excited About This Opportunity Because You Will:

  • Own renewals and retention across a book of roughly 80 enterprise accounts, protecting a strong retention base.
  • Drive expansion through new modules and new sites, shifting from inbound-led demand to proactive outreach.
  • Run end-to-end sales cycles for new-site expansions, partnering with a sales engineer on module demos.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships from plant-level users to VP and C-suite so customers always know who to call.
  • Partner with Implementation, Support, and Product to create clean handoffs and keep onboarding or response-time issues from becoming churn risk.
  • Shape account planning, coverage, and renewal playbooks alongside the Account Management team as the function matures.
  • Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and forecast renewals and expansion accurately.

We’re Excited About You Because:

  • You bring 3-5+ years owning renewals and expansion, with a quota tied to upsell or cross-sell revenue.
  • You have managed a large book of accounts independently and know how to prioritize by growth potential.
  • You build credibility with VP and C-suite stakeholders at large companies and can push back on unreasonable requests with confidence.
  • You sell consultatively, tying product capabilities to measurable customer outcomes.
  • You communicate with energy and clarity in live demos and customer conversations.
  • You ideally bring quality, EHS, or industrial manufacturing experience, and are comfortable traveling up to 20%.
  • You possess a proactive, solution-oriented, problem-solving mindset -- “I’ll figure it out.”
  • You thrive in a small, growing, fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

Location: Fully remote (US or Canada)

Base Salary Range: The target salary range for this position is US: ($80,000 - $90,000) | Canada: (C$112,000 - C$126,000), and is part of a competitive total rewards package including an annual bonus, employer-paid benefits, L&D stipend and incentive pay for eligible roles. Individual pay may vary from the target range and is determined by a number of factors including experience, location, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. We review all employee pay and compensation programs annually at minimum to ensure competitive and fair pay.

A Secure Candidate Experience: All official emails and messages regarding your application will come from an @intellaquest.com or @alpinesg.com email address. We will never ask for sensitive personal information such as Social Security numbers, banking information, or payment details during the hiring process.

The Global Flagship Accounts Manager is responsible for driving customer retention, growth, and long-term success within an assigned portfolio of accounts. This role partners cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Professional Services teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences while achieving revenue and retention objectives. Success in this role requires strong consultative-selling skills, customer advocacy, business acumen, and the ability to manage complex customer relationships throughout the account lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts, building trusted relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Conduct regular business reviews to understand customer objectives, challenges, and opportunities for growth
  • Develop and execute account plans that drive customer retention, expansion, and long-term success.
  • Drive renewals and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities across software solutions, subscriptions, and professional services.
